name: Afternoon Delight
abstract: Afternoon Delight is described as an indica-dominant hybrid with a hazy aura that engulfs the mind and body.

name: Afwreck
abstract: Afwreck is a hybrid cross of Afghani and Trainwreck.  Strong sativa effects with immediate head-concentrated high.

name: Agent Orange
abstract: An orange-smelling strain that has a citrus aftertaste.  This strain of cannabis produces an uplifting and almost psychedelic effect.

name: Agent Tangie
abstract: For those craving a cerebral buzz with a citrus kick, 3C Agent Tangie is perfect. The glittery colas are light green with a zesty, floral flavor. Its effects linger in the crown of the skull and disperse throughout the body in steady waves of invigoration.

name: Al's Dream
abstract: Al’s Dream is rapidly becoming a Colorado cannabis staple. This cross of Albert Walker and Blue Dream yields a unique connoisseur-grade flower with notes of celery seed and pungent earth that opens up with notes of citrus after combustion. Offering consumers a heady euphoria that lends itself to creative tasks, it also has medicinal benefits that curb the effects of depression, nausea, and stress.

name: Alaska
abstract: Alaska, developed by Tikun Olam, is an Israeli strain comprised of 70 percent sativa genetics.

name: Alaska Thunder Grape
abstract: From Sonoma County comes Alaska Thunder Grape, a hybrid strain that balances genetics from Matanuska Thunder Fuck and Grape Ape.

name: Alaskan Ice
abstract: Alaskan Ice by Green House Seeds is an energizing and euphoric sativa cross between White Widow and Haze.

name: Alaskan Thunder Fuck
abstract: A strong sativa strain, Alaskan Thunder Fuck will have you feeling the effects soon after exhale.  Originates in the Manatuska Valley area in Alaska.

name: Albert Walker
abstract: Albert Walker is an indica-dominant hybrid with a sour, skunky smell and heavy full-body effects that can last for several hours.

name: Alchemy
abstract: Alchemy is a 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain that was conjured by combining Chemdawg and Querkle.

name: Alf
parent_names: animal cookies cherry pie white fire alien og girl scout cookies
abstract: The indica-dominant hybrid Alf was created by crossing Animal Pie and Black Raven from The Captain’s Connection.

name: Alice in Wonderland
abstract: Alice in Wonderland is a mostly sativa strain with euphoric effects that are particularly helpful in treating mood disorders.

name: Alien Abduction
abstract: Alien Abduction is an OG Kush hybrid bred by So-Cal medical collective Ocean Grown Genetics, who crossed an Alien OG male with the Ether cut of Alien Dog.

name: Alien Asshat
abstract: Alien Asshat is a hybrid cannabis strain grown by Sky High Gardens in Washington.

name: Alien Bubba
abstract: Alien Bubba is the intergalactic cross of the renowned Bubba Kush and the heady space invader, Alien Kush. This two-fold Kush blend offers mellow sedation with a mental aura most would describe as introspective or meditative.

name: Alien Dawg
abstract: With a sour and pungent odor, Alien Dawg has a light, bitter taste and presents brilliant mind/body effects.

name: Alien Hallucination
abstract: Alien Hallucination is a hybrid cannabis strain that is believed to be a cross between the sedating Tahoe Alien and LSD.

name: Alien Inferno
abstract: Alien Inferno is a heavy-handed OG hybrid that can help relieve pain, boost creativity, and help you unwind.

name: Alien Kush
abstract: Alien Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that is a cross of LVPK and Alien Technology. It originally comes from California.

name: Alien OG
abstract: Alien OG is a strain cross from Tahoe OG and Alien Kush.

name: Alien Reunion
abstract: Alien Reunion is an indica-dominant cross of Alien OG and Alien Dawg bred by Cannobi Genetics. Its dense colas emit a pungent mix of flavors that include sweet fruity tones of cherry and lemon combined with a skunky, diesel note.

name: Alien Rift
abstract: Alien Rift by Ocean Grown Seeds is the thoroughly enhanced phenotype of Alien Abduction specifically backcrossed for better hash production. With a tart scent of lemon and spice and buds dense with trichomes, Alien Rift is certain to please the senses.

name: Alien Rock Candy
abstract: Alien Rock Candy by Alien Genetics is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Sour Dubble and Tahoe Alien.

name: Alien Sour Apple
abstract: Alien Sour Apple is a sativa-dominant hybrid that mixes the genetics of Alien Dawg with Sour Apple.

name: Alien Stardawg
abstract: Alien Stardawg is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross of Alien Kush and Stardawg bred by Green Beanz Seeds.

name: Alien Technology
abstract: Very little is known about Alien Technology other than it is a landrace strain selected from a handful of seeds acquired by breeder OBSoul33t from a US soldier returning from Afghanistan.

name: Allen Wrench
abstract: A popular strain for sativa-lovers, Allen Wrench presents the best qualities of its parents Trainwreck and New York City Diesel.

name: Allkush
abstract: Allkush, 2nd prize winner at the 2005 Highlife Cannabis Cup, is a hashy Kush blend bred by Paradise Seeds of Amsterdam. This resinous flower hails from the “Hippie Trail” that winds through Pakistan and Afghanistan, creating a 80/20 indica-dominant strain that soothes without binding the consumer to the couch.

name: Aloha
abstract: Aloha is a sativa cannabis strain that produces large flowers with a strong citrus smell and taste.

name: Aloha Limone
abstract: The smell of Aloha Limone has been described as, “a fruit tree rotting in the Kona sun.” Citrus notes are native to this Hawaiian Sunrise and Nina Limone cross, but the plant also expresses latent floral and pungent elements from recessive Kush genetics.

name: Alohaberry
abstract: Originating from the tropical islands of Hawaii, Alohaberry releases an aroma and taste of tropical berries.

name: Alpha Blue
abstract: Alpha Blue, also known as Dream Diesel (or DD), is a high-flying sativa that combines Blue Dream and Sour Diesel.

name: Alpha Cow
abstract: Alpha Cow is a sativa strain that brings together genetics from Alpha Blue and Purple Cow.

name: Alpha Express
abstract: Alpha Express is an introspective sativa strain that descends from Alpha Blue and Ghost Train Haze.

name: Alpha OG
abstract: Alpha OG from Alpha Medic is an OG Kush phenotype that took 2nd place in the 2014 Los Angeles Cannabis Cup.

name: Alpine Blue
abstract: Alpine Blue is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid that combines Blue Mystic and Power Plant, who pass on uplifting euphoric effects alongside a complex aroma of blueberry and woody pine.

name: Alpine Star
abstract: Alpine Star, often labeled as Alpine OG, is an earthy, citrus mix of Tahoe OG and Sensi Star genetics.

name: Ambrosia
abstract: With a sweet tropical flavor and dense sticky buds, Ambrosia's high will hit you quick and throughout your body.

name: American Dream
abstract: American Dream by Sensi Seeds is an indica-dominant strain that blends Afghan Skunk with Jamaican and Hawaiian genetics.

name: American Kush
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush sin city kush
abstract: American Kush, by Alphakronik Genes (AKG), is a 70/30 indica-dominant combination of Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Sin City Kush.

name: Americano
abstract: Americano is a Canadian strain released by Enterprise Seeds. It is a Northern Lights/Skunk hybrid that is named for the American consumers it was designed to attract.

name: Amethyst
abstract: Amethyst is a hybrid cannabis strain from the gardens of Zion Botanicals, who crossed parent strains Sage N Sour and Granddaddy Purple.

name: Amethyst
abstract: Amethyst is a hybrid cannabis strain from the gardens of Zion Botanicals, who crossed parent strains Sage N Sour and Granddaddy Purple.

name: Amnesia
abstract: Amnesia is typically a sativa-dominant cannabis strain with intense cerebral effects suitable for consumers treating mood disorders.

name: Amnesia Haze
parent_names: thai afghani hawaiian jamaican south asian indica cambodian haze
abstract: With earthy flavors of lemons and citrus, Amnesia Haze is a perfect strain to start your day with a smile. A mostly sativa hybrid, Amnesia Haze won first prize a the Hightimes Cannabis Cup in '04.

name: Ancient Kush
abstract: Ancient Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid strain whose genetic background is lost to history, but most certainly contains the age-old characteristics of Afghani indicas.

name: Ancient OG
abstract: Ancient OG from Bodhi Seeds is a mostly indica strain descended from an Iranian landrace and their Snow Lotus hybrid.

name: Anesthesia
abstract: Anesthesia is an indica cannabis strain that is known for its therapeutic treatment of pain as well as its earthy Afghan aroma and potency.

name: Angel OG
abstract: Angel OG is a fruity Kush cross that drapes the body in mellow effects from head to toe. This strain's OG Kush x Blackberry lineage gives the buds an aroma of earth, pine, and sweetness while supplying the consumer with potent physical effects.

name: Animal Cookies
abstract: Animal Cookies is a clone-only cross between the legendary hybrid marijuana strains Girl Scout Cookies and Fire OG.

name: Anonymous OG
abstract: The 3C Anonymous OG greets the nose with distinctive woodsy, citrus, diesel scent that indica connoisseurs all know and love. 3C Anonymous OG is a 3C Farms select cut of 3C Kushishima. Its round dense buds are wrapped in deep green calyxes that drip with resin and glitter with trichomes.

name: Ape Shit
abstract: Ape Shit is the genetic offspring of three quality cannabis strains. By crossing Purple Urkle, Acapulco Gold, and Cinderella 99, this hybrid strain blends deep body effects against bright, heady mental energy.

name: Apollo 11
abstract: Apollo 11 is a hybrid cannabis strain that is celebrated for its extremely quick flowering time and uplifting, cerebral effects.

name: Apollo 13
abstract: Apollo 13 is a hybrid cannabis strain that was bred by the Brothers Grimm. It is prized for its rarity and unique aroma.

name: Appalachia
abstract: Appalachia is a hybrid cross between Green Crack and Tres Dawg bred by High & Lonesome Seeds.

name: Appalachian Power
parent_names: island sweet skunk white widow lifesaver
abstract: Appalachian Power by Soulshine Cannabis is a potent sativa-dominant strain with a rich genetic lineage. By crossing The Appalachian (Grape Punch x Life Saver) with The Power (Island Sweet Skunk x White Widow), Appalachian Power was born.

name: Apple Jack
abstract: Apple Jack is the beautiful and popular hybrid cross of Jack Herer and White Widow. This potent combination embodies the uplifted clarity of Jack Herer while applying a warm, soothing relaxation to the body. This strain works wonders for patient and consumers suffering from chronic physical pain and nausea.

name: Apple Kush
abstract: Apple Kush is the indica-dominant hybrid cross of Sour Diesel and Pure Kush.

name: Appleberry
abstract: Appleberry by Sumdo Seeds in an indica-dominant yield machine. Bred from (Dynamite x Bubblelicious) x White Widow, this strain has classic Central Asian and Central American roots while expressing a terpene profile all its own.

name: Arabian Gold
abstract: Arabian Gold is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that can leave many consumers feeling unfocused but mentally relaxed.

name: Arctic Sun
abstract: Patients often look to this strain for relief of chronic pain, sleeplessness, and muscle spasms

name: ArcticBlue
abstract: ArcticBlue is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain cultivated by ArcticBlue Farms.

name: Area 51
abstract: A sativa-dominant hybrid of unknown origin, Area 51 has a sweet smell with citrus and floral undertones and a smooth flowery smoke.

name: Argyle
abstract: Argyle is a variety of Nordle grown by Canadian LP Tweed, Inc. The indica-dominant hybrid crosses Afghani and Sensi Star genetics.

name: Arjan's Strawberry Haze
parent_names: northern lights #5 haze kali mist swiss sativa
abstract: Strawberry Haze is characterized by it's strawberry smell and sweet taste. It has a THC level up to 20% and CBD level of approximately 1.2%.

name: Arjan's Ultra Haze #1
abstract: Arjan’s Ultra Haze #1 is a Dutch sativa bred by Green House Seeds, who combined Neville’s Haze with landrace strains from Cambodia and Laos.

name: Armageddon
abstract: Armageddon is a hybrid cannabis strain of unknown genetics that has multi-colored buds, a forest smell, and potent sativa effects.

name: Armagnac
abstract: Armagnac, bred by New House Seeds, is a hybrid that combines Krome’s The White with DJ Short’s Grape Kush.

name: Ash
abstract: Ash is a hybrid cross between Afghan Haze and Afghan Skunk bred by Mr. Nice Seeds.

name: Asian Fantasy
abstract:
Asian Fantasy is a rarer strain of cannabis that is known for its upbeat, creative high and spicy 
aroma.

name: Aspen OG
abstract: Aspen OG by 303 Seeds is a testament to how rich the Rocky’s cannabis heritage really is. This Sour Cream and SFV OG cross “is sweet like Aspen in the summer and coated white like Aspen in the winter,”

name: Astroboy
abstract: Astroboy is an energetic, sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain that combines Apollo 13 genetics with a cross of Ortega and Cinderella 99 bred by TGA Subcool Seeds.

name: Athabasca
abstract: Athabasca is a variety of the strain Pennywise grown by Canadian LP Aphria.

name: Atmosphere
abstract: Atmosphere is a balanced hybrid cross between White Widow and OG Kush.

name: Atomic Goat
abstract: Atomic Goat is a cross between Golden Goat and Chernobyl that induces deep relaxation of the mind and body.

name: Atomic Northern Lights
abstract: With a three-time Cannabis Cup-winning parent, Atomic Northern Lights will give you a mind/body sensation with uplifting effects.

name: Atomical Haze
abstract: Atomical Haze is an 80/20 sativa-dominant strain bred by Paradise Seeds.

name: Aurora Borealis
abstract: Also known as A-B, Aurora B, or simply Aurora, Aurora Borealis is an indica-heavy cross that combines Northern Lights #10 with Skunk #1.

name: Aurora Indica
abstract: Aurora Indica, bred by Nirvana Seeds, is a 90% indica cross between Afghan and Northern Lights.

name: Avalon
abstract: A selectively bred cross between Afghani and Blueberry.  Avalon has strong sedating effects with a hashy taste.

name: Avi
abstract: Avi is a high-CBD strain grown by Canadian LP Peace Naturals Project, Inc. It is a balanced hybrid, 50% indica and 50% sativa, with a 2:1 CBD:THC ratio.

name: Avi-Dekel
abstract: Avi-Dekel is a sativa-dominant strain developed by Tikun Olam to contain high levels of CBD and almost no THC.

name: Azure Haze
abstract: Azure Haze presents a fruity palette of terpenes and an upbeat, long-lasting high that slowly gives way to deep, dreamy relaxation.

name: B-52
abstract: B-52 is a 75/25 indica-dominant cross between Skunk and Big Bud. This Skunk #1 hybrid by Nirvana Seeds is a sweet mix of skunky flavors that have remarkable cerebral effects for a strain that leans towards the indica end of the spectrum.

name: B-Witched
abstract: B-Witched by Ocean Grown Seeds is a magical cross of arcane genetics. By combining OGS Wizard’s Potion and the famous Witches Weed, a frosted herbaceous phantasm is brought to life, exhibiting notes of grape, forest floor, and grapefruit.

name: B-Witched
abstract: B-Witched by Ocean Grown Seeds is a magical cross of arcane genetics. By combining OGS Wizard’s Potion and the famous Witches Weed, a frosted herbaceous phantasm is brought to life, exhibiting notes of grape, forest floor, and grapefruit.

name: B.B. King
abstract: B.B. King, named in honor of the Blues musician and songwriter, is an indica-dominant strain that crosses Blackberry Kush and Space Monster.

name: B4
abstract: B4, bred by MTG Seeds, is a hybrid cannabis strain that descends from Blue Dream and Chemdawg 4.

name: BC Big Bud
abstract: A cousin to the indica-dominant Big Bud cannabis strain from Amsterdam, BC Big Bud is a mostly sativa hybrid with potent cerebral effects.

name: BC Roadkill
abstract: BC Roadkill is a strain that originated in Canada and provides balanced, relaxing body effects with a euphoric head high.

name: BC Sweet Tooth
abstract: BC Sweet Tooth is an indica-dominant strain of cannabis that flowers quickly and is known for its sweet smell and taste.

name: BOG Bubble
abstract: BOG Bubble is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by B.O.G. Seeds.

name: BSC
abstract: BSC is a hybrid cannabis strain that follows in the footsteps of its Girl Scout Cookies parent with potent effects that hug the mind and body in tranquil euphoria.

name: Bakerstreet
abstract: Bakerstreet is a variety of Hindu Kush grown by Canadian LP Tweed. It is a pure indica with origins in the Hindu Kush mountain range.

name: Balmoral
abstract: Balmoral is a variety of UK Cheese grown by Canadian LP Tweed, Inc. It carries the classic skunky blue cheese aroma that has given the Cheese strains their global reputation.

name: Banana Diesel
abstract: Banana Diesel is a sativa-dominant hybrid that inherits energizing effects and a sweet, tangy aroma from its parent strains Banana Kush and Super Sour Diesel.

name: Banana Kush
abstract: Banana Kush has a slight but pleasant banana scent and flavor.  This balanced hybrid provides a very nice, strong full body stone with uplifting cerebral effects.

name: Banana OG
abstract: Banana OG is an indica-dominant cross between OG Kush and Banana.

name: Banana Peel
abstract: Banana Peel is a hybrid cannabis strain bred by Illuminati Seeds that descends from Banana OG and Pestilence.

name: Bananas
abstract: Bananas is a sweet-smelling hybrid strain that offers energizing cerebral effects to fuel creativity.

name: Bandana
abstract: Bandana is a hybrid strain that combines Banana OG and 707 Headband, inheriting from its parents a sweet banana aroma and the buzzing cerebral sensation that first lent Headband its name.

name: Bango
parent_names: white fire alien og mango kush
abstract: Bango is a hybrid strain with a rich terpene profile and tropical flavors worth sharing. This hybrid is a combination of White Fire Alien OG and Mango Kush, exhibiting subtle hints of each on the nose and palate.

name: Barbara Bud
abstract: Barbara Bud is powerful indica strain that eliminates symptoms without too much mental cloudiness.

name: Batgirl
abstract: Batgirl is a sativa-dominant hybrid with beautiful effects. This Jack’s Cleaner and Blueberry cross brings out a unique and pleasant aroma of sweet berry and spicy chemicals. The strain’s hybrid effects express themselves as a heady euphoria that uplifts the mind while gently coating the body in calming haze.

name: Batman OG
abstract: Batman OG, named for the Caped Crusader of the DC Universe, is a potent indica that hits the body like POW! This knockout strain binds the consumer to the couch and offers relaxing physical effects that are calming and sedative. Batman OG has deep earthy notes intermixed with scents of skunk and pine.

name: Bay 11
abstract: Grand Daddy Purp’s Bay 11 is a potent sativa strain used by patients to treat pain, sleeplessness, and appetite loss.

name: Bay Dream
abstract: Bay Dream by Granddaddy Purp is a sativa cross between Blue Dream and Bay 11 that provides patients relief from appetite loss.

name: Beastmode 2.0
abstract: Beast Mode 2.0, also known as BlueFire OG, is an indica-dominant hybrid of Master Kush and White Fire OG. It is a proprietary strain distributed by Green Umbrella in Seattle, and bred by Grass Roots Pharm.

name: Beastmode OG
abstract: Beast Mode OG is a proprietary strain of cannabis distributed by Green Umbrella, a Seattle-based delivery service. When the grower, Zion Gardens, first received the strain they believed it was a Girl Scout Cookies cut, but after growing it out it became apparent that this strain was either an exceptional phenotype of OG Kush or it was an OG-dominant hybrid of some kind.

name: Bedica
abstract: Bedica is a strain produced by Canadian LP Bedrocan. It is a heavy indica with an average THC content of around 14%.

name: Belladonna
abstract: Belladonna is a mostly sativa strain that also carries good indica characteristics making for a very nice hybrid.

name: Berkeley
abstract: Berkeley is a high-THC strain rumored to have been bred by a student of the University of California Berkeley campus. It has active effects and flowers quickly.

name: Berry Bomb
abstract: Berry Bomb is a hybrid cross between Blueberry and Bomb #1 that shows off its indica-leaning genetics through powerful sedation.

name: Big Band
abstract: Big Band was created to stabilize the delicious flavor of Bubble Gum with a strong, heavy yielding plant. Chronic, this strain’s second parent, grows massive colas with generous resin production and hybridized sativa effects, making it a natural compliment to Bubble Gum’s indica-dominant qualities.

name: Big Skunk Korean
abstract: Big Skunk Korean is supposedly a mix of Big Bud, Skunk #1, and Korean genetics originating in the western U.S., possibly Oregon, though it is unclear when it was created and by whom.

name: Big Sky OG
abstract: Big Sky OG from Elemental Seeds is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Big Sur Holy Bud
abstract: Big Sur Holy Bud is a sativa bred by Bodhi Seeds.

name: Big White
abstract: Big White is an indica-dominant hybrid that combines The White with Big Bud genetics. Bred by La Plata Labs, this strain began as an F1 hybrid created by Eclectic Genetics. La Plata Labs then refined and stabilized the genetics through generations of breeding and phenotype selection. This strain is known to produce large yields of sweet, sugary buds that express themselves in a variety of colors and carry a unique maple syrup flavor.

name: Big Wreck
abstract: Indica-dominant hybrid will slow down time but leave your reflexes in tact.

name: Biker Le’Blanc
abstract: A sativa-dominant hybrid rarely found nowadays, Biker Le’Blanc is a dense and resinous strain that combines Raskal’s The White with Hell’s Angel OG (Biker Kush cut).

name: Bio-Diesel
parent_names: sour diesel sensi star nyc diesel
abstract: Bio-Diesel is a true cannabis hybrid strain that took 1st place in the 2nd Annual Colorado Medical Marijuana Harvest Cup.

name: Bio-Jesus
abstract: Bio-Jesus is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain that provides heavy body effects and reliable pain relief.

name: Biochem
abstract: Biochem is the sedating cross of Chemdawg 4 and Sensi Star. This indica-dominant strain offers patients a weighted relaxation with a gentle headiness that infuses the body with a soft and soothing haze. Enjoy Biochem in the evening, as its effects naturally sedate.

name: Birds Eye
abstract: Birds Eye is a variety of Jack Herer grown by Canadian LP Tweed, Inc. Its flavors mirror the invigorating mix of sweet citrus and spicy pine that many associate with Jack Herer.

name: Birthday Cake Kush
abstract: Birthday Cake Kush, or just Birthday Cake, is an indica-dominant hybrid with strong body effects and sweet cake-like flavor.

name: Black '84
abstract: Black ’84, also known as UW Black ’84, is one of a few elusive strains that managed to escape from the medical cannabis garden at the University of Washington in the early and mid-1980s.

name: Black Betty
abstract: Black Betty is a long-lasting sativa-dominant hybrid that stems from East Coast Sour Diesel and AK-47 genetics.

name: Black Bubba
abstract: Black Bubba is an indica-dominant cross of Bubba Kush and Black Russian. The resulting buds carry a sweet aroma with subtle fruit notes that produce earthy flavors of hash and pine.

name: Black Cherry Soda
abstract: Black Cherry Soda by TGA Genetics is an indica cannabis strain named after its fruity, soda-like taste and unusually dark purple color.

name: Black Dahlia

name: Black Diamond

name: Black Diesel
abstract: Multiple Cannabis Cup winner Black Diesel is a tried-and-true cannabis sativa strain with dense, purple flowers and well-balanced effects.

name: Black Haze

name: Black Ice
abstract: A cross between Black Domina and Ice, Black Ice is an indica-dominant cannabis hybrid known for its impressive potency.

name: Black Jack
abstract: Black Jack is a marijuana strain that produces hard buds with huge, grape-like calyxes that are completely encrusted with THC.

name: Black Label Kush
abstract: Black Label Kush is a lesser-known cannabis strain but delivers a classic indica experience with long and heavy physical effects.

name: Black Lime Special Reserve
abstract: From Aficionado Seeds comes Black Lime Special Reserve, an indica strain that descends from Woodman Canyon Oil Can, Lime Afghani, Northern Lights, Purple Kush, and Chemdawg Special Reserve.

name: Black Magic Kush
abstract: Black Magic Kush (also known simply as Black Magic) is an indica-dominant strain with mysterious and arcane genetics. With jade green foliage and bright orange pistils, Black Magic Kush looks nearly as good as it tastes.

name: Black Mamba
abstract: Black Mamba is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that is known for its perfume aroma, grape taste, and long-lasting effects.

name: Black Russian
abstract: Black Russian is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain bred by Delicious Seeds, who created this strain by crossing a Black Domina mother with White Russian.

name: Black Tuna
abstract: Black Tuna is a cannabis strain native to British Columbia's 5 Star Organic that is known for its strong smell and potent narcotic effects.

name: Black Velvet
abstract: Child of indica Black and sativa Burmese Kush, Black Velvet is a potent but well-balanced hybrid optimal for intermediate to experienced patients.

name: Black Widow
abstract: An evenly balanced hybrid strain, Black Widow is the sister of White Widow and maintains the families reputation for high natural THC levels.

name: Blackberry
abstract: Blackberry is a cannabis strain that is quickly growing in popularity due to its active effects. As a plant, Blackberry is a picky grower.

name: Blackberry Bubble
abstract: Blackberry Bubble is exclusively produced by Arizona Natural Selections, and is the delectable cross of Sour Bubble and Blackberry Kush. This 80/20 indica-dominant strain offers pain relief and mental ease without anchoring the consumer to the couch.

name: Blackberry Chem OG
abstract: Blackberry Chem OG is a hybrid strain that combines the fruity, mid-level sedation of Blackberry with the gently stimulating but overall subdued Chemdawg. This strain’s unique aroma of tart chemicals and sweet fruit makes it a favorite for consumers with diverse palates.

name: Blackberry Cream
abstract: Blackberry Cream from Exotic Genetix combines the sweet berry terpenes of Blackberry Kush with the smooth creamy notes of Cookies and Cream.

name: Blackberry Diesel
abstract: Blackberry Diesel is an 80/20 sativa-dominant cross between East Coast Sour Diesel and Plushberry.

name: Blackberry Hashplant
abstract: Blackberry Hashplant is the child of strains Blackberry Kush and Hashplant Haze and delivers both cerebral and physical effects.

name: Blackberry Haze
abstract: Blackberry Haze, developed by Nebu Hybridz, is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Blackberry and Lime Haze.

name: Blackberry Kush
abstract: Blackberry Kush is an indica dominant cannabis strain that is a mix of Afghani and Blackberry strains. Medicinally, it is often used for pain relief.

name: Blackberry Lime Haze
abstract: Blackberry Lime Haze is a 90% sativa cross between Blackberry and Lime Haze with a sweet, spicy flavor and clear-headed effects.

name: Blackberry Pie
abstract: Blackberry Pie is a hybrid cross of Jojorizo’s Blackberry Widow and a Crystal Locomotive created by Gage Green Genetics.

name: Blackberry Rhino
abstract: Blackberry Rhino, also called Blackberry White, is a berry-flavored indica strain that combines Blackberry and White Rhino.

name: Blackberry Trainwreck
abstract: Blackberry Trainwreck, or Blackberry Wreck, is a hybrid strain parented by two notable varieties, Blackberry Kush and Trainwreck.

name: Blackberry x Blueberry
abstract: This dense crystal-covered indica strain by LivWell is a mix of Blackberry and DJ Short’s Blueberry.

name: Blackwater
abstract: Blackwater is an indica strain typically bred from Mendo Purps and San Fernando Valley OG Kush.

name: Blaze
abstract: British Columbia Seed Company crossed the indica Blueberry with Haze in order to tame this lanky, long-flowering Blaze.

name: Blissful Wizard
abstract: Blissful Wizard by The Captain’s Connection is a potent hybrid strain that crosses Captain's Cookies and Girl Scout Cookies in a decadent fusion of lemon, lime, and cream flavors.

name: Blob OG
abstract: Blob OG is supposedly a strain that originated in Western Washington. This heavy hitting, body-driven strain incorporates the stimulating mental elements of Diesel crossed against the potent indica-dominant genetics of Pre-99 Chemdawg.

name: Blockhead
abstract: Blockhead is an indica-dominant hybrid whose powerful physical and psychoactive effects are well-suited for experienced cannabis connoisseurs.

name: Bloo's Kloos
abstract: Bloo’s Kloos is a playful indica with a carefree buzz that encourages laughter. This three-way cross of Larry OG, Blueberry, and Northern Lights imbues Bloo's with earthy and fruity terpenes that turn sweet when consumed.

name: Bloodhound
abstract: Bloodhound is the obscure cross of Huckleberry Hound and Guard Dawg (by RedEyed Genetics). This genetic coupling was motivated by the desire to preserve the beautiful foliage and tartness of Huckleberry Hound while co-opting Guard Dawg’s potency.

name: Blowfish
abstract: Blowfish is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Dutch Flowers.

name: Blucifer
abstract: Blucifer is a blue-ish purple sativa strain that radiates with the smell of blueberries and cream with a spicy finish.

name: Blue Afghani
abstract: Bred by Jordan of the Islands in Canada, Blue Afghani is an indica-dominant strain that combines genetics from Blueberry and Afghani.

name: Blue Alien
abstract: Blue Alien is powerful, sweet-smelling indica stain that combines genetics from Blueberry and Alien Kush.

name: Blue Bastard
abstract: Blue Bastard is an indica-dominant hybrid that produces relaxing physical effects without the sedation.

name: Blue Bayou
abstract: Blue Bayou is a piercing sativa cannabis strain, providing patients with a psychoactive experience that opens the mind.

name: Blue Blood
abstract: Blue Blood from breeder Medicann is an indica-dominant cross of OG Kush and Blueberry. It carries on the potent legacy of OG Kush genetics and adds a sweet berry flavor to the pine and diesel undertones.

name: Blue Boy
abstract: Blue Boy is a cross of popular favorites Blue Dream and Northern Lights #5 that provides focused, uplifting effects.

name: Blue Champagne
abstract: A descendent from the famous Blue Dream, Blue Champagne is a sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid optimal for active, daytime consumption.

name: Blue Cheese
abstract: The Blue Cheese medical cannabis strain is a hybrid cross between Blueberry and UK Cheese.  It's a smooth strain with euphoric and psychedelic effects.

name: Blue Cinex
abstract: Blue Cinex is the stimulating love child of Blue Dream and Cinex. This creeper lays into the mind from the first puff and expands outward within 15 minutes after inhalation. Offering longevity and potency, Blue Cinex is a perfect partner for long days on your feet or sustained physical activity.

name: Blue Cookies
abstract: Blue Cookies is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between two celebrity strains, Girl Scout Cookies and Blueberry.

name: Blue Crack
abstract: Blue Crack is a sativa-dominant hybrid that takes after its iconic parents, Blue Dream and Green Crack. It yields a favored daytime medication.

name: Blue Diamond
abstract: Blue Diamond is a sativa-leaning hybrid of Diamond OG and Blue Dream with strong stress-relieving effects.

name: Blue Diesel
abstract: Daughter of prominent strains Blueberry and NYC Diesel, Blue Diesel is a slightly indica cannabis strain with relaxing effects.

name: Blue Dot
abstract: Blue Dot is an 80% sativa strain from Sonoma, CA bred from White Widow, Skunk, Big Bud, and Northern Light # 5.

name: Blue Dragon
abstract: Blue Dragon is usually so dark purple that it looks black.  This weed has aromatic hints of fruity pebbles and grapes.

name: Blue Dream
abstract: Blue Dream, a sativa-dominant hybrid originating in California, has achieved legendary status among West Coast strains.

name: Blue Dynamite
abstract: Blue Dynamite, bred by Next Generation Seeds in Canada, is an indica-dominant strain that provides heavy mind-and-body relaxation alongside a fruity, hashy flavor.

name: Blue Frost
abstract: Blue Frost is a hybrid that balances the genetics of Blue Monster and Jack Frost to create a 60/40 indica-dominant cross.

name: Blue Galaxy
abstract: Blue Galaxy is a classic combo of Middle Eastern genetics bred for their potency and resin production. With Afghani and Hashplant Haze parentage, this strain imbues the consumer with a metric ton of muscular weight and a hazy but pleasant mental state.

name: Blue God
abstract: Blue God, bred by Jordan of the Islands in Canada, is a powerful indica mothered by God Bud and Blueberry.

name: Blue Goo
abstract: Crossed between famous hybrid Blue Dream and indica Afgoo, Blue Goo is a steady, slightly sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain.

name: Blue Hash
abstract: The aroma is a mixture of fresh berries with a pungent, earthy finish. Blue Hash produces a powerfully relaxing effect that is a great way to unwind at the end of a long day or at night before bedtime.

name: Blue Hawaiian
abstract: Blue Hawaiian is a hybrid cannabis strain that produces light green to red-orange flowers and gives a balanced physical and mental high.

name: Blue Haze
abstract: The favored Blue Haze is a slightly sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid strain whose strength lies in its versatility.

name: Blue Heron
abstract: Blue Heron is an indica-dominant strain bred by Dynasty Seeds that brings euphoric flight to both mind and body.

name: Blue Ivy
abstract: Named after the newborn child of musicians Jay-Z and Beyonce, Blue Ivy is a hybrid cannabis strains whose effects are clearly indica-dominant and of impressive potency, with favorable blueberry undertones.

name: Blue Jay Way
abstract: Blue Jay Way by Matrix NV is the hybrid cross of True Blueberry and OG Kush. This fruity combination incorporates the best of Blueberry’s sweet relaxation with OG Kush’s well-known sedation to create a strain that is fun and euphoric while offering medicinal benefits for patients suffering from nausea, restlessness, and chronic pain.

name: Blue Kiss
abstract: DJ Short Blueberry and Mistress OG come together to form the potent indica-dominant hybrid strain known as Blue Kiss. Seductive and sweet, Blue Kiss elicits relaxation and anti-anxiety effects.

name: Blue Knight
abstract: Blue Knight is a rare indica-dominant strain with a noble lineage that stems from Blueberry and Kryptonite genetics.

name: Blue Kripple
parent_names: blue rhino big bud medicine man
abstract: Blue Kripple is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Dr. Krippling. This strain brings together the relaxing, therapeutic properties of Medicine Man and Blue Rhino, while the influence of Big Bud enhances Blue Kripple with dense, oversized colas and large yields.

name: Blue Kush
abstract: Blue Kush, a sativa-dominant hybrid, combines the sweet berry flavors of Blueberry with the powerful and pungent OG Kush.

name: Blue Lights
abstract: Daughter of eminent strains Blueberry and Northern Lights, Blue Lights is an indica-dominant cannabis hybrid with a noteworthy THC content.

name: Blue Magic
abstract: Blue Magic is an upbeat sativa-dominant strain bred from the famous Blue Dream.

name: Blue Magoo
abstract: Blue Magoo is a clone-only hybrid cross between DJ Short Blueberry and Major League Bud with heavy indica effects and a fruity, berry smell.

name: Blue Monster
abstract: Blue Monster is a powerful combination of G13, Blueberry, Northern Lights #5, and a Mexican landrace strain. Bred by Goldenseed, Blue Monster combines a sweet mix of flavors with strong indica effects.

name: Blue Moon Rocks
abstract: Blue Moon Rocks by BOG Seeds is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Blue Moon and BOGBubble.

name: Blue Moonshine
abstract: A DJ Short creation, Blue Moonshine is a very potent blueberry indica strain that provides a nice body high.

name: Blue Mountain Fire
abstract: A sativa strain with Jamaican roots, Blue Mountain Fire is an invigorating, upbeat variety that coerces creativity and happy mindsets.

name: Blue Mystic
abstract: Blue Mystic is a cannabis strain of mysterious origins, with unique blue coloring and a low odor that makes it ideal for indoor growers.

name: Blue Nightmare
abstract: Blue Nightmare bred by RNM Flowers is a resinous, berry-flavored hybrid cross between Blue Dream and Tahoe OG.

name: Blue Nina
abstract: Blue Nina is one of Colorado Seed Inc.’s excellent Blue Dream crosses. This sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Blue Dream and Nina Limone offers energetic effects and complicated fruity flavors.

name: Blue OG
abstract: Blue OG from G13 Labs is a flavorful hybrid following the lineage of Blueberry F3, Blue Moonshine, and OG Kush.

name: Blue Ox
abstract: Blue Ox by Rare Dankness Seeds is a berry-rich version of their Stone Mountain strain. By combining classic Blueberry with The OX, Rare Dankness created a sweet, well-rounded strain with aromas of blueberry, coffee, chocolate, and earthy spice.

name: Blue Persuasion
abstract: Blue Persuasion, bred by BUDS Pasco in Washington, is an indica-dominant strain composed of Blueberry, Northern Lights, and White Widow genetics.

name: Blue Power
parent_names: master kush the white blue moonshine
abstract: The indica-dominant Blue Power is one of Sin City Seeds’ signature strains, bred from Sour Double, Master Kush, The White, and Blue Moonshine genetics.

name: Blue Rhino
abstract: Blue Rhino is a cannabis strain that produces especially large flowers and boasts both high THC and CBD content.

name: Blue Satellite
abstract: Blue Satellite, the sativa offspring of Blueberry Sativa and Shishkaberry, is a strongly psychoactive strain with long-lasting effects.

name: Blue Sky
abstract: Blue Sky is the sweet, candy-flavored offspring of LSD and Rocky Mountain Blueberry

name: Blue Thai
abstract: Blue Thai by Dinafem Seeds is a hybrid strain from the Netherlands that crosses Blueberry and Thai Skunk.

name: Blue Trainwreck
abstract: Blue Train is a marijuana strain with famous genetics that provides happy head effects.

name: Blue Trane
abstract: Blue Trane is a cut with a mysterious heritage. These seeds were acquired while Colorado Seed Inc.’s head grower was cultivating strains in Hawaii and have since been stabilized and sown elsewhere.

name: Blue Treat
abstract: This short plant takes after its strong indica lineage, producing sticky resinous buds that can soothe your pain and relieve your stress.

name: Blue Velvet
abstract: Blue Velvet, also known as Blueberry Thai, is a 50/50 hybrid strain that is named for the lush appearance of its plants.

name: Blue Venom
abstract: Blue Venom, an intoxicating indica-dominant hybrid by G13 Labs, is a cross between the sweet-tasting Blueberry and potent White Widow.

name: Blue Widow
abstract: Blue Widow is a hybrid marijuana strain that is best for inducing relaxation. This strain has colorful flowers and a berry aroma.

name: Blue Wonder
abstract: Blue Wonder is a sativa-dominant hybrid originating from California as a distinct descendant of Blue Dream. Originally bred from Blueberry and Super Silver Haze, Blue Wonder exhibits a profound level of cerebral invigoration while maintaining a classic Blue Dream body buzz.

name: Blue Wreck
abstract: Blue Wreck, also called Blueberry Trainwreck, is a clear-headed hybrid strain primarily led by its sativa influence.

name: Blue Zombie
abstract: Blue Zombie (not to be confused with the Zombie strain lineage) is a full indica that boasts medical-grade potency and effects. With notes of fresh ground coffee, fuel, and skunky grape, this strain packs a surprising diverse array of terpenes.

name: Blueberry
abstract: Blueberry gets its name from its fruity smell and sweet blueberry taste. This strain is a favorite among seasoned smokers.

name: Blueberry AK
abstract: Blueberry AK is a hybrid strain that combines the indica-dominant Blueberry with the sativa-dominant AK-47, both popular and potent strains in their own right.

name: Blueberry Blast
abstract: A mostly sativa hybrid from Snow High Seeds, Blueberry Blast is a the result of the famous Blueberry-Haze genetics of Blue Dream being pollinated by a Johnny Blaze male.

name: Blueberry Cheesecake
abstract: Child of Blueberry and Big Buddha Cheese, Blueberry Cheesecake smells very much like it's name.

name: Blueberry Diesel
abstract: Blueberry Diesel is a cross of two favorite strains, Blueberry and Sour Diesel. It is best known for its strong blueberry aroma.

name: Blueberry Dream
abstract: Blueberry Dream is said to bring out your creativity while giving the mood a boost, all with the sweet flavor of ripe blueberries.

name: Blueberry Essence
abstract: Blueberry Essence is a high-CBD cannabis strain bred by Life Gardens in Washington.

name: Blueberry Haze
abstract: A cross between blueberry and haze.  Provides a happy and euphoric high when properly moderated.

name: Blueberry Headband
parent_names: blueberry emerald og pre-98 bubba kush
abstract: Blueberry Headband is a hybrid marijuana strain that's, quite appropriately, a cross between Blueberry and Headband. True to its name, this strain has a sweet blueberry taste and smell.

name: Blueberry Jack
abstract: A cross between the legendary Jack Herer and DJ Short Blueberry, Blueberry Jack has something special to offer in both flavor and effect.

name: Blueberry Kush
abstract: Blueberry Kush is an indica cannabis strain that has an earthy blueberry aroma due to its Blueberry and OG Kush genetics.

name: Blueberry Lambsbread
abstract: Blueberry Lambsbread is an uplifting hybrid strain that folds together genetics from Jamaican Lamb’s Bread and Blueberry.

name: Blueberry Muffins
abstract: Blueberry Muffins is the thoroughly baked indica-dominant hybrid of parent strains Afghani and Blueberry. The complimentary genetics make for a strong yet functional indica that exhibits a classic aroma of -- you guessed it -- blueberry muffins.

name: Blueberry OG
abstract: Blueberry OG is a DJ Short Blueberry phenotype with exceptional CBD yielding qualities combined with the indica-dominant legend, OG Kush. This potent, award-winning union doesn’t pack much in the way of psychoactivity, but its anti-anxiety and anti-inflammatory effects make up for any lack of headiness.

name: Blueberry Pancakes
abstract: Blueberry Pancakes is a delicious indica-dominant hybrid that miraculously tastes like blueberry pancakes. With dense, slightly purple buds, this strain exhibits an aroma of blueberries, grape, and dough.

name: Blueberry Pie
abstract: Blueberry Pie is the indica-dominant hybrid of two famous strains, Girl Scout Cookies and Blue Dream. Each strain in this potent cross has its own claim to fame, but when combined their unique attributes coalesce to form a strain greater than the sum of its parts.

name: Blueberry Silvertip
abstract: Blueberry Silvertip first took root in Big Sky Country when a Montana Silvertip plant was crossed with the famous indica Blueberry.

name: Blueberry Skunk
abstract: Blueberry Skunk is an indica-dominant hybrid of Blueberry and Skunk #1 genetics. It has a reputation for being potent, flavorful, and relatively easy to grow.

name: Blueberry Waltz
abstract: Blueberry Waltz is an indica-dominant strain that took first place in the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup’s solventless hash category.

name: Blueberry Yum Yum
abstract: Blueberry Yum Yum is a flavorful, uplifting hybrid strain whose popularity was ushered in by rap artist Ludacris and his song centered on the strain.

name: Blues
abstract: Blues, also known as “Livers,” is a famous hybrid strain in the U.K.

name: Blukashima
abstract: Using a Chernobyl male plant to pollenate their Blue Dream cut, Terraform Genetics created Blukashima.

name: Bluniverse
abstract: Bluniverse, also called Blue Universe, is a 50/50 hybrid strain bred by Dynasty Seeds.

name: Blurple
abstract: Blurple, also known as Blue Dream Purple, is a balanced hybrid cross between Blue Dream and Mendocino Purps.

name: Bob Saget
abstract: Bob Saget is a stimulating sativa that won 2nd place at the 2016 Colorado Cannabis Cup. This addled comedian gets the heart pumping, stimulating the consumer to the point of agitation. But fear not, the energy subsides and settles into an uplifted, cerebral haze that is lucid, yet spacey.

name: Bogart
abstract: Bogart is a rendition of OG Kush distributed by Canadian LP Tweed that delivers hefty euphoric effects suitable for consumers with a high cannabis tolerance.

name: Boggle Gum
abstract: Boggle Gum is a relaxing hybrid cross between Northern Lights #5 and BOG Bubble.

name: Booger
abstract: Booger combines Strawberry Cough with Bubba Kush to create a balanced effect that walks the line between physical relaxation and cerebral energy.

name: Bootlegger
abstract: Bootlegger is a potent cross of AK-47 and Rugburn OG from Rare Dankness Seeds.

name: Bordello
abstract: Bordello is a hybrid marijuana strain that provides strong pain relief properties, but may not be ideal for mental focus.

name: Boss Hogg
abstract: Boss Hogg by Cali Connection is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between two early classics, Chemdawg 91 and Pre-98 Bubba Kush.

name: Brains Damage
abstract: Bred by KC Brains in Holland, Brains Damage is a hybrid cross between Acapulco Mexican, Mango, Hawaiian, and KC 36.

name: Brainstorm Haze
parent_names: thai haze sensi star warlock ak-47
abstract: Brainstorm Haze is a dominantly Sativa cannabis strain. The plants are known for high yields, dense buds, and a fruity and floral taste.

name: Brand X
abstract: Brand X, also known as The Ostipow Indica, is a decades-old heirloom strain that hails from Michigan.

name: Brian Berry Cough
abstract: Brian Berry Cough from TGA Genetics is a balanced 50/50 hybrid strain that crosses Strawberry Cough and Space Queen.

name: Broke Diesel
abstract: Broke Diesel is a 50/50 hybrid marijuana strain with exceptionally strong psychoactivity that many cannabis connoisseurs seek out.

name: Bronze Whaler
abstract: An 80/20 indica-dominant strain bred in Australia, Bronze Whaler gives off the sweet smell of fruit with distinct tropical overtones.

name: Brooklyn Mango
parent_names: ed rosenthal super bud nyc diesel
abstract: Brooklyn Mango, bred by Dr. Underground, is a hybrid that combines Ed Rosenthal Super Bud with NYC Diesel. The resulting buds carry a mix of diesel and tropical fruit flavors, like pineapple, mango, and lemon.

name: Bruce Banner
abstract: Bruce Banner is a hybrid cannabis cross of OG Kush and Strawberry Diesel. This potent strain has euphoric and creative effects.

name: Bruce Banner #3
abstract: Bruce Banner #3 is one of the three main versions of the Bruce Banner cannabis strain. It gives consumers uplifting effects and potent stress reduction.

name: Bubba Doja
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush double purple doja
abstract: Bubba Doja by Quest Genetics is a heavy indica-dominant strain that combines the legendary Pre-98 Bubba Kush and the deep purple yield machine, Double Purple Doja.

name: Bubba Kush
abstract: Bubba Kush is a sweet, earthy indica strain with genetics that trace back to the Hindu Kush landrace strains.

name: Bubba OG
abstract: Great for relaxing, hanging out, and just enjoying life.

name: Bubba Tom Hayes
abstract: Bubba Tom Hayes is a hybrid that crosses Pre-98 Bubba Kush with a select Haze variety that was bred by Tom Hill. The hybrid tends to be Haze-dominant with a sweet, herb flavor that mixes with musky Kush undertones.

name: Bubba x Skunk
abstract: Old School Breeders Association crossed the original Bubba Kush clone with a reliable, true-breeding Skunk in an effort to speed up veg times, add height, and increase yields.

name: Bubba's Bitch
abstract: Bubba’s Bitch is a proprietary cross from Garrett Gardens out of Dewitt, Michigan. This indica-dominant hybrid is a lovingly handcrafted cross of Bubba Kush and 517 Headband, which was then backcrossed for stability and potency.

name: Bubba's Gift
abstract: Despite being almost purely indica, this cross between Bubba Kush and God’s Gift produces functional and uplifting effects with a mild body high.

name: Bubble Cheese
abstract: Bubble Cheese, bred by Big Buddha Seeds, is an 85% indica-dominant strain that brings in genetics from Cheese, Bubble Gum, and Hubba Bubba Kush.

name: Bubble Gum
abstract: Sweet and fruity smell and taste, truly resembling bubble gum.  Provides a euphoric high and has won four awards in the High Times Cannabis Cup.

name: Bubbleberry
abstract: Bubbleberry is a treat for cannabis consumers on either side of the indica-sativa divide. Combining the sweet, floral taste and aroma of Bubble Gum with the all-star fruity skunkiness of Blueberry, this strain has depth while remaining immensely palatable.

name: Bubblegum Kush
abstract: Bubblegum Kush is an 80% indica bred by Bulldog Seeds.

name: Bubblegun
abstract: Bubblegun is a hybrid marijuana strain that is often used to treat pain and insomnia. It’s a cross of Bubble Gum and AK-47.

name: Bubblicious
abstract: Refined in the Netherlands since the 1990s, Bubblicious captures the signature bubble gum flavor that first lent this hybrid widespread notoriety.

name: Buddha Haze
abstract: Buddha Haze is an 85% sativa strain bred by Big Buddha Seeds that induces energetic, clear-headed effects.

name: Buddha Tahoe
abstract: Buddha Tahoe is what you get when Big Buddha Seeds reverses Cali Connection’s Tahoe OG Kush to create their own rendition of this indica staple.

name: Buddha's Hand
abstract: Buddha’s Hand is a sativa-dominant strain that was bred by combining genetics from Lemon Thai and Snow Lotus.

name: Buddha's Sister
abstract: Buddha's sister has a flavor like a tart cherry candy and a scent to match. The effects are creative and cerebral.

name: Buffalo Bill
abstract: Buffalo Bill is a sativa-dominant cross between Willie’s Wonder and Killer Ken grown by Doc and Yeti’s in Washington state.

name: Bugatti OG
abstract: Bugatti OG is a hybrid strain that induces deep relaxation and intense cerebral stimulation that lifts the mind to faraway escapes from aches, pains, and stress.

name: Burkle
abstract: Burkle is indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Pre-98 Bubba Kush with Granddaddy Purple. The result is a powerfully relaxing indica that consumes the body with calming effects that ease away pain and induce sleep.

name: Burmese Kush
abstract: Burmese Kush marijuana is an indica dominant strain that has a piney aroma and a sweet aftertaste. It is known as a “creeper” high.

name: Butter OG
abstract: Butter OG is generally thought to be an indica-dominant strain as it gives consumers a very relaxing, giggly high that gradually fades to sleepiness.

name: Butterscotch
abstract: Butterscotch is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that owes its name to its candy-sweet aroma. It’s recommended for insomnia.

name: C13 Haze
abstract: C13 is one of the many strains in the DNA Genetics catalog. It's a hybrid crossed with Super Cannalope and G13 Haze.

name: C3
abstract: C3 is an indica-dominant cross between Chemdawg and a Lemon Thai-Pakistani hybrid, creating a stinky flower rich with earthy aromas.

name: C3PO
abstract: With the smell of fresh pine, C3PO delivers relaxing effects with mental clarity due to its high CBD content.

name: C4
abstract: An indica-leaning cross between Cotton Candy and Shiskaberry, C4 is known for its high yields and resin production that make it an excellent option for producing top-notch concentrates.

name: CBD Critical Cure
abstract: From Barney’s Farm comes CBD Critical Cure, an indica-dominant strain that’s said to combine Critical Kush with a ruderalis variety.

name: CBD Kush
abstract: From the collaborative efforts of CBD Crew and Dutch Passion comes CBD Kush, a hybrid strain with equal parts THC and CBD.

name: CBD Mango Haze
abstract: This pleasant and aromatic blend combines the tropical flavors of Mango Haze with the added benefits from high levels of cannabidiol.

name: CBD Shark
abstract: CBD Shark is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that offers an equal ratio of THC and CBD.

name: CHR Super OG
parent_names: skywalker og tahoe og kush larry og
abstract: A three-way cross between Skywalker OG, Tahoe OG Kush, and Larry OG, CHR Super OG is an indica strain that produces heavy effects that relax the mind and body.

name: Cabbage Patch
abstract: Cabbage Patch is a sativa-dominant hybrid that combines Cherry Pie and Durban Poison genetics.

name: Cactus
abstract: First bred by Jordan of the Islands, Cactus is an indica cross between Afghani and Northern Lights.

name: Cactus Cooler
abstract: Cactus Cooler is a sativa-dominant strain that’s said to be a cross between Blue Dream and OG Kush.

name: Cadillac Purple
parent_names: blackberry kush the black purple urkle
abstract: Cadillac Purple is a heavy indica strain that is popular among users seeking true body relaxation and pain relief without spacey cerebral effects.

name: Cali Gold
abstract: Cali gold is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that has a fresh citrus aroma and promotes relaxation among users.

name: Cali Jack
abstract: Cali Jack by Medicanna Seeds is a potent union of polar opposites. Jack Herer, the sativa-dominant king of clear-minded motivation, comes together with Pre-98 Bubba Kush, a classic West Coast indica dynamo with a heavy body and laidback demeanor, to form a strain with powerful and unique properties.

name: Cali Kush
abstract: Cali Kush is a popular hybrid cannabis strain out of California that produces large, dense flowers with a citrus and spice aroma.

name: California Grapefruit
abstract: California Grapefruit by DNA Genetics is an indica strain that draws from a palette of California-grown genetics: Northern Lights, Skunk #1, and Afghani.

name: California Hash Plant
abstract: California Hash Plant is a combination of two sister strains from the same Hash Plant mother. Offering a spicy, floral aroma, this endogamic cross weighs heavily on the limbs and mind, dissolving anxiety and encouraging rest.

name: California Orange
abstract: California Orange has a pronounced citrus aroma and flavor.  A 50/50 hybrid that produces very sticky and dense buds

name: California Sour
abstract: California Sour is an elusive hybrid strain bred from a Mexican sativa and Afghani indica.

name: Cambodian
abstract: Cambodian refers to any strain that grows natively in this region.

name: Cambodian Haze
abstract: This South East Asian spin on the classic Purple Haze will deliver a strong euphoric experience without exacerbating paranoia.

name: Candy Cane
abstract: Candy Cane is a 70% indica strain from Crop King Seeds that combines AK-47, Mango, and White Widow genetics.

name: Candy Jack
abstract: Candy Jack was the second place sativa winner at the first ever High Times Cannabis Cup in the U.S.

name: Candyland
parent_names: granddaddy purple platinum girl scout cookies
abstract: Candyland, a gold medalist of the 2012 KushCon, is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred from Granddaddy Purple and Bay Platinum Cookies.

name: Canna-Tsu
abstract: Canna-Tsu is a hybrid cannabis strain that combines genetics from two CBD-rich parents, Cannatonic and Sour Tsunami.

name: CannaSutra
abstract: CannaSutra by Delta 9 Labs is a 70/30 indica-dominant cannabis strain parented by Reclining Buddha and Sensi Star.

name: Cannadential
abstract: Grows like Cannalope, tastes like LA Confidential. This plant is the perfect mix of indica/sativa. Heavy buds and a fruity smell brought to us by those crazy geneticists from DNA Genetics.

name: Cannalope Haze
abstract: Almost a pure sativa that crosses Haze Brothers and a Mexican landrace, this strain is a great solution for fatigue and when struggling with appetite loss.

name: Cannalope Kush
abstract: Cannalope Kush from DNA Genetics mixes the powerful effects of OG #18 with the sweet fruity flavors of Cannalope Haze.

name: Cannatonic
abstract: Cannatonic is a hybrid cross with an MK Ultra mother and G13 Haze father.  Cannatonic has been known to have a nearly 1:1 ratio of THC & CBD.

name: Capers
abstract: Capers is a relaxing indica strain believed to have descended from Burmese Kush.

name: Captain America OG
abstract: Captain America OG is a sativa-leaning OG cut with uplifting euphoria and a bright citrus flavor. Relieving anxiety without the debilitating weight of heavier OG crosses, call on “The Captain” for relief of stress as well as nausea, mild physical pain, and muscle spasms.

name: Captain's Cake
parent_names: girl scout cookies white fire alien og
abstract: Captain’s Cake by The Captain’s Connection is a hybrid cross between Girl Scout Cookies and White Fire Alien OG. With bright citrus terpenes on the nose and palate, and a sweet doughy earth aroma, Captain’s Cake is a crowd-pleaser with enjoyable relaxing effects.

name: Caramel Candy Kush
abstract: Carmel Candy Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid of Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Ms. Universe bred by Dynasty Seeds.

name: Caramelicious
abstract: Caramelicious is a hybrid cannabis variety that has sticky buds and a caramel flavor.  A favorite after dinner smoke for some, provides a sweet taste and happy high.

name: Caramella
abstract: Caramella is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain recommended for late nights out with friends as it provides an uplifting and social high.

name: Caramelo
abstract: Caramelo is a 70/30 sativa-dominant hybrid derived from the Lavender family, inheriting that signature floral aroma with accents of sweet and spicy fruit.

name: Carl Sagan
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush blue moon rocks
abstract: Carl Sagan is an easy, relaxing cross between Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Bogs Blue Moon Rocks.

name: Cascadia Kush
abstract: Cascadia Kush is an 80/20 indica bred by Hesperides Gardens in Washington. It combines Alien Kush and Frankenstein genetics to create a powerhouse of relaxing, pain-relieving effects. Cascadia Kush took the award for Best Indica at the 2015 DOPE Cup in Seattle.

name: Casey Jones
parent_names: trainwreck thai east coast sour diesel
abstract: Casey Jones is a cross between Oriental Express (Trainwreck x Thai) and East Coast Sour Diesel that provides an earthy, sweet palate with subtle hints of citrus.

name: Casper OG
abstract: Casper OG is an indica-dominant strain with a unique history. By combining ThaDocta’s Face Off OG and ORGNKID’s Ghost OG, Casper OG (the friendliest OG you know) was brought into being from the great beyond.

name: Cat Piss
abstract: With a name like Cat Piss, this strain is actually quite sweet and sour tasting.

name: Cataract Kush
abstract: This is the combination of LA Confidential and OG Kush. This strain was created by DNA Genetics and it has blankets of crystals and looks almost grayish-black.

name: Catfish
abstract: Catfish is a sativa strain that took 1st place in the sativa category of High Times' 2014 Michigan Medical Cannabis Cup.

name: Cello Sweet OG
abstract: Colorado Seed Inc. pays homage to new school and old school genetics in Cello Sweet OG. This cross combines DJ Short’s Flo, a living cannabis virtuoso, and Secret Garden OG, CO Seed’s Kush bomb, to create a connoisseur-quality strain with potency and dimension.

name: Central American
abstract: Central American refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis  that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: Cerebro Haze
abstract: Cerebro Haze focuses its efforts in the head and provides a clean, clear buzz that allows you to stay active and functional.

name: Chairman Chem Sou
abstract: Chairman Chem Sou is another Chemdawg cross from Royal Choice Farms. This tart combination unites the ever-popular Chemdawg with Sour OG for a sour, spicy aroma and an equal measure of mental and physical effects.

name: Champagne Kush
abstract: Champagne Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid that offers a variety of attributes suited to different tastes and ailments. With a pleasant and palpable weight on the limbs coupled with a heady, thoughtful mind, this strain adapts to the consumer’s needs with dosage.

name: Charlie Sheen
parent_names: og kush green crack blue dream
abstract: Charlie Sheen is an indica-dominant hybrid, parented by Green Crack, OG Kush, and Blue Dream.

name: Charlotte's Web
abstract: Charlotte’s Web is a cultivar that has gained popularity as an option for treating seizures as well as a range of other medical conditions.

name: Cheese
abstract: Named for its sharply sour aroma, Cheese is an indica-dominant hybrid from the U.K. that has achieved widespread popularity for its unique flavor and consistent potency.

name: Cheese Candy
abstract: Cheese Candy by Delicious Seeds is the hybrid lovechild of Cheese and Caramelo, a genetic combination of parent strains that results in an unusual fusion of sweet candy and sharp cheese flavors.

name: Cheese Quake
abstract: Cheese Quake by TGA Subcool Seeds is a cross of Cheese and Querkle.

name: Cheeseburger
abstract: Cheeseburger by Cannasol Farms (of Omak, Washington) is a deep, sumptuous strain that leaves the consumer feeling satisfied, like a cheeseburger after a hard day’s work. With a long, mysterious heritage coming out of Okanogan, this indica-dominant strain was entrusted to Cannasol to ensure its wholesome genetics were preserved.

name: Cheesewreck
abstract: Cheesewreck is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Seedism Seeds that brings together the sour, flavorful taste of a Cheese hybrid with the staggering potency of Trainwreck.

name: Chem Crush
abstract: Chem Crush is a hybrid strain that took 2nd place in the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Chem D.O.G.
abstract: Chem D.O.G., not to be confused with Chemdawg, is a potent Chemdawg and OG Kush cross that harnesses the best qualities of either strain. With an expansive terpene profile that includes limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene, this strain has a spiced citrus nose with touches of chemical and earth.

name: Chem Jong Ill
abstract: Chem Jong Ill is a powerful hybrid by Colorado Seed Inc. that was bred using Chemdawg #4 and Gupta Kush genetics.

name: Chem Scout
abstract: Chem Scout from IC Collective is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Chem Valley Kush
abstract: Chem Valley Kush is a sativa-leaning hybrid cross between Chemdawg and SFV OG Kush bred by Cali Connection.

name: Chem's Sister
abstract: Chem’s Sister, also known as Chem Sis, is a sativa-dominant variation of the classic Chemdawg strain.

name: ChemWreck
abstract: ChemWreck is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Lionhart. The combination of Chemdawg and Trainwreck genetics gives way to a pungent aroma of diesel fumes that produces flavors of lemon, citrus, and pine.

name: Chemdawg
abstract: The parent of strains like Sour Diesel and OG Kush, Chemdawg is known for its distinct, diesel-like aroma.

name: Chemdawg #4 x Alien OG Kush
abstract: Chemdawg #4 x Alien OG Kush is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain offered exclusively by LivWell in Colorado.

name: Chemdawg 4
abstract: Chemdawg 4 is an indica-dominant strain that smells of Pine-Sol and tastes of lemon.

name: Chemdawg 91
abstract: Chemdawg 91 is thought to be an offshoot of the original Chemdawg strain, with similarly cerebral focused effects.

name: Chemdawg Sour Diesel
abstract: Chemdawg Sour Diesel from Reservoir Seeds is a hybrid cannabis strain that combines champion genetics from Chemdawg D and Sour Diesel.

name: Chemmy Jones
abstract: Chemmy Jones by Connoisseur Genetics is a hybrid strain that unites genetics from Chemdawg D and Casey Jones.

name: Chemo
abstract: Chemo is an indica-dominant strain best known for its subtle woody aroma and potent medicinal effects.

name: Chernobyl
abstract: Chernobyl is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that carries a unique lime sherbet smell.

name: Cherries Jubilee
abstract: Cherries Jubilee is a festive strain named for a dessert usually baked during Fall. This sweet strain has a light tartness on the nose, but the real cherry flavor comes out on the exhale. An indica-dominant hybrid, Cherries Jubilee starts off with an uplifting euphoria that turns hazy in the mind and heavy on the body.

name: Cherry AK-47
abstract: A cherry phenotype of AK-47, Cherry AK-47 has a THC level  of up to 16% and a cherry flavor.

name: Cherry Bomb
abstract: Cherry Bomb is a popular hybrid cannabis strain which provides mild to moderate effects that are appropriate for daytime consumption.

name: Cherry Cookies
abstract: Cherry Cookies is one of the most popular Girl Scout Cookie crosses to date, ranking next to Pink Cookies and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. With similar genetic parentage, Cherry Cookies derives from the blending of Cherry Pie (aka Cherry Kush) and Cookies F2.

name: Cherry Cream Pie
abstract: Cherry Cream Pie is the decadent indica-dominant hybrid offspring of Cherry Pie and Cookies & Cream. With pronounced OG undertones and hints of tartness and pine, Cherry Cream Pie’s terpene profile is half the experience.

name: Cherry Diesel
abstract: Cherry Diesel by MTG Seeds combines Cherry OG and Turbo Diesel into one sweet-smelling, uplifting hybrid strain.

name: Cherry Durban Poison
abstract: Cherry Durban Poison is a hybrid strain that brings a unique cherry flavor profile to the high-energy qualities of Durban Poison.

name: Cherry Grapefruit
abstract: Cherry Grapefruit is a super fruity sativa-dominant hybrid that brings out the best qualities of parent strains White Widow, Chemdawg, OG Kush, and Sour Diesel.

name: Cherry Kola
abstract: Cherry Kola is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Cherry Kush
abstract: A cross between Purple Afghani and OG Kush, Cherry Kush is a very potent indica-dominant hybrid that has become very popular with medical patients in the SF Bay Area.

name: Cherry Limeade
abstract: Cherry Limeade is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Cherry OG
abstract: Cherry OG by Emerald Triangle Seeds is a hybrid cannabis strain bred by combining Cherry Thai, Afghani, and Lost Coast OG genetics.

name: Cherry Pie
abstract: Cherry Pie smells and tastes just like a cherry pie. Its effects come on in minutes and stick around for a couple of hours.

name: Cherry Pie Kush
parent_names: durban poison granddaddy purple sfv og
abstract: Cherry Pie Kush (not to be confused with Cherry Pie) is essentially a Cherry Pie cross of Durban Poison and Granddaddy Purple, infused with the California native, San Fernando Valley OG. Some folks claim this strain came before Cherry Pie and others say it’s a product of Cookie Fam’s famous hybrid lineage.

name: Cherry Sauce
abstract: Cherry Sauce by Andromeda Strains is a delicious cross with diverse genetics. The offspring of parent strains Cherry Pie and The Sauce, Cherry Sauce offers complex nuances in flavor, aroma, and effect.

name: Cherry Sherbet
abstract: Cherry Sherbet is an indica-dominant delight. This stinky sweet herb is the genetic cross of Sour Sherbet and Cherry Pie.

name: Cherry Skunk
abstract: Cherry Skunk is an indica-dominant hybrid that combines genetics from Skunk Dawg and Poppa Cherry.

name: Cherry Thunder Fuck
parent_names: cherry bomb maple leaf indica matanuska thunder fuck
abstract: Cherry Thunder Fuck is an ultra-pungent strain with unique, long-lasting effects. Created by breeding a Cherry Bomb mother with a Maple Leaf Indica x Matanuska Thunder Fuck cross, Cherry Thunder Fuck offers an array of pungent, earthy aromas wrapped in the smell of overripe cherries.

name: Chiesel
abstract: Cheese and NYC Diesel come together to form the Chiesel cannabis variety.  Strong smell is to be expected considering its lineage, provides a euphoric and functional stone.

name: China Yunnan
abstract: China Yunnan is where deep indica relaxation meets the sweet, woody sativa varieties of South Asia.

name: Chiquita Banana
abstract: Chiquita Banana by Utoptia Farms takes the Banana OG cut to the next level, with an average THC percentage pushing 33%. A cross between parent strains OG Kush and Banana, Chiquita Banana leads with a potent heady sizzle (likely brought on by the enormous quantity of THC) which then melds into a Kush-esque body buzz that is relaxing but not sedative.

name: Chloe
abstract: Chloe is a powerful and mysterious sativa-dominant hybrid created by Chris Wren of Medizin, Las Vegas.

name: Chocolate Chunk
abstract: Chocolate Chunk by TH Seeds is a pure indica that will meld you with the couch.

name: Chocolate Diesel
abstract: Chocolate Diesel is a sativa cannabis strain that brings together genetics from the original Sour Diesel and Chocolate Thai.

name: Chocolate Fondue
abstract: Chocolate Fondue, bred by DNA Genetics, is a sativa-dominant cross that balances the uplifting effects of Chocolope with the relaxing effects and unique flavors of Exodus Cheese.

name: Chocolate Hashberry
abstract: Chocolate Hashberry is an aromatic strain with quality effects and beautiful foliage. With a smell indicative of its name, Chocolate Hashberry reeks of chocolate, hashy spice, and sweet berries.

name: Chocolate Kush
abstract: Chocolate Kush, bred by 00 Seeds, is a powerful indica strain that captures the best of its two parent strains.

name: Chocolate Kush
abstract: Chocolate Kush, bred by 00 Seeds, is a powerful indica strain that captures the best of its two parent strains.

name: Chocolate Thai
abstract: Chocolate Thai is a potent sativa bred by Dutch Flowers.

name: Chocolate Thunder
abstract: When you combine the sweet cocoa flavor of Chocolope with the strength and potency of Alaskan Thunder Fuck, you get none other than Chocolate Thunder.

name: Chocolope
abstract: Chocolope is a cross between OG Chocolate Thai & Cannalope Haze Cannabis varieties.

name: Chocolope Kush
abstract: With an aroma of vanilla and chocolate, Chocolope Kush brings on a cerebral and heavy high.

name: Chong Star
abstract: Chong Star, named in honor of Tommy Chong, is a hybrid strain that is cultivated and sold by Marisol Therapeutics in Pueblo, Colorado.

name: Chronic
abstract: Chronic is a balanced hybrid cross between Northern Lights, Skunk, and AK-47 originally bred by Serious Seeds in 1994.

name: Chronic Thunder
abstract: Chronic Thunder is an indica strain bred by Barney’s Farm that offers full-body effects alongside a funky diesel and spicy pepper aroma.

name: Chucky's Bride
abstract: Chucky’s Bride is a cross of Exodus Cheese and Cinderella 99 bred by Eskobar Seeds. This sativa-dominant hybrid gives off an exotic mixture of sharp flavors.

name: Chunky Diesel
abstract: Chunky Diesel by Cresco Labs is a West Coast rarity with classic roots. This combo of Deep Chunk (a robust indica straight out of 1970) and the ever-popular Sour Diesel creates a pleasantly motivating strain with a clear-headed mental state.

name: Chupacabra
abstract: Chupacabra looks like a sativa and acts like an indica. With tall, bright green buds that fray into even brighter orange hairs, this wild strain reeks of its Golden Goat heritage.

name: Church OG
abstract: Bred from God's Gift and OG Kush, Church OG provides a strong body sensation and has a THC level of up to 19%.

name: Cinderella 99
abstract: A cannabis sativa dominant strain that is popular among many long term weed smokers.  A good all around variety that us nice when hanging out with friends or just relaxing at home.

name: Cinderella's Dream
abstract: Cinderella’s Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid of Cinderella 99 and Blue Dream.

name: Cindy White
abstract: Cindy White is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Cinderella 99 and White Widow with uplifting effects that are ushered in by an earthy, floral aroma.

name: Cinex
abstract: Cinex is a cannabis sativa strain that is a cross of Cinderella 99 and Vortex strains.

name: Citrix
abstract: Citrix is a hybrid cannabis strain that draws its genetics from a flavorful Grapefruit mother and a heavy resin potential from an LA Confidential male.

name: Citrus Kush
abstract: Citrus Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that smells and tastes like a mix of citrus fruits.

name: Citrus Punch
abstract: Citrus Punch by Potbox is a tangy splash of bright citrus and good vibes. This sativa-dominant strain smells of ripening oranges and tangerines with notes of grapefruit and lime.

name: Citrus Sap
abstract: From Crockett Family Farms and DNA Genetics, Citrus Sap is a hybrid cross between Gorilla Glue #4 and Tangie.

name: Clementine
abstract: Clementine is a sweet, citrus flavored sativa hybrid that combines Tangie with Lemon Skunk genetics.

name: Clementine Kush
abstract: Clementine Kush is the lovechild of Tangerine Sunrise and Sanjay Gupta Kush bred by Colorado Seed Inc.

name: Clockwork Orange
abstract: Originally a clone-only hybrid and later released in seed form by breeders Riot Seeds, Clockwork Orange is thought to be some sort of G13/Black Widow cross.

name: Cloud 9
abstract: Cloud 9 began as a collaboration between Kiwiseeds and Dampkring Classics as an attempt to stabilize the classic clone-only strain NYC. Diesel.

name: Cluster Bomb
abstract: Cluster Bomb is an indca-dominant hybrid bred by Bomb Seeds. This strain takes the soaring sativa effects of Cinderella 99 and crosses them with Bomb #1, a proprietary strain that Bomb Seeds uses to influence their genetics. This blend is then crossed with original Skunk #1 genetics from Sensi Seeds to give us Cluster Bomb.

name: Cold Creek Kush
abstract: Cold Creek Kush is an award-winning indica-dominant hybrid cross of MK Ultra and Chem-91. It has a pleasant pine and sour aroma.

name: Colombian Gold
abstract: Colombian Gold is a classic Colombian landrace sativa that induces alert, functional effects with a sweet citrus aroma.

name: Colorado Bubba
abstract: Colorado Bubba from Vault Genetics took 1st place in High Times' 2014 Amsterdam Cannabis Cup in the "Best Indica" category.

name: Colorado Chem
abstract: Colorado Chem is a hybrid strain that took 2nd place in the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Colorado Clementines
abstract: New from La Plata Labs, Colorado Clementines is a 70% indica-dominant  hybrid with odor and yields that are off the charts.

name: Concord Grape Blockhead
abstract: Concord Grape Blockhead is a complex Blockhead phenotype developed by Spice of Life Seeds. This plant is the offspring of Project 19 (an unknown African hybrid) and Sweet Tooth #3, resulting in a stalky structure with dense clusters of sparkling purple buds.

name: Confidential Cheese
abstract: Confidential Cheese by DNA Genetics is a crossbred indica hybrid of Exodus Cheese and LA Confidential.

name: Confidential Wreck
abstract: Confidential Wreck, also known as Lohan, is the humorous, if not totally common sense cross of LA Confidential and Trainwreck. This plant grows to a medium height and produces dense, light green nuggets that smell of earth, pine, and citrus.

name: Connie Chung
abstract: The parents of this strain speak for themselves...the classic LA flavor crossed with the old school G13 Haze.

name: Conspiracy Kush
abstract: Conspiracy Kush by Heroes of the Farm Genetics is a 70/30 indica-dominant cross of Obama Kush and Space Queen.

name: Cookie Dough
abstract: Cookie Dough is a wonderfully potent Girl Scout Cookies phenotype. This particular version of the West Coast’s most popular strain exhibits an orange/yellowish sheen of trichomes and a pungent doughy aroma. Cookie Dough’s effects align closely with GSC’s, offering medical-grade sedation on the body and a well-lit mind that borders on speedy.

name: Cookie Jar
parent_names: platinum girl scout cookies white fire alien og
abstract: Cookie Jar is a dessert blend of Platinum GSC crossed with White Fire Alien OG.

name: Cookie Monster
abstract: Cookie Monster is a 2014 Seattle Cannabis Cup winner that blends the West Coast royalty, Girl Scout Cookies, and the legendary powerhouse, OG Kush.

name: Cookie Wreck
abstract: Cookie Wreck, also called Cookie Trainwreck, is a hybrid cross between Girl Scout Cookies and Trainwreck bred by CannaVenture Seeds.

name: Cookies Kush
abstract: Cookies Kush is a hybrid strain that took 1st place as "Best Coffeeshop Strain" in High Times' 2014 Cannabis Cup.

name: Cookies and Cream
abstract: Bred by Exotic Genetix, Cookies and Cream is a hybrid cross between Starfighter and a Girl Scout Cookies phenotype.

name: Cookies and Dream
abstract: Cookies & Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that is a harmonious blend of fan favorites Blue Dream, also a favorite of lead artists Dominic and Jeremy of Big Gigantic, and combined with the robustly sweet flavors of Girl Scout Cookies.

name: Copper Kush
abstract: Copper Kush is a flavorful 80% indica strain from Washington that was bred from Frankenstein and Lemon OG Kush genetics.

name: Corleone Kush
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush sfv og kush
abstract: Corleone Kush is a potent strain of cannabis known for its strong pain relief properties and citrus and incense aroma.

name: Cornbread
abstract: Cornbread by Rare Dankness is an 80/20 indica-dominant hybrid strain that crosses Katsu Bubba Kush and Rare Dankness #2.

name: Cosmic Collision
abstract: Cosmic Collision is a sativa-dominant strain from MTG Seeds, who crossed Cosmic Charlie and Piña Collision into a fusion that boasts both flavor and potency.

name: Cotton Candy Kush
abstract: Cotton Candy Kush, or simply "Cotton Candy," is a sweet-tasting hybrid cross between Lavender and Power Plant.

name: Cotton Purple Chem
abstract: Cotton Purple Chem, or CPC, is a hybrid bred by Hesperides Gardens. CPC claimed the People’s Choice award at the 2015 DOPE Cup in Seattle with its sweet diesel flavors and extremely pungent aroma.

name: Cracker Jack
abstract: Cracker Jack is a sativa strain that crosses Jack Herer with Green Crack.

name: Crazy Miss Hyde
abstract: Crazy Miss Hyde is a surprisingly balanced hybrid given her name. She is a lively combination of the uplifting, sativa-dominant Belladona and the powerhouse indica Northern Lights.

name: Cream Caramel
abstract: Cream Caramel is sweet-tasting indica cross between BlueBlack, Maple Leaf Indica, and White Rhino.

name: Crimea Blue
abstract: Crimea Blue is a hybrid strain bred by Barney's Farm that is a cross between Blueberry and Crimean hash plant.

name: Critical 47
abstract: A sweet, skunky cross between Critical Mass and AK-47 that has a reputation for its pungent aroma and happy, relaxing effects.

name: Critical Bilbo
abstract: Critical Bilbo is a powerful indica-dominant strain that holds several Cannabis Cup championships under its belt.

name: Critical Cheese
abstract: Critical Cheese by Dinafem is a sativa-dominant hybrid that borrows its genetics from Cheese and Critical Plus.

name: Critical Haze
abstract: Critical Haze by Mr. Nice Seeds is an indica-dominant cross between Critical Mass and Afghan Haze.

name: Critical Hog
abstract: Critical Hog from T.H. Seeds is a commercial grower’s dream, producing hefty colas that stay true to its Critical Mass genetics with the added influence of Hog’s Cannabis Cup winning legacy.

name: Critical Jack
abstract: Critical Jack is a hybrid cross between Critical Mass and Jack Herer, with functional cerebral effects that allow for focus and productivity.

name: Critical Kali Mist
abstract: A powerful and resinous sativa that produces large, dense flowers after about 70 days

name: Critical Kush
