abstract: Critical Kush from Barney’s Farm is a mostly indica strain that blends together two famed cannabis staples, Critical Mass and OG Kush.

name: Critical Mass
abstract: Named after its "critical mass" of production, Critical Mass yields buds with a THC level of 19-22%.

name: Critical Plus
abstract: Critical Plus is a balanced hybrid cross between Skunk and Big Bud.

name: Critical Sensi Star
abstract: An indica-heavy cross between Critical Mass and Sensi Star that is easy to grow and extremely sticky.

name: Critical Skunk
abstract: Critical Skunk is a hybrid bred by Mr. Nice and parented by Critical Mass.

name: Critical Widow
abstract: Critical Widow by Mr. Nice Seeds combines a resinous White Widow hybrid with the heavy-hitting indica Critical Mass.

name: Critters Cookies
abstract: Critters Cookies is a balanced 40/60 sativa-leaning cross that is equal parts energizing and relaxing, and is naturally suited for physical discomfort and pain.

name: Crouching Tiger Hidden Alien
abstract: Crouching Tiger Hidden Alien is another indica staple from Exotic Genetix, who combined Tiger’s Milk with Starfighter to create this powerhouse strain.

name: Crown OG
abstract: Crown OG is an indica strain that stays true to its OG roots with a sweet pine aroma and potent euphoric effects.

name: Crown Royale
abstract: Crown Royale is a sweet indica-dominant hybrid that blends the best of parent strains Blueberry and Purple Kush together. This flower is a feast for the eyes with bright purple hues and deep green foliage. Just as delightful on the palate, Crown Royale exhibits notes of the forest floor with piney aromas and a telltale berry tartness.

name: Crunch Berry Kush
abstract: Crunch Berry Kush from Encanto Green Cross is “Chong Certified” hybrid strain that brings blissful relaxation to mind and body.

name: Crypt
abstract: Crypt is an indica-dominant strain from Northern California with an aroma that border

name: Crystal Coma
abstract: Crystal Coma is a rare sativa-dominant hybrid from California that induces deep, trance-like effects.

name: Crystal Gayle
abstract: Crystal Gayle is an indica-dominant strain descended from Northern Lights #1 with a sharp citrus flavor and productive, focused effects.

name: Crystalberry
abstract: Crystalberry is an indica-dominant cannabis strain crossed using two popular and well-loved strains, Sensi Star and DJ Short’s Blueberry.

name: Cuvee
abstract: A collaboration from TGA Genetics and Aficionado seeds, Cuvee was created crossing Space Queen and the clone-only Pinot Noir.

name: DJ Short Blueberry
abstract: DJ Short Blueberry is a living legend. This is, was, and forever will be the west coast Blueberry varietal. The strain is sought after and has been spliced into many different hybridized strains.

name: DJ Smoke
abstract: DJ Smoke is another beautiful Flo cross created by Colorado Seed Inc. This particular cross is with CO Seed’s proprietary strain, Rebel God Smoke (Cinderella 99 x Gupta Kush), which adds clear-headed stimulation to Flo’s fruity genetics, making it an ideal hybrid for those looking for mid-level body effects that aren’t cumbersome.

name: Dairy Queen
abstract: Dairy Queen is a hybrid strain of cannabis that users covet for its unique cheese and fruit aroma. Plants are bushy and flower within 8 weeks.

name: Damn Sour
abstract: Damn Sour is a mostly sativa strain bred by Green House Seeds using Sage N Sour genetics. As its name suggests, this cannabis variety inherits a distinctive sour aroma with funky hints of diesel.

name: Damnesia
abstract: A spin-off of the Amsterdam staple Amnesia Haze, Strain Hunters Seeds has crossed the Haze with another coffee shop powerhouse, AMS, to create a long-lasting hybrid.

name: Dance World
abstract: Dance World is a high-CBD sativa strain bred by Royal Queen Seeds in Spain.

name: Dancehall
abstract: Dancehall, a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid, was bred by Reggae Seeds by combining Juanita La Lagrimosa with Kalijah.

name: Dank Schrader
abstract: Dank Schrader is the house strain at The Healing Center in Vancouver, BC that crosses Rockstar Kush and Bubba Kush.

name: Danky Doodle
abstract: Danky Doodle is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that produces high yields of large buds. Effects include full body relaxation.

name: Dark Blue Dream
abstract: Dark Blue Dream is a gently sedative twist on a classic. By combining the ubiquitous headiness of Blue Dream with Dark Night’s semi-sedative physical aura, an enjoyable hybrid is created that stimulates the mind while simultaneously relaxing the body.

name: Dark Side of the Moon
abstract: A cross between Spirit in the Sky and Green Ribbon, Dark Side of the Moon flowers bloom with a starry coat of crystal trichomes wreathed by dark purple leaves.

name: Dark Star
abstract: Dark Star’s true indica effects are as spacey as its name suggests: a deep, relaxed sensation throughout the body accompanied by a heavy cerebral calm.

name: Darkside OG
abstract: Darkside OG is a heavy-hitting Kush combo from Colorado Seed Inc. With the OG parentage of Dark Star OG x Rug Burn OG, this strain is a useful and sedating option. The dark, frosted buds emanate an earthy, floral aroma that lingers in the air.

name: Darth Vader OG
abstract: Darth Vader OG is an indica variety of cannabis that hails from Afghan and Kush strains. It’s popular medicinally to treat insomnia.

name: Dawg's Waltz
abstract: Dawg’s Waltz combines the purple hues and flavors of Purple Urkle with the skunky aroma and powerful effects of Tres Dawg to create an extremely pungent hybrid.

name: Dawgfather OG
abstract: Dawgfather OG, or simply “The Dawgfather,” is an indica-dominant hybrid created by AlphaKronik Genes capable of massive plant production and a healthier-than-average yield.

name: Day Tripper
parent_names: sensi star medicine man master kush
abstract: Day Tripper is a hybrid cannabis strain that managed to inherit sativa-like effects from its indica-dominant family tree.

name: Deadhead OG
abstract: Deadhead OG is bred by The Cali Connection and is a 60/40 hybrid of Chemdawg and SFV OG.

name: Deadwood
abstract: Deadwood is potent indica cross between Bubba Kush and Sweet Pink Grapefruit. These robust indica strains come together to create good medicine for those suffering from insomnia, anxiety, and chronic pain. The aroma is sweet and skunky with spicy notes on the finish.

name: Death Star
abstract: Death Star is the potent cross of Sensi Star and Sour Diesel and has the shared sativa and indica effects of its parents.

name: Death Star OG
parent_names: sour diesel og kush sensi star
abstract: Death Star OG is a potent cross between Sour Diesel, Sensi Star, and OG Kush.

name: Deep Cheese
abstract: Deep Cheese is the result of years of selective inbreeding aimed at emphasizing the legendary funk of sharp cheese flavors that fans of Cheese strains have grown attached to.

name: Deep Chunk
abstract: This pure indica from Afghanistan was introduced to Northern California by breeder Tom Hill in the late 1970s.

name: Deep Purple
abstract: Deep Purple provides great grape taste and a calming and relaxing high.

name: Deep Sleep
abstract: Also known as P.O. 4, Deep Sleep is a cross of the Larry OG and Pre ‘98 Bubba Kush from North Hollywood breeders Progressive Options.

name: DelaHaze
abstract: DelaHaze by Paradise Seeds is a 70% sativa strain bred from Mango Haze and California Lemon Skunk genetics.

name: Denver Maple
abstract: Denver Maple is an indica strain that took 3rd place in the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Desert Star
abstract: Desert Star is a sweet and earthy 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain that offers a motivating, upbeat buzz to keep you productive and stress-free.

name: Devil Fruit
abstract: Devil Fruit is a 70% indica strain bred by Medical Seed Co. through crossing Shiskaberry and Great White Shark.

name: Devil's Tit
abstract: Devil’s Tit from SnowHigh Seeds is a potent heart-pounding speed demon that will put even the most seasoned sativa enthusiast to the test.

name: Diablo
abstract: Diablo has a THC content of up to 20% and a short flowering time. It's a cross between Blueberry, Grapefruit and South African Sativa.

name: Diamond OG
abstract: Diamond OG is an indica cannabis strain with OG Kush genetics. Patients love it for its potent and long-lasting body effects.

name: Diamond Socks
abstract: Diamond Socks, named for the dense layer of trichomes coating the plant (and a juicy reggae track), is an invigorating hybrid with roots in a rare strain of Hawaiian Silverback. The structure and growth pattern is indicative of its Kush genetics, leading to a handsome yield and aromatic floral overtones.

name: Diamond Valley Kush
abstract: Diamond Valley Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid that produces dense, medium-sized buds that emanate a classic OG aroma.

name: Diesel Duff
abstract: Diesel Duff is a hybrid cannabis strain with Sour Diesel genetics that provides an uplifting, happy high.

name: Dieseltonic
abstract: Bred by Resin Seeds in Spain, Dieseltonic is a high-CBD hybrid cross between NYC Diesel and Cannatonic.

name: Digweed
abstract: Digweed is a high-CBD Afghani cross helpful in treating chronic pain, stress, and muscle spasms.

name: Dirty Girl
abstract: Dirty Girl is a sativa-dominant cross of a Trainwreck hybrid, known as Arcata Lemon Wreck, and Cinderella 99.

name: Disney Blue
abstract: Disney Blue is a mood-lifting hybrid strain that inherits the sweet aroma of DJ Short Blueberry and the blissful, uplifting effects from its Blue Dream parent.

name: Dizzy OG
abstract: Dizzy OG took 2nd place for Best Medical Hybrid Flower at the 2016 SoCal Cannabis Cup and is the official strain of Las Vegas hip-hop luminary Dizzy Wright.

name: Django
abstract: Django is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that leaves patients feeling alert and active. It is commonly used during the day for its focused effects.

name: Do-Over OG
parent_names: og kush skywalker og hindu kush wellness og
abstract: Do-Over OG is an indica-dominant strain that combines OG Kush, Hindu Kush, Skywalker OG, and Wellness OG into one powerful hybrid.

name: Do-Si-Dos
parent_names: girl scout cookies face off og
abstract: Do-Si-Dos is an indica-dominant hybrid with qualities similar to its parent, Girl Scout Cookies. With glittering trichomes, bright pistils, and lime green and lavender leaves, this strain is a feast for eyes. Its aroma is pungent, sweet, and earthy with slight floral funkiness. These classic OG aromas blend nicely with medical-grade body effects that lean toward the sedative side with the addition of Face Off OG genetics.

name: Dog Shit
abstract: Dog Shit is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain named for its aroma, which bears a striking resemblance to its namesake.

name: Dogwalker OG
abstract: Dogwalker OG is a balanced hybrid bred by combining Albert Walker OG and Chemdawg 91.

name: Dolla Sign OG Kush
abstract: Dolla Sign OG Kush by Ty Dolla Sign is an OG blend befitting the rising Hip Hop/RnB wunderkind. He achieves this one-of-a-kind strain by blending Irene OG and Larry OG (two of his favorite cuts), creating a strain with distinct aromas and unique effects.

name: Don Shula
parent_names: the white true og east coast sour diesel
abstract: Don Shula, 3rd place winner of Best Hybrid Flower at the 2016 Colorado Cannabis Cup, crosses The White and Diagonal (True OG x East Coast Sour Diesel) to create a hybrid that sits upright in the body and mind.

name: Donegal
abstract: Donegal is a variety of Chemdawg grown by Canadian LP Tweed. It is a sativa-dominant hybrid that is potent but will still allow you to maintain your typical routine.

name: Donna OG
abstract: Donna OG is a 50/50 hybrid cross between two OG varieties, resulting in a powerfully euphoric strain with a sweet, pine aroma.

name: Doobiebird Daydream
abstract: Doobiebird Daydream is another Blue Dream hybrid that combines its famous creative relaxation with the medicinal qualities of Sanjay Gupta Kush.

name: Doox
abstract: Doox is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain bred from Purple Cow and the legendary hybrid Chemdawg.

name: Dopium
abstract: Dopium, a cross between ChemDawg and Sour Diesel, is a hybrid cannabis strain with a unique scent while keeping elements of that classic Sour Diesel smell.

name: Dorit
abstract: Dorit is an indica-dominant strain tailored for treating pain, inflammation, indigestion, appetite loss, nausea, and sleep disorders.

name: Double Barrel OG
abstract: Double Barrel OG offers a double shot of OG genetics as this hybrid combines White Fire OG with Raskal’s OG Kush.

name: Double Diesel
abstract: Double Diesel is the sativa-dominant result of a cross between award-winning NYC Diesel and Sour Diesel. It has a unique fuel and grapefruit aroma.

name: Double Dream
abstract: The sativa-dominant hybrid Double Dream puts a unique spin on the famed Blue Dream by crossing it with Dream Star.

name: Double Dutch
abstract: Double Dutch is a classic hybrid strain bred by Magus Genetics who crossed a pre-2000 Chronic female with a Warlock father.

name: Double OG
abstract: Double OG combines the powerhouse indica properties of Big Bud Afgoo and SFV OG to create a sedating strain ideal for body aches and sleepless nights.

name: Double Purple Doja
abstract: Double Purple Doja is an indica strain that crosses Sputnik #1 with Black Russian, a parentage that gives rise to powerfully euphoric effects and a musky blackberry aroma.

name: Double Tangie Banana
abstract: Double Tangie Banana is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain developed by Crockett Family Farms.

name: Doug's Varin
abstract: Doug’s Varin is a rare sativa strain that was specially crafted to contain high amounts of the cannabinoid THCV.

name: Dr. Bubbles
abstract: Dr. Bubbles is a delicious strain with roots in Y2K Bubble Gum and Gupta Kush. This lip-smacking marriage of flavors creates a sweet and decidedly floral combination that is pleasant but not debilitating.

name: Dr. Feelgood
abstract: Dr. Feelgood is a beautiful blend of flavors and effects that possesses a tangible medical bent. This cross developed by Colorado Seed Inc. is a blend of Harlequin and Gupta Kush.

name: Dr. Funk
abstract: Dr. Funk is a mostly indica strain that balances genetics from Blueberry and Bubba Kush.

name: Dr. Grinspoon
abstract: Dr. Grinspoon, a pure sativa heirloom bred by Barney’s Farm in Amsterdam, is a strain destined for connoisseurs and intellectuals alike.

name: Dr. Who
abstract: Dr. Who from TGA Genetics is a 60% indica hybrid cross between Mad Scientist and Timewreck.

name: Dragon OG
abstract: Dragon OG (or Red Dragon OG) is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Red Dragon and OG Kush. Red Dragon adds gentle invigoration to OG Kush’s mid-level sedation and pleasant euphoria.

name: Dragon's Breath
abstract: Dragon's Breath is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between two legendary strains, Jack Herer and Northern Lights.

name: Dreadlock
abstract: Dreadlock, hailing from Canada, is a 50/50 hybrid with energizing effects that carry social interactions to a new level.

name: Dream Beaver
abstract: Dream Beaver by Bodhi Seeds is a sativa-dominant strain that crosses Dirty Hippy with Appalachia.

name: Dream Berry
abstract: Dream Berry is a sweet, fruity cross between Blue Dream and Blackberry. Its calming indica qualities prevail over its sativa genetics.

name: Dream Lotus
abstract: Dream Lotus by Bodhi Seeds is a hybrid strain that was designed to recreate the widely cherished qualities of Blue Dream, but with an accentuated chunky bud structure.

name: Dream Police
abstract: Dream Police is a balanced hybrid crossed between  Dreamy Bubbles and AK-47.

name: Dream Queen
abstract: Dream Queen is an aptly named sativa-dominant hybrid that will leave you in a euphoric, dream-like state after a few puffs.

name: Dream Star
abstract: A cross between Blue Dream and Stardawg, Dream Star is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Oaksterdam Seed Co.

name: Dreamer’s Glass
abstract: Dreamer’s Glass is a hybrid cannabis strain that delivers dreamy euphoric effects alongside heavy body effects that let you settle deeply in relaxation.

name: Drizella
abstract: Drizella is a sativa bred by Dynasty Seeds crossed between Cinderella 99, White Widow, and Space Queen.

name: Duke Nukem
abstract: Duke Nukem is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain named after the popular video game character. It produces an energetic, uplifting high.

name: Durban Berry
abstract: Durban Berry is a hybrid cannabis strain that harnesses the vitalizing sativa power of Durban Poison counterbalanced by the mellow indica qualities of Rocky Mountain Blueberry.

name: Durban Cheese
abstract: Durban Cheese is a potent hybrid of Durban Poison and Cheese and provides the balanced effects of its indica and sativa parentage.

name: Durban Cookies
abstract: Known for its invigorating mental energy and medical-grade body buzz, Durban Cookies offers a more energizing experience with powerful pain relieving qualities, making this sativa-dominant strain a top choice for patients treating aches throughout the day.

name: Durban Poison
abstract: One of the most coveted sativa strains for its mind-blowing effects.  Durban Poison is sure to impress  with its energetic and creative buzz.

name: Durga Mata
abstract: With flavors best described as reminiscent of Turkish Delight, Durga Mata offers a long-lasting relaxing body buzz without the couch potato effect.

name: Dutch Dragon
abstract: Dutch Dragon is a sativa variety bred by Paradise Seeds.

name: Dutch Hawaiian
abstract: Dutch Hawaiian provides a good body high and is lime green in color.

name: Dutch Kush
abstract: Dutch Kush is a fully sedative indica developed by Paradise Seeds of Amsterdam. This traditional Kush plant grows strong and fast with earthy notes that mature and gain depth over the curing process. Dried, this bud smells of coffee beans and caramelized sugar while retaining a pungent floral undertone.

name: Dutch Queen
abstract: Dutch Queen is an uplifting, sweet-flavored hybrid strain bred by Buddy Boy Farms in Washington.

name: Dutch Thunder Fuck
abstract: Dutch Thunder Fuck by Sirius Buds is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that combines genetics from an award-winning cut of Dutch Treat and the illustrious Matanuska Thunder Fuck.

name: Dutch Treat
abstract: Smelling of sweet pine and citrus, Dutch Treat has a THC of up to 18% with a taste of eucalyptus.

name: Dutch Treat Haze
abstract: Two superstars from the Dutch cannabis scene mingle together to rejuvenate genetics from decades passed into an intriguing hybrid that gained popularity in Colorado’s medical market for being both potent and flavorful.

name: Dutchberry
abstract: Dutchberry is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid strain from Artizen Cannabis in Lacey, WA.

name: Dynamite
abstract: Dynamite is a short and bushy Indica that provides high yield and high quality bud.

name: Early Girl
abstract: An indica-dominant hybrid, Early Girl is great for novice consumers looking for stress relief. This strain has a flowering time of 7-8 weeks.

name: Early Miss
abstract: An auto-flowering indica-dominant hybrid, Early Miss is a great strain for those looking for pain relief or an appetite boost.

name: Early Pearl
abstract: Early Pearl is a sativa bred by Sensi Seeds.

name: Early Skunk
abstract: Cannabis Cup winner Early Skunk is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Skunk #1 and Early Pearl.

name: Earth OG
abstract: A combination of Sour Diesel and Ghost OG, Earth OG is a cerebrally-focused hybrid with stimulating and happy effects.

name: Earthshaker OG
abstract: Earthshaker OG, also known as P.O. #3, is a variety of OG Kush from Progressive Options Genetics. The powerful sativa-dominant effects are known to sneak up on you with a smooth and lengthy buzz.

name: East Coast Sour Diesel
abstract: East Coast Sour Diesel is a sativa cannabis strain that has a strong lemon aroma and provides fast-acting high energy effects.

name: Eastern European
abstract: Eastern European refers to any strain that grows natively in this region. These varieties tend to be indica in structure and effect.

name: Easy Bud
abstract: Easy Bud by Royal Queen Seeds is an autoflowering Ruderalis variety that is designed for horticultural newbies looking for a resilient plant with mid-range indica effects. This plant’s genetics remain unknown, but have been compared to White Dwarf in stature and potency.

name: Ebola #7
abstract: Ebola #7, also known as THCbola, is a blend of two popular California strains. It was created in the summer of 2012 when HendRx Farms’ breeders crossed SFV OG with Girl Scout Cookies.

name: Ed Rosenthal Super Bud
parent_names: afghani south asian thai african mexican jamaican
abstract: A superb balance of the best traits from each end of the cannabis spectrum has been achieved through expert selection over countless generations.

name: Edelweiss
parent_names: hindu kush skunk no. 1 north indian
abstract: The Edelweiss strain gets its namesake from the white flower that grows high in the Swiss Alps.

name: El Chapo OG
abstract: El Chapo OG is a potent indica strain out of California that smells of rich earth and pine. With dense jade popcorn buds that exhibit a shimmering coat of trichomes, this strain is visually striking and worth keeping on display.

name: El Jefe
abstract: El Jefe by Rare Dankness Seeds is a 70/30 indica-dominant cross between Abusive OG and Rare Dankness #1.

name: El Niño
parent_names: haze super skunk south american south indian
abstract: El Niño is an award-winning strain of marijuana that was released by Greenhouse Seeds in 1998. It is known for its strong sedative effects.

name: El-Na
abstract: El-Na, an Israeli strain bred by Tikun Olam, is a 50/50 hybrid intended for treatment of chronic pain and nausea.

name: Elderberry Kush
abstract: Elderberry Kush is a 55% indica-dominant hybrid bred by Green Devil Genetics in Spain.

name: Electric Black Mamba
abstract: Electric Black Mamba is an indica-dominant strain bred from a Black Domina mother and a Purple Diesel male.

name: Electric Kool Aid
abstract: Electric Kool Aid is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid strain bred by crossing Purple Diesel and Cherry Pie.

name: Electric Lemon G
abstract: Electric Lemon G is a sativa-dominant strain that combines an unknown lemon-flavored hybrid, G13, and Northern Lights #5.

name: Elephant
abstract: Elephant is an old school bud with a lineage lost to time. This strain supposedly acquired its name for the elephant-sized colas it creates during its flowering cycle. The chunky flowers express a sweet and sour aroma that is reminiscent of candy and citrus while also retaining a subtle spiciness.

name: Elvis
abstract: Elvis is a hybrid creation by Seedism that crosses AK-47 with a sativa-dominant phenotype of Skunk #1, known as The Pure.

name: Emerald Jack
abstract: Jack Herer, with its amazing spectrum of earthy flavors and heady effects, combines with the pungent sour aromas of Emerald OG to give life to Emerald Jack’s unique terpene profile.

name: Emerald OG
abstract: Emerald OG, a strain developed by the California Breeders Association, is a vigorous cross that combines Fire OG with Emerald Diesel.

name: Emperor Cookie Dough
abstract: Emperor Cookie Dough was dubbed one of the Strongest Strains of 2016 by High Times. This potent cross of Emperor OG and Girl Scout Cookies yields severely resinous buds that reek of cookie dough. If the smell and potency don’t have you elbow deep in a jar of these nuggets, the appearance of these glittering green buds will.

name: Endless Sky
abstract: Endless Sky by Greenthumb Seeds is an indica strain bred from Grenadine and an Iranian landrace.

name: Enemy of the State
abstract: Enemy of the State by Super Strains is an old school indica whose genetics have been lent to several other successful strains over the years. While the strain’s genetics remain unknown, the musky aroma and heavy mental and physical sedation suggests indica-dominant lineage. Enemy of the State’s primary claim to fame is its genetic contribution to the Amnesia family line as well as its generous yields.

name: Enigma
abstract: Enigma is an indica-dominant strain that delivers happy effects and relief from appetite loss.

name: Eran Almog
abstract: Eran Almog, an indica-dominant strain developed by Tikun Olam, is a high THC strain used for treating sleep disorders and nausea.

name: Erez
abstract: Erez is an indica-dominant strain developed by the Israeli company Tikun Olam and named after their first patient.

name: Ether
abstract: Generally referred to as Alien Dawg (“Ether” cut), this is one of the more sought after phenotypes of the indica-dominant hybrid Alien Dawg.

name: Euforia
abstract: Euforia (or Euphoria) is a multi award-winning cannabis strain bred from popular skunk strains that is prized for its upbeat, energetic effects.

name: Eugene Cream
abstract: Named for its light color and smooth smoke, Eugene Cream inherits its characteristics from a Hash Plant/Big Bud hybrid and a female plant called Queen.

name: Euphoria Cookies
abstract: Euphoria Cookies is a balanced 50/50 hybrid cross of the ever-popular Girl Scout Cookies and the uplifting sativa Euphoria. The colorful buds exhibit sweet, doughy terpenes that smell like vanilla, rose, and tropical fruit.

name: Everlast
abstract: Everlast from Machias, Washington is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that induces deeply relaxing effects with a hashy, skunky aroma.

name: Ewok
abstract: Ewok, a cross between Albert Walker and Tahoe Alien, was the Hybrid winner of the 2013 Seattle High Times Cannabis Cup.

name: Exodus Cheese
abstract: Unusual cheesy smell with deeply pungent earthy taste.  Uplifting high that lasts about four hours.

name: Extreme OG
abstract: Extreme OG, bred by Exotic Genetix, is a potent yet functional indica built from the genetics of Fire OG and Green Ribbon. While Fire OG maintains chunky, weighted body effects, this strain stays uplifted thanks to the dominant Green Crack genetics inside Green Ribbon.

name: Face Off OG
abstract: Face Off OG is a powerfully euphoric OG Kush phenotype bred by Archive Seeds.

name: Fat Axl
abstract: Fat Axl is a laugh-out-loud homage to the Fat Axl Rose meme circulating the internet. This genetic cross started out as an experiment and joke, but after witnessing the strain’s phenomenal yield and potency, Fat Axl earned a place in the Pua Mana ‘Ohana catalog.

name: Fat Nelson
abstract: Fat Nelson combines a bouquet of hybridized genetics to create a formidable flower with pleasant and uplifting effects. Colorado Seed Inc. crossed Sour Willie (Willie's Sour Diesel x Vietnamese Black x Highland Nepalese) and the proprietary Gupta Kush to form a strain that doesn’t sacrifice diversity for stability.

name: Fat Purple
abstract: Fat Purple by Hazeman is a hybrid strain with big buds and potent effects. By crossing a Purple Rhino and G13 hybrid with Fat Marty, Hazeman achieved a strain with uplifting euphoria and soothing physical attributes.

name: Faygo Red Pop
abstract: Bred by 710 Savant, Faygo Red Pop is an indica strain that took 1st place as live resin in the 2015 High Times Michigan Cannabis Cup.

name: Fire Alien Kush
abstract: Fire Alien Kush from OG Raskal Genetics is a potent hybrid strain that crosses Alien Kush with Fire OG.

name: Fire Haze
abstract: Fire Haze is an upbeat sativa marijuana strain. It’s great for those who suffer from stress, anxiety, and headaches, as this strain has head-oriented effects.

name: Fire OG
abstract: THC up to 20% and the appearance of nuggets that are on fire, Fire OG is one of the strongest of the OG strains.

name: Firewalker OG
abstract: Firewalker OG is a sativa-dominant cross between Skywalker and Fire OG that is spicy with hints of flowers and hash.

name: Flaming Cookies
abstract: Girl Scout Cookies and Fire OG combine to create Flaming Cookies, a potent indica strain that delivers a thick fog of cerebral euphoria.

name: Flo
abstract: Creating a "flo" of buds to harvest, Flo was rated #1 at the 1996 Cannabis Cup.

name: Flo Limone
abstract: Flo Limone is Colorado Seed’s twist on a cannabis classic.

name: Flo Walker
abstract: Flo Walker from award-winning breeder, The Vault Genetics, is an exceptional indica-dominant cross with potency and flavor. By combining the legendary likes of Skywalker OG and DJ Short’s Flo, Flo Walker takes on the calming sedative body of its Afghani parentage while commingling with Flo’s brilliant flavor and clear mental state.

name: Flowerbomb Kush
abstract: Flowerbomb Kush by Green House Seeds is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by crossing Green Crack and OG Kush.

name: Flowers For Algernon
abstract: Flowers For Algernon is a sativa-dominant cross between Sour Diesel and Mask.

name: Fortune Cookies
abstract: Fortune Cookies is a hybrid cannabis strain that combines the famed genetics of Girl Scout Cookies and OG Kush in a potent mix of earthy, honeyed flavors.

name: Four Cups
parent_names: jack herer sensi star cherry ak-47 blueberry
abstract: Four Cups is the resinous union of four different Cannabis Cup winners: Jack Herer, Sensi Star, Cherry AK-47, and Blueberry. This wild hybrid blend offers effects for every situation, including physical relaxation, a dissociative hazy mental state, and significant mood elevation.

name: Four Star General
abstract: Four Star General from Fire Bros. is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that brings together genetics from two Chemdawg hybrids, Stardawg and Tres Dawg.

name: Frank's Gift
abstract: Frank’s Gift is a phenomenal phenotype of Skunk Haze that has been known to generate upwards of 20% CBD. This strain delivers a nearly mythological ratio of CBD/THC that lends itself to a variety of medical uses associated with physical discomfort, inflammation, and anxiety.

name: Frankenstein
abstract: Frankenstein is an 80% indica strain ideal for high-tolerance patients and consumers.

name: Freezeland
abstract: Freezeland, a celebrity indica cannabis strain in Quebec, has a fruity citrus flavor with pine undertones and potent full-body indica effects

name: Frida
abstract: With the dense, full flavor of her indica parentage and over 12% CBD from an ACDC mother, Frida is a complex and enchanting strain that provides relief for mind and body while fueling inspiration, sensuality, appetite, and meditation. Named in celebration of “The Heroine of Pain,” Frida by Raven Grass reminds the consumer to reach further, encouraging physical wellness without encumbering you with sedation.

name: Frisian Dew
abstract: Frisian Dew, Dutch Passion’s pride and joy, is a 50/50 hybrid first bred in 2008 by combining Super Skunk and Purple Star.

name: Frisian Duck
abstract: Frisian Duck is a structurally unique strain developed by Dutch Passion. Its genetics were bred over several generations of Frisian Dew x Duckfoot. The genetics from Duckfoot (named for its oddly shaped leaves that resemble duck feet) allows this plant to hide in plain sight, making it ideal for outdoor grows.

name: Frostbite
abstract: Frostbite is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that flowers at 8 to 9 weeks, producing high yields.

name: Frosted Freak
abstract: Frosted Freak is a Michigan hybrid that crosses Brand X with a long-lost sativa-dominant strain known as High Roller.

name: Fruit Loops
parent_names: blue dream white widow grapefruit blueberry
abstract: Fruit Loops is an indica-dominant hybrid that smells as good as it sounds, Tucan sold separately. This luscious strain reeks of its recessive Grapefruit and Blueberry genetics and takes White Widow’s moderate body effects further with every puff.

name: Fruit Punch
abstract: Fruit Punch is a mostly sativa strain from Heavyweight Seeds, who bred this flavor powerhouse from Skunk, Haze, and Northern Lights genetics.

name: Fruit Spirit
abstract: Fruit Spirit is a 60% sativa-dominant hybrid that was bred by Royal Queen Seeds by crossing Blueberry and White Widow.

name: Fruity Chronic Juice
abstract: Fruity Chronic Juice, bred by Delicious Seeds, is an indica-dominant cross of White Widow and Chronic that is short in stature but can stretch tall when given enough room for the roots to spread. It expresses itself with an array of citrus flavors, like orange and grapefruit, that give way to subtle undertones of pine and hash on exhale.

name: Fruity Pebbles
parent_names: green ribbon granddaddy purple tahoe alien
abstract: Fruity Pebbles by Alien Genetics is a hybrid strain named after its characterizing sweet, fruity flavor.

name: Fruity Widow
abstract: Fruity Widow by 710 Genetics is a coupling of classic phenotypes to create a potent union of sweet terpenes and hybridized effects. 710 Genetics combined the flavorful Blueberry and the well-balanced, resinous White Widow to create an instant classic.

name: Fruitylicious
abstract: Fruitylicious is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Mandala Seeds. Its fruit flavors are passed down from its parent strains, Blueberry and Very Berry Hashberry, and mix with subtle notes of hazelnut and pine.

name: Fucking Incredible
abstract: Fucking Incredible is a pure indica strain and was created by combining the genetics of two magnificent indicas back in 1990.

name: Full Moon
abstract: A classic tropical sativa, Full Moon is a tall, stretchy, long-flowering strain that will produce dense buds under HID lighting.

name: Funfetti
abstract: Funfetti is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Cherry Pie with a select phenotype of Animal Cookies, nicknamed Secret Cookies. This strain was originally bred in Northern California by a group of breeders know as Bay Exclusives and was released in limited quantities.

name: Funky Monkey
abstract: Funky Monkey is a euphoric indica-dominant cross between Grape Ape and Mendo Purps.

name: Future
abstract: Future by Exotic Genetix is a strain of cannabis crafted in the present, but sent from the future. This potent cross of Gorilla Glue #4 and Starfighter F2 delivers immediate euphoria that elevates the mind and relaxes the body. The strength of this strain has been known to dole out anxiety in novice consumers, so mind your dosage.

name: G Stik "Amarillo"
abstract: The "Amarillo" G Stik from G FarmaLabs is a blend of 100% sativa flowers hand picked to create a euphoric feeling.

name: G Stik "Orange"
abstract: The "Orange" G Stik from G FarmaLabs is a hybrid blend with a tangy aroma.

name: G Stik "RED"
abstract: The "RED" G Stik from G FarmaLabs is a potent form of medicine for patients in medical marijuana states.

name: G Stik "Rosado"
abstract: The "Rosado" G Stik from G FarmaLabs is a sativa blended to uplift the mind through its rich aroma and perfect burn.

name: G Stik "Verde"
abstract: The "Verde" G Stik from G FarmaLabs symbolizes energy and healing in a potent hybrid blend.

name: G Stik "Violeta"
abstract: The "Violeta" G Stik from G FarmaLabs is one of the most desired 100% Pre-Rolled Indica blends in the market.

name: G-Force
abstract: G-Force by Flying Dutchman is a hearty G-13 and Skunk/Northern Lights cross with heavy effects and a generous yield. This potent indica produces massive resinous colas that mature over a nine-week flowering cycle.

name: G.O.A.T.
abstract: Created by Scapegoat Genetics and TSL Farms, G.O.A.T. is a hybrid strain that crosses Animal Pie and ACDC.

name: G13
abstract: G13 is a cannabis strain of legends. A very strong variety of indica that is a favorite of anybody who tries it, G13 produces very heavy indica body effects.

name: G13 Diesel
abstract: G13 Diesel from Head Seeds is a well-balanced hybrid strain that descends from G13 and East Coast Sour Diesel.

name: G13 Haze
abstract: G13 Haze is a cross between the G13 and Haze cannabis strains. It produces uplifting effects while still retaining the heavy-hitting indica undertones.

name: G13 Widow
abstract: G13 Widow is a mix of two of the most renowned strains from across the cannabis landscape. G13, whose legend started in the US, combines with the prized White Widow, first bred in the Netherlands.

name: GI001
abstract: GI001 is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain developed by one of Growth Industries’ botanists. This strain is characterized by a lime green plant color, citrus taste, and high yields during cultivation.

name: GRiZ Kush
abstract: GRiZ Kush is a custom strain bred by Native Roots in collaboration with Root Cellar Genetics. This exclusive hybrid blend of Tangerine Haze and Pakistani Chitral Kush genetics was hand-selected by the musician GRiZ based on his favorite flavors and desired effects.

name: GTO
abstract: GTO is a well-balanced hybrid that crosses parent strains Golden Goat and Triangle OG. The strain has a pungent, skunky aroma that can fill a room, but the exhale is sweet, earthy, and slightly tropical. Its effects are heady and talkative while exhibiting soothing warmth in the extremities.

name: Galactic Jack
abstract: This sativa provides an aroma of sweet lemons mixed with flavors of skunky grapefruit and effects best described as uplifting and carefree.

name: Game Changer
abstract: The 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid Game Changer is a clone-only strain that descends from Purple Dragon and Green Thai.

name: Gandalf OG
abstract: Gandalf OG is an extremely potent indica-dominant strain that packs medical-grade sedation, analgesic qualities, and an OG aroma that could only originate in a world of fantasy and wonder. This strain achieves such pronounced potency by combining parent strains Louie XIII and Skywalker OG.

name: Ganesh Berry
abstract: From Zion Botanicals comes Ganesh Berry, a hybrid cannabis strain that pulls genetics from Plushberry and a Northern Indian and Afghani hybrid.

name: Garlic Bud
abstract: Garlic Bud is a pungent indica strain from the 90's, bred by The Seed Bank (now known as Sensi Seeds) using Afghani genetics.

name: Gatekeeper OG
parent_names: og kush sensi star medicine man
abstract: Gatekeeper OG is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that was bred as an attempt to recreate and stabilize the “Farmer 12” version of OG Kush.

name: Gelato
parent_names: sunset sherbet thin mint girl scout cookies
abstract: Gelato is another tantalizing hybrid cannabis strain from Cookie Fam Genetics, following in the footsteps of its parents Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies.

name: Gemstone
parent_names: northern lights sour diesel skunk #1 lavender
abstract: Gemstone is a coveted hybrid strain with a complex genetic background that combines Skunk #1, Northern Lights, Lavender, and Sour Diesel.

name: Georgia Pine
abstract: Georgia Pine by Swamp Boys Seeds is a complex, terpene rich hybrid with a bouquet like no other. A cross between Killer Queen G13 and William’s Wonder, Georgia Pine yields aromatic notes of gasoline and black licorice wrapped in the scent of wild watermelon.

name: Ghost OG
abstract: Ghost OG Kush, an award-winning Afghani strain with a sweet citrus taste, is loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.

name: Ghost OG Moonshine
abstract: Ghost OG Moonshine is described as a “chameleon” by breeder Colorado Seed Inc. Some consumers feel the immediate stimulation from the strain’s Blue Moonshine genetics while others experience intense appetite ignition.

name: Ghost Ship
abstract: Ghost Ship is an indica-dominant cross between Purple Kush Starship and Gupta Kush. Pervasive relaxation cascades over the body, but the buzz is not lethargic. With a very strong aroma that can only be described as “Kushy,” this strain soothes aches and pains while lending heady introspection.

name: Ghost Train Haze
abstract: First bred by Rare Dankness, Ghost Train Haze is a sativa cross between Ghost OG and Neville’s Wreck.

name: Gigabud
abstract: this strain produces happy but sleep-inducing effects with an earthy aroma of fresh apricots. Gigabud’s relaxing qualities make it a strain best saved for the end of your day or when faced with sleepless nights.

name: Ginger Ale
abstract: Ginger Ale, a cross between Cinderella 88 and Cafe Girl, is a potent hybrid known to test upwards of 20-25% THC. This heavy-handed cross delivers an immense burst of euphoria coupled with weighted body effects that saturate the consumer’s perception while locking them to the couch.

name: Girl Scout Cookies
abstract: Girl Scout Cookies is an OG Kush and Durban Poison hybrid with intensely euphoric effects and a sweet, earthy aroma.

name: Glad Max
abstract: Glad Max, cultivated by Monarch Wellness in Arizona, is a spin on the classic Caramelicious sativa. This high-THC sativa hybrid is known to have long-lasting euphoria that lifts the mood while relaxing the body.

name: Glass Slipper
abstract: A cross between Cinderella-99 and 'The White', Glass Slipper is a sativa-dominant hybrid described to have a nice cerebral effect with a sweet, somewhat fruity flavor profile.

name: Glue Tech
abstract: Glue Tech is a functional indica that shows its rich Afghani lineage in the form of bright green buds coated in sugary trichomes. This strain's effects are relaxing and sedating, especially with continued consumption, but also anticipate appetite enhancement.

name: Go Time
abstract: A cross between Norton and JOG Kush, Go Time is perfect for perking up moods, stimulating focus, and coercing arousal.

name: Gobbilygoo
parent_names: blue magoo purple urkle sin city kush
abstract: Gobbilygoo is an indica strain bred by Alphakronik, who combines genetics from Blue Magoo and Gobbstopper.

name: God Bud
abstract: A great strain for small spaces, God Bud doesn't grow much higher than 3 feet tall.

name: God's Gift
abstract: A popular California strain, God's Gift tastes of citrus, grape, and hash. It has a very strong THC content of up to 22%.

name: God's Green Crack
abstract: God’s Green Crack is a hybrid strain bred by Jordan of the Islands, who wanted to lighten up the heavy effects of God’s Gift with Green Crack.

name: Godberry
abstract: Godberry is a potent indica marijuana strain that provides potent pain relief. Growers like this strain because it is easy to grow and produces high yields.

name: Godfather OG
abstract: Godfather OG is a popular OG strain of cannabis that is known for its potency and high THC levels. It is used widely for medical purposes.

name: Godfather Purple Kush
abstract: Bred by MTG Seeds, Godfather Purple Kush is an indica-dominant cross between Godfather, Purple Kush, and Afghani.

name: Godzilla
abstract: Godzilla is a mostly indica strain crafted from God Bud genetics, and is meant for cultivation in hot climates.

name: God’s Bubba
abstract: Bred by Jordan of the Islands, God’s Bubba is an indica cross between two hefty parent strains, God Bud and Pre-98 Bubba Kush.

name: God’s Treat
abstract: God’s Treat, bred from the holy matrimony of Dutch Treat and God Bud, is an indica-dominant hybrid from Jordan of the Islands Seeds.

name: Gog & Magog
abstract: Gog & Magog, a strain produced by Israeli cannabis suppliers Tikun Olam, is an 80/20 indica-dominant hybrid.

name: Goji Diesel
abstract: Goji Diesel is an uplifting strain brought to us by The Blowing Tree out of Providence, Rhode Island. This particular Diesel is a cross of Goji OG by Bodhi Seeds and CDDiesel  by MTG Seeds.

name: Goji OG
abstract: Goji OG is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Bodhi Seeds crossed between Nepali OG and Snow Lotus.

name: Gold King's Thai
abstract: old King’s Thai (also known as Gold King’s Thai Stick) is the historical seed stock from a 1979 Thai Stick mother gathered by Gold King. This heirloom lineage is a special and rare cut that grows tight, colorful buds contrary to the traditional lanky stocks of Southeast Asia.

name: Goldberry
abstract: Goldberry is a hybrid cannabis strain that is a cross of Pot of Gold and Blueberry. It is often used medicinally for pain management.

name: Golden Gage
abstract: Golden Gage by Green Gage Genetics is a wooly sativa-dominant hybrid with neon-orange pistils and trichome-laden foliage that will make your fingers sticky. By crossing Golden Goat and Joseph OG, the breeders at Gage Green created a special cut with truly lifted attributes.

name: Golden Goat
abstract: Created by accident in Kansas, Golden Goat's effects can last up to 2 hours. The strain has a sweet, sour, and spicy taste.

name: Golden Panda
abstract: Gold Panda is a cross between Golden Pineapple and Gold Nugget. This sativa-dominant hybrid has the earthiness and trichome production of Girl Scout Cookies, with light green buds that packs rich tropical and spicy notes.

name: Golden Pineapple
abstract: Golden Pineapple is a hybrid cross between Golden Goat and Pineapple Kush that delivers creative, uplifting effects with a fruity, tropical flavor.

name: Golden Ticket
abstract: Golden Ticket from Archive Seeds Bank is a 50/50 hybrid strain that gives you special access to euphoria’s top floor.

name: Goo
abstract: Goo is an indica cross between Hindu Kush and Blueberry that induces deep physical relaxation coupled with slight cerebral energy.

name: Gooberry
abstract: Gooberry is an indica-dominant strain descended from legendary parents Afgoo and Blueberry.

name: Good Medicine
abstract: Good Medicine is great for solving medical needs without keeping you on the couch.

name: Gorilla Biscuit
abstract: Gorilla Biscuit by Seeds of Compassion is an indica-dominant cut bred from crossing the Turpentine pheno of Sensi Star and Stardawg IX. This rare and rather old school blend is named for Methaqualone, also known as quaaludes, a medication which has a sedative and sensual effect on the body.

name: Gorilla Cookies
parent_names: gorilla glue #4 thin mint girl scout cookies
abstract: Gorilla Cookies by Elev8 Seeds is the powerful union of Gorilla Glue #4 and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. The pungent Gorilla Glue aroma is loud, but Thin Mint’s exotic terpene profile adds nuance to the bouquet.

name: Gorilla Glue #1
abstract: Gorilla Glue #1 by GG Strains is the potent and flavorful sister strain to Gorilla Glue #4, who took the fast lane to fame in recent years after snagging several Cannabis Cup awards.

name: Gorilla Glue #4
abstract: Gorilla Glue #4 is a potent hybrid strain that won 1st place in the 2014 Los Angeles Cannabis Cup.

name: Gorilla Glue #5
abstract: Gorilla Glue #5 from GG Strains is a potent strain that crosses Gorilla Glue #1 and Gorilla Glue #4 phenotypes to create this knockout hybrid.

name: Gorkle
abstract: Gorkle is a cross between The Fork and Rebel God Smoke. This sativa-dominant strain exhibits the better parts of it Hawaiian genetics through an uplifting and stimulating body buzz that lingers for hours. Its effects are also easy on the joints and limbs in a nod to its recessive Rug Burn OG genetics.

name: Grand Doggy Purps
abstract: Grandoggy Purps, or more formerly Grandoggy Purple, is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Granddaddy Purple and a Chemdawg phenotype known as Chemdawg D.

name: Grand Hindu
abstract: Grand Hindu is an indica-dominant marijuana strain that serves as a potent treatment for pain. Since it can induce laziness, this strain is not for daytime use.

name: Grand Hustle
abstract: Grand Hustle is a potent hybrid marijuana strain that provides users with pain relief while leaving them focused and alert.

name: Granddaddy Purple
abstract: Introduced in 2003 by Ken Estes, Granddaddy Purple is a famous indica cross between Purple Urkle and Big Bud.

name: Grandpa Larry OG
abstract: Granddaddy Purp and Larry OG were crossed to create this indica that behaves more like a hybrid.

name: Grape Ape
abstract: A good all-around indica strain that will help with your pain or nausea.

name: Grape Calyx
abstract: Grape Calyx by Calyx Garden is a strain with deep roots in a half-dozen genetic parents. Calyx Garden has been breeding this strain since 2012 and began by crossing Durban Poison and Master Kush. The cross was then combined with SFV OG, which was then bred with Platinum Girl Scout Cookies. This “Suicide Girl” strain was then crossed with the rare Purple Pineapple to create a strain bursting with purple calyxes, appearing similar to a bunch of grapes dusted with trichomes.

name: Grape Cookies
abstract: Grape Cookies by Pisces Genetics is the rich indica-dominant cross between Forum Girl Scout Cookies and Grape Kush. With strong OG elements on one side, complex floral terpenes on the other, and flavors of sweet berry and grape throughout, this strain is a knockout.

name: Grape Crush
abstract: Grape Crush is an indica-dominant strain of cannabis that descends from the popular Blueberry strains. Buds are purple to blue in color and sweet in taste.

name: Grape Drink
abstract: Grape Drink is a sweet cross of familiar genetics. Kimbo Kush x Grape God offer their best attributes to this indica, expressing themselves as large spear-shaped colas from Kimbo Kush and the intoxicatingly sweet aroma of Grape God.

name: Grape God
abstract: Grape God is a cross between God Bud and Grapefruit.  Produces large yields and high levels of THC.

name: Grape Inferno
abstract: Grape Inferno is a 70/30 indica-dominant strain bred by NorStar Genetics and propagated by TGA Genetics.

name: Grape Kush
abstract: Grape Kush is a hybrid marijuana strain that provides euphoric head effects along with a nice, relaxed body sensation.

name: Grape OX
abstract: Grape OX is a 90% indica strain bred by Rare Dankness, who crossed Grape Ape with OX to achieve this potent, purple-hued variety.

name: Grape Skunk
abstract: Grape Skunk is an indica-dominant marijuana strain that has a quick flowering time and produces flowers with a berry smell and flavor.

name: Grape Stomper
abstract: Grape Stomper, AKA Sour Grapes, is a hybrid strain from Gage Green Genetics.

name: Grape Valley Kush
abstract: Grape Valley Kush is an indica-dominant cross of SFV OG and Grape Kush bred by Moxie Seeds. The earthy aroma of this strain mixes with flavors of pine and sweet citrus to bring on full-bodied relaxation with a hint of social energy that makes this strain good for relaxing with friends in your down time.

name: Grapefruit
abstract: Grapefruit has the sweet, soft smell of grapefruit with an equally sweet taste and nice sativa effects.

name: Grapefruit Diesel
abstract: Grapefruit Diesel is a hybrid strain of marijuana that flowers in 8 weeks and exhibits common indica characteristics.

name: Grapefruit Haze
abstract: A beautiful blend of fruity and spicy flavours with a very cerebral high.

name: Grapefruit Kush
abstract: Large buds with a fruity hash taste, Grapefruit Kush produces enjoyable smooth and creamy smoke with a great high.

name: Gravity
abstract: Gravity is an indica-dominant strain of marijuana that is often used therapeutically to treat chronic pain due to its high CBD levels.

name: Great White Shark
parent_names: super skunk south american south indian
abstract: Great White Shark is a sativa strain of marijuana that grows best indoors, producing potent flowers that smell strongly of fruit.

name: Green Avenger
abstract: Green Avenger is a squat, branchy hybrid strain with long, sticky colas of tropical, fruity smelling flowers.

name: Green Candy
abstract: Green Candy is a hybrid marijuana strain that's a cross between Candy Kush and Green Crack. It provides a cerebral sensation and relaxing body effects.

name: Green Crack
abstract: Green Crack is a popular sativa strain that promotes energy, focus, and mental stimulation.

name: Green Crack Extreme
abstract: Green Crack Extreme is a sativa marijuana strain that provides users with an active, creative high. Its flowers have a sweet aroma.

name: Green Door Kush
abstract: Green Door Kush is a hybrid cannabis strain that is often recommended medically for the management of chronic pain or nausea.

name: Green Dragon
abstract: Green Dragon, bred by Master Thai, is a cross of two indicas, Afghani and Turkish Gummy

name: Green Dream
abstract: Green Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross of Green Crack and Blue Dream.

name: Green Goblin
abstract: Green Goblin is a sativa-heavy cannabis strain that delivers a happy, creative buzz along with long-lasting body relaxation.

name: Green Goddess
abstract: Green Goddess is an indica-dominant hybrid that offers a divine flavor profile of rose and ruby red grapefruit.

name: Green Haze
abstract: Green Haze by A.C.E. Seeds is another version of their sativa Oldtimers Haze and takes after her Thai and South Indian ancestry.

name: Green Kush
abstract: Green Kush is a slightly indica-dominant cannabis strain that carries an upbeat, cerebral effect before inducing a heavy body feeling.

name: Green Lantern
abstract: Green Lantern is a sativa strain that inherits mellow euphoric effects and a peppery pine aroma.

name: Green Love Potion
abstract: Green Love Potion is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that is surprisingly functional. This particular cut grows into a bouquet of green and purple leaves that emits an odor denoting its Lavender parentage.

name: Green Poison
abstract: Green Poison is a dangerously flavorful and potent indica cross championed by Sweet Seeds.

name: Green Python
abstract: Green Python is an indica-dominant strain bred by House of Funk Genetics that was created by cross-pollinating Burmese (from Bodhi Seeds) with a Green Crack clone. The resulting hybrid is full-bodied and known for its fast flowering cycle.

name: Green Queen
abstract: Green Queen was bred by JB Dank Nugs and is the hybrid cross of Green Crack and Space Queen. Each of these strains has exceptional standalone effects, but when combined, their speedy and heady elements work in concert to create a strain greater than the sum of its parts.

name: Green Ribbon
abstract: Green Ribbon is a hybrid cannabis strain that offers an energetic, heady sativa effect along with an indica body buzz.

name: Gremlin
parent_names: king louis xiii white fire alien og girl scout cookies
abstract: A cross between King Louis XIII and Mogwai, Gremlin is a hybrid strain that carries the sweet scent of cookie dough and earthy pine.

name: Grilled Cheese
abstract: Grilled Cheese is a cross of TGA/Subcool’s Cheese Quake and Colorado Seed Inc.’s Gupta Kush. This strain shows off cheesy terpenes with a hint of citrus on the finish.

name: Grimace
abstract: Grimace is a mostly indica strain with a bright purple coloration and sedating, mellow effects.

name: Grimmdica
abstract: Grimmdica is a blissful, tranquilizing indica strain with a rich, acrid hash flavor.

name: Guard Dawg
abstract: Guard Dawg is an indica-dominant phenotype bred by RedEyed Genetics. This flower’s genetic parentage is a combination of Abusive OG and TreStardawg.

name: Guava Chem
abstract: Guava Chem is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Guava Kush
abstract: Guava Kush is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Gucci OG
abstract: Gucci OG is an OG Kush variant named with the lavish cannabis connoisseur in mind.

name: Gumbi
parent_names: pure kush la confidential sweet tooth juicy fruit
abstract: Gumbi is an indica strain bred by combining a Pure Kush and LA Confidential hybrid with a Sweet Tooth and Juicy Fruit hybrid.

name: Gumbo
abstract: Getting its name from the classic bubble gum flavor, Gumbo is a perfect medicine for the evenings and has a smooth taste and finish.

name: Gummy Bears
abstract: Gummy Bears by Elemental Seeds is a gooey hybrid with sweetness and potency. By combining Trueberry (True OG crossed with a Strawberry Banana x Blackberry hybrid) with the citrus sovereign Big Lemon, Gummy Bears achieves a unique array of colored leaves and outstanding resin production.

name: Gupta Haze
abstract: Tangerine Haze and Gupta Kush come together in this outstanding hybrid by Colorado Seed Inc. With sweet and stimulating effects brought forward by Tang’s NYC Diesel x G13 Haze parentage and a yield and potency boost from Gupta Kush, Gupta Haze is mentally clarifying with a generous body buzz.

name: Gupta Kush
abstract: This famous indica-dominant strain is a homage to the neurosurgeon and medicinal marijuana advocate, Dr. Sanjay Gupta. The folks at Colorado Seed Inc. wanted to honor Dr. Gupta with an old-school indica that was versatile and potent.

name: Guptilla
abstract: Guptilla is a potent indica-dominant cross bred by Colorado Seed Inc. With the glittering trichome laden foliage of Gorilla Glue #4 intermixed with the “Dr. of Dankness” Gupta Kush, this strain raises kushy, full-bodied indica effects to a level that few have the privilege of enjoying.

name: Gutbuster
abstract: Washington State breeders Exotic Genetix crossed two of their own strains to create Gutbuster, a 70% indica-dominant hybrid that offers the mellowing effects that indica fans love.

name: Hades Haze
abstract: Hades Haze is a devilish bent on classic Haze genetics. Known for its rarity and indica-dominant nature, Hades Haze drops sedating weight on the consumer while still hazing the mind with a potent euphoria.

name: Haleigh’s Hope
abstract: Haleigh’s Hope is a high-CBD strain from Colorado named after a 4-year old with cerebral palsy and epilepsy.

name: Haole
abstract: Breeder Reserva Privada has taken the renowned sativa Maui Wowie and crossed it with the mainland’s LA Confidential to create Haole, a pleasant, calming strain that is well-suited to relieve stress and relax body pains.

name: Haoma
abstract: A cross between The Purps and Afghani, Haoma is a 70% indica strain with calming, stress-relieving qualities.

name: Haoma Mist
abstract: Haoma Mist crosses a Haoma indica with the hybrid Cannatonic, resulting in one THC-rich indica-dominant hybrid.

name: Hardcore OG
abstract: An indica-dominant cross between Big Bud and DJ Short Blueberry, Hardcore OG is a California strain bred with the stalwart cannabis veteran in mind.

name: Harle-Tsu
abstract: Harle-Tsu, bred by the Southern Humboldt Seed Collective, is a high-CBD hybrid cross between Harlequin and Sour Tsunami.

name: Harlequin
abstract: Harlequin typically has very high levels of CBD, making it good for pain relief and a favorite among medical marijuana patients.

name: Harley Storm
abstract: Harley Storm by Cannavative is a complex union of CBD-rich parent strains. By crossing Harle-Tsu and Thunderstruck, this aptly named strain takes on mild cerebral effects while remaining primarily medicinal.

name: Harley Twin
abstract: Harley Twin is a CBD-rich, sativa-dominant strain that inherits genetics from Harle-Tsu and Harlequin. This wellness oriented combination has an alert buzz that is maintained by its balanced THC/CBD ratio, encompassing the mind in soft haze while gently stimulating the body.

name: Harmony
parent_names: colombian gold lemon og kush lemon thai
abstract: Harmony is a hybrid that synchronizes the very best of Santa Marta Colombian Gold, Lemon OG Kush, and Lemon Thai.

name: Harry Potter
abstract: Harry Potter is an otherworldly hybrid strain that crosses Blissful Wizard with Fire Alien Kush.

name: Hash Plant
abstract: Named for its hashy taste, the Hash Plant marijuana strain has been a parent to many of the great Sensi Seeds hybrid strains.

name: Hashbar OG
abstract: Hashbar OG is a 70% indica-dominant hybrid that generates THC levels between 20% and 24%. While the smell of this strain is light, it still delivers a nice OG flavor when smoked.

name: Hashberry
abstract: Hashberry is an indica marijuana strain with a classic indica flavor and hashish undertones. Its thick stems are necessary to support the heavy buds, providing a classic aroma and flavor of mint or pepper.

name: Hashplant Haze
abstract: The uplifting high of the Hashplant Haze is enjoyable throughout the day due to it's being a sativa dominant strain

name: Hawaiian
abstract: Hawaiian is a mostly sativa cannabis strain that has creative, relaxing effects and a tropical fruit aroma.

name: Hawaiian Cookies
abstract: Hawaiian Cookies is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Hawaiian Snow and Girl Scout Cookies that first entered the scene in 2014.

name: Hawaiian Delight
abstract: Hawaiian Delight has a strong and musky aroma, hashy finish with a pleasant after taste.

name: Hawaiian Diesel
abstract: Hawaiian Diesel is a sativa cannabis strain that provides energetic effects. Flowers have a citrus and pine aroma and a sweet flavor.

name: Hawaiian Dream
abstract: Hawaiian Dream is an uplifting sativa strain that crosses Blue Dream with a Hawaiian variety.

name: Hawaiian Fire
abstract: Hawaiian Fire is a hybrid cannabis strain with sativa-dominant effects that make patients feel happy and social. This strain hails from Maui.

name: Hawaiian Haze
abstract: Hawaiian Haze is a sativa strain of cannabis that has a tropical, floral aroma. Plants are slower to flower at 12 to 14 weeks.

name: Hawaiian Punch
abstract: Originating in Hawaii, Hawaiian Punch delivers a "punch" not unlike the most righteous wave in Hawaii. This strain is extremely potent, yet delivers an aloha feeling to your mind and body, much like an ocean breeze.

name: Hawaiian Purple Kush
abstract: Hawaiian Purple Kush is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that brings together the flavors of the tropics and the potency of Afghan varieties.

name: Hawaiian Sativa
abstract: Hawaiian Sativa is a pure sativa cannabis strain that produces exceptionally long, citrus-smelling flowers. It may be effective in treating glaucoma.

name: Hawaiian Skunk
abstract: Hawaiian Skunk is a hybrid cannabis strain that tends towards sativa-dominant. It is prized for its high THC content and minimal growing difficulty.

name: Hawaiian Snow
abstract: Hawaiian Snow is a cross of Hawaiian Haze, Pure Haze and Neville's Haze.  This sativa marijuana has a complex taste and provides radiant highs.

name: Hawaiian Sunrise
abstract: Hawaiian Sunrise is a mysterious Hawaiian strain acquired by Colorado Seed Inc. while preparing their robust roster for the mainland. This strain is the mother of Hibiscus Sunrise, another potent cut by Colorado Seed Inc.

name: Hawai’i ‘78
abstract: Hawai’i ‘78 is a Hawaiian landrace sativa, also known as the "Sweet Lady of Waiāhole." This strain originated on the island of O’ahu, near where the film Jurassic Park was shot. According to sources, Hawai’i ‘78 even became a favorite with the production crew while on site.

name: Haze
parent_names: south american thai mexican south indian
abstract: The Haze variety of cannabis sativa is very potent and high in THC content. It's great for medicinal uses or social settings.

name: Haze Berry
abstract: A cross between Super Silver Haze and DJ Short’s famous Blueberry, Haze Berry is an 80% sativa hybrid.

name: Haze Heaven
abstract: Bred by Soma Seeds, Haze Heaven is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid whose classic genetics derive from Northern Lights #5, Haze, Afghani, and Hawaiian.

name: Haze Mist
abstract: Bred by Flying Dutchmen, Haze Mist is a sativa strain that was parented by a South Indian Skunk hybrid and a Haze male.

name: Haze Wreck
abstract: Haze Wreck is the “perfect storm” of sativa strains, as it unites the lineages of two legendary sativas, Haze and Trainwreck.

name: Head Cheese
abstract: Head Cheese combines the legendary strains 707 Headband and UK Cheese into a pungent and potent sativa-dominant hybrid.

name: Head Trip
abstract: Head Trip is an indica-dominant cross of Chocolate Trip and Snow Lotus bred by Bodhi Seeds.

name: Headband
abstract: Headband is a hybridized combination of OG Kush and Sour Diesel.

name: Headbanger
abstract: Headbanger, a winner of the 2013 Amsterdam Cannabis Cup, is a sativa dominant hybrid cross between Sour Diesel and Biker Kush.

name: Heaven Scent
abstract: Heaven Scent is a hybrid cannabis strain bred by MTG Seeds that crosses genetics from God’s Gift and Green Crack.

name: Heavy Duty Fruity
abstract: Double Duty Fruity is a hybrid marijuana strain that produces large flowers and yields both inside and outdoors. Effects can be psychedelic.

name: Heisenberg Kush
abstract: Heisenberg Kush is a cross of SC Blue Dream and Sin City Kush bred by Alphakronik Genes Seeds as part of their Great Minds series of genetics.

name: Hell Raiser OG
abstract: Hell Raiser OG, bred by Archive Seed Bank, is a 60% sativa hybrid cross between Fire OG and Face Off OG.

name: Hell's Angel OG
abstract: Hell’s Angel OG, or just Hells OG, is an indica-dominant strain that is said to contain OG Kush and Blackberry genetics.

name: Hellfire OG
abstract: Hellfire OG is a California hybrid strain that crosses Rascal’s OG Kush with SFV OG Kush.

name: Hemlock
abstract: A cross of Durban Poison and LA Confidential, Hemlock is a hybrid strain that smells of sweet grapefruit with a hint of ammonia.

name: Hempstar
abstract: Hempstar is a sativa cannabis strain that's a three-way cross between Skunk, Oasis, and Haze. It was bred by Dutch Passion Seeds.

name: Hercules
abstract: Hercules! Hercules! These hybrid buds are a blend of Hawaiian Urkle and Gupta Kush. A 60/40 sativa-dominant blend, Hercules offers the functional sedation of Kush with the mental alertness native to strong sativas.

name: Herijuana
abstract: Originally bred by Woodhorse Seeds, Herijuana is a combination of the highly regarded Humboldt County Afghan indica called Petrolia Headstash and an outdoor hybrid from Kentucky known only as the “Killer New Haven” strain.

name: Hibiscus Sunrise
abstract: Hibiscus Sunrise is Colorado Seed Inc.’s version of “beach chair weed.” This relaxing, clear headed indica-dominant hybrid emanates chill vibes made for bright days.

name: Higher Power
abstract: Higher Power is a cross between the hybrid strain Geezus and the sativa African Queen bred by Wild Oregon Weed.

name: Highwayman
abstract: Highwayman is a cross of William’s Wonder and Tang Tang created by Colorado breeder Tierra Rojo and supposedly named in honor of Willie Nelson.

name: Himalayan Blackberry
abstract: Himalayan Blackberry by Soulshine Cannabis is a strain that blends earthy flavors with relaxed physical attributes. This indica-dominant cut combines Nepalese with North Indian and offers stoney effects that help relieve pain while imbuing the mind with subtle invigoration.

name: Himalayan Gold
abstract: Spawn from the Himalayan mountains, this plant has been known to grow up to 8 feet tall and smells of chocolate.

name: Hindu Kush
abstract: Hindu Kush will provide you with a calm, active mental state different than that of other Indicas.

name: Hindu Skunk
abstract: Hindu Skunk is a cross of Hindu Kush and Skunk #1.  Provides a smooth smoke and a strong mellow high.

name: Hippie Chicken
abstract: A cross between Blueberry and Alaskan Thunder Fuck, Hippie Chicken takes after its sativa parent in its giggly, energetic effects which are accented only slightly by the tingly, relaxing effects passed down by Blueberry.

name: Hippie Crippler
abstract: Hippie Crippler is a sativa-dominant hybrid marijuana strain that patients love for its sweet smell and uplifting effects.

name: Hoarfrost
abstract: Hoarfrost by Cabin Fever Seed Breeders is a pungent hybrid with incredible trichome production. By crossing the mysterious White Forest with Raskal’s own White Fire, CFSB created a stimulating cross with heady euphoria that is ideal for long conversations and afternoons full of imagination.

name: Hobbit
abstract: Hobbit by Kannabia Seeds is a resilient autoflowering variety with sweetness and strong elemental resistance. This strain has a sweet aroma that has been described as “strawberry candy” and an equally sweet smoke with latent earthy notes.

name: Hog's Breath
abstract: 2002 Cannabis Cup winner Hog's Breath is bred by legendary Hindu Kush and Afghani and provides an overall mind and body high.

name: Holland's Hope
abstract: Outdoor growers love Hollands Hope for its ability to produce great even during a wet summer. Full indica that provides a very heavy stone.

name: Hollywood OG
abstract: Hollywood OG from southern California is an indica-dominant hybrid that delivers strong cerebrally focused effects with a sweet, earthy flavor.

name: Holy Ghost
parent_names: satori amnesia haze pitbull durban poison
abstract: Holy Ghost is a harmony of attractive genetics that balance the relaxing nature of indicas with sativas’ cerebral activity.

name: Holy Grail Kush
abstract: Holy Grail Kush is an award-winning hybrid marijuana strain known for its high THC levels and complex kush aroma.

name: Honey Bananas
abstract: Honey Bananas from Elemental Seeds is a heavy-handed hybrid strain bred from Strawberry Banana and Honey Boo Boo.

name: Honey Boo Boo
abstract: An 80% indica by DNA Genetics, Honey Boo Boo is a limited edition strain that crosses a Bubba Kush mother with a Captain Krypt OG male.

name: Hong Kong
abstract: Hong Kong is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Sour Diesel and Sensi Star that exhibits both high yields and THC levels.

name: Hoodwreck
abstract: Developed in Mt. Hood, OR, by Valhalla Pharm, Hoodwreck is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross of Trainwreck and Purple Diesel.

name: Huckleberry
abstract: The Huckleberry hybrid cannabis strain is best known for its intense berry aroma and comes with relaxing sativa-dominant effects.

name: Huckleberry Hound
abstract: Huckleberry Hound is an obscure hybrid that has alleged roots in Blueberry and Chemdawg families. With notes of berry intermixed with a palatable melange of chemicals, this flower's bouquet is challenging but worthwhile.

name: Humboldt
abstract: Humboldt is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain named after California’s Humboldt County. It has a sweet aroma and gives an upbeat high.

name: Humboldt Dream
abstract: This strain takes the sensuous body high of the Purple Panty Dropper and adds the pseudo-stimulation of Blue Dream to elicit a mental aloofness.

name: Humboldt Headband
abstract: Unlike the traditional sativa-dominant Headband, Humboldt breeds in Purple Panty Dropper for its weighty indica genetics, resulting in a euphoric 75% indica-dominant strain that relieves aches and pains.

name: Hurkle
abstract: Bred by TGA Genetics, Hurkle is a hybrid cross between the high-CBD sativa Harlequin and a Querkle indica.

name: Hurricane
abstract: Hurricane is a 70/30 sativa-dominant hybrid from Colorado breeders Reserva Privada that combines the spicy Haze genetics of Panama Punch with the OG Kush flavors of the award-winning LA Confidential.

name: Hustler Kush
abstract: Hustler Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Greenworks out of Seattle, WA.

name: ICED Grapefruit
abstract: ICED Grapefruit by Female Seeds is a hybrid strain that brings together genetics from ICE and Grapefruit.

name: IG Kush
abstract: Imperial Genetics was created by the breeders who originally brought the OG Kush craze to California and Colorado from Florida.

name: Ice
parent_names: afghani shiva skunk northern lights skunk no. 1
abstract: Ice is a 50/50 hybrid with a powerful and heavy stone that will leave you feeling lazy for hours.

name: Ice Cream
abstract: This indica-dominant 60/40 strain bred by Paradise Seeds creates a great hybrid balance of effects.

name: Ice Queen
abstract: Ice Queen is a hybrid strain that crosses White Widow and Cinderella 99 in a sativa-heavy blend fit for royalty.

name: Ice Wreck
abstract: By combining two high-potency strains, Ice and Trainwreck, Crop King Seeds has created a real knockout of a hybrid that has tested at over 27% THC.

name: Iced Widow
abstract: This powerful indica combines the high THC content of ICE with the prized White Widow.

name: Illuminati OG
abstract: 3C Illuminati OG is a direct cut from Josh D’s 1996 Club 33 OG phenome and makes up the genetic backbone of many west coast cannabis varieties. In spite of its ubiquity, its origins remain a debatable mystery (as its name suggests).

name: In The Pines
abstract: From Aficionado Seeds comes In The Pines, a sativa-dominant strain bred by crossing Pineapple Thai, Master Kush, and Pineapple.

name: Incredible Bulk
abstract: Incredible Bulk is a mixture of three notable indicas. Big Bud combines with Super Skunk and Green Spirit to create the sweet earthy flavors of hash that usher in Incredible Bulk’s relaxing effects.

name: Incredible Hulk
abstract: Incredible Hulk is a sativa strain that harnesses the active and stimulating effects of its parent strains, Green Crack and Jack Herer.

name: Industrial Plant
abstract: To produce this hybrid Dinafem Seeds crossed Northern Lights with a selection of Skunk genetics. The result is a skunky, citrus aroma with hints of wood and spice that sweeten to fruity hints of bubblegum when ground into shake.

name: Ingrid
abstract: The Ingrid cannabis strain is a vibrant green, tightly bound indica that induces a strong body effect.

name: Irene OG
abstract: Irene OG is a sour-smelling hybrid strain that delivers a balance of cerebral energy and physical relief.

name: Iron Triangle
abstract: Iron Triangle is an indica-dominant hybrid originating within the humid geometry created by Jacksonville, Miami, and Tampa. This red-eye inducing strain exhibits an aroma of lemon and fuel.

name: Island Maui Haze
abstract: Island Maui Haze is a 75/25 sativa-dominant strain with effects that can creep up on you.

name: Island Sweet Skunk
abstract: Island Sweet Skunk is a Canadian marijuana strain that was bred from a popular skunk strain and produces an uplifting sativa buzz.

name: J's Famous Kush
abstract: J’s Famous Kush is a cross of three Northern Californian hybrids. The resinous colas carry a strong skunky smell and produce sweet earthy flavor, with notes of black pepper and hash.

name: J-27
abstract: J-27 is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that is good for patients looking for alert, focused effects. The strain originated in California.

name: J1
abstract: The J1 cannabis strain is a high-end, sativa-dominant hybrid that is highly favored by patients seeking uplifting, energetic effects.

name: JT15
abstract: JT15 is an indica Kush cross with a powerful onset and a deep, earthy, woody aroma.

name: Jack 47
abstract: Jack 47 combines two of the most sought-after varieties of cannabis: Jack Herer and AK-47. This super hybrid, bred by Sweet Seeds, is mostly sativa and carries the sweet, captivating aroma of Jack Herer.

name: Jack Diesel
abstract: Jack Diesel crosses two mainstays in the cannabis world, Jack Herer and NYC Diesel, to produce a pungent mix of floral and diesel aromas.

name: Jack Flash
abstract: Jack Flash is an offshoot of the legendary Jack Herer strain mixed with Skunk and Haze.  A very powerful indica-dominant strain with a pungent skunky smell.

name: Jack Frost
parent_names: jack herer white widow northern lights #5
abstract: Developed over 5 years with ancestors such as Jack Herrer, White Widow, Northern Lights #5 and Rainbow Kashmiri, Jack Frost has a THC content up to 22.5%.

name: Jack Haze
abstract: Jack Haze is a cross between Jack Herer and Super Silver Haze. This sativa is extremely potent and has intense psychoactive effects.

name: Jack Herer
abstract: Jack Herer is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that provides the perfect pairing of cerebral elevation and full-body relief.

name: Jack Skellington
abstract: Jack Skellington by TGA Genetics is a 70% sativa cross between Killer Queen and Jack the Ripper.

name: Jack Smack
abstract: Jack Smack by Ustad Seeds is an astonishingly powerful sativa. Known for its mind-warping rush of euphoria and heart-racing stimulation, Jack Smack is pure rocket fuel.

name: Jack Widow
abstract: Jack Widow is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between two award-winning strains, White Widow and Jack Herer

name: Jack Wreck
abstract: Jack Wreck is a potent sativa strain that combines two timeless classics, Jack Herer and Trainwreck.

name: Jack the Ripper
abstract: Jack the Ripper is a "killer" cannabis strain with a heavy lemon smell and lots of resin.

name: Jack's Cleaner
abstract: Jack’s Cleaner is a sativa-dominant hybrid with an overpowering lemon pungency and high potency.

name: Jack's Dream
abstract: Jack’s Dream is a stimulating hybrid with familiar flavors and gentle effects. This common sense cross of Jack Herer and Blue Dream offers the consumer an immediate rush of energy that crests into heady euphoria that encourages laughter.

name: Jackalope
abstract: Jackalope is a mostly sativa strain that crosses Chocolope and Black Jack in a flavorful combination of berry and chocolate confection.

name: Jacked-Up
abstract: Originally bred by Heroes of the Farm, Jacked-Up is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Jack Herer and Timewreck.

name: Jacky White
abstract: Jacky White is a 75% sativa strain bred by Paradise Seeds, who crossed the legendary Jack Herer sativa with a resinous White Widow hybrid.

name: Jah Kush
abstract: Jah Kush is a well-rounded hybrid strain of cannabis, favored for its distinct aroma and mellow effects.

name: Jahwaiian
abstract: Jahwaiian by Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalōlō Seed Bank is a tropical mashup of two legendary strains. By combining Lamb’s Bread genetics sourced directly from Nine Mile, St. Anne’s, Jamaica, and the “Sweet Lady of Waiāhole” (AKA Hawai’i ‘78), Pua Mana crafted an uplifting strain that harnesses the tropical vibes and aromas distinct to the Hawaiian and Caribbean coastlines.

name: Jamaican
abstract: Jamaican refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: Jamaican Dream
abstract: Jamaican Dream is a 90% sativa bred by Eva Seeds using Jamaican genetics, resulting in a sweet and energetic strain perfect for daytime use.

name: Jamaican Lion
abstract: Jamaican Lion is a high-CBD sativa strain with mildly psychoactive effects that stimulate creativity and focus without the loss of functionality.

name: Jamaican Pearl
abstract: Jamaican Pearl's sweet tropical taste and breezy effects make this sativa marijuana strain a favorite of experienced consumers.

name: Jamba Juice
abstract: Jamba Juice is a unique clone-only offering from Golden State Genetics.

name: Jane Doe
abstract: Jane Doe is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain of mystery origin that has a strong lemon scent and provides balanced hybrid effects.

name: Jasmine
abstract: Jasmin, or Yasmin, is a 70/30 indica-dominant hybrid bred by the Israeli medical cannabis supplier Tikun Olam.

name: Jawa Pie
abstract: Jawa Pie is a sumptuously minty cut by Ocean Grown Seeds. This indica achieves its unique bouquet of shortbread, lime, and menthol by combining CookieFam’s Key Lime Pie with Ocean Grown’s own Alien Rift.

name: Jazz
abstract: Jazz is the mysterious combination of a Mexican landrace from Oaxaca and an Iranian landrace indica. Even with its hot heritage, gardeners consistently note how well this strain grows in colder climates.

name: Jean Guy
abstract: Jean Guy is a sativa-dominant strain from Canada with intensely cerebral effects and a sour citrus smell.

name: Jedi Kush
abstract: Cali Connection’s Jedi Kush brings together the forces of Death Star and SFV OG, an indica alliance that will awaken both mind and body.

name: Jelly Roll
abstract: Jelly Roll is a sweet treat crafted by Colorado Seed Inc. to show off their wonderful Jellyroll (God Bud x Grapefruit) crossed against their yield powerhouse, Gupta Kush.

name: Jenni
abstract: Jenni is a sativa strain with a modest THC level that allows you to remain functional and productive throughout the day.

name: Jenny Kush
abstract: Jenny Kush is a hybrid cannabis strain named in memory of Jenny Monson, a cannabis activist who passed away in 2013.

name: Jesse's Girl
parent_names: black cherry og purple og kush
abstract: Jesse’s Girl by Peak Organics is the handcrafted indica-dominant cross of Black Cherry Kush and Purple OG.

name: Jesus
abstract: Jesus, not to be confused with Jesus OG, is a Seattle staple grown by Solstice.

name: Jesus OG
parent_names: hells angel og jack the ripper
