abstract: Jesus OG is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that is known to be a heavy producer and to have a relaxing effect when used.

name: Jet Fuel
abstract: The name Jet Fuel isn’t purely devoted to the sweet, pungent aroma of diesel fumes that this strain exudes, but also the high-energy jolt of uplifting sativa effects that eventually level off to provide a dream-like state of relaxation.

name: Jillybean
abstract: Jillybean was rated as one of the top 10 strains in 2007 by High times and has tangy orange and mango flavors. THC has been measured up to 17%.

name: Jimi Hendrix
parent_names: jack herer headband black cherry soda
abstract: There are many genetic combinations that fall under the name Jimi Hendrix, but this southern Oregon hybrid descends from Jack Herer, Headband, and Black Cherry Soda.

name: Jock Horror
abstract: Jock Horror is sativa-dominant a hybrid parented by Northern Lights and two other strains of the skunk and haze families.

name: Johnny’s Tonic
abstract: Johnny’s Tonic is a sativa-dominant California strain with a high CBD content.

name: Jolly Rancher
abstract: Not much is known about the California-bred hybrid Jolly Rancher, but this hybrid strain has nevertheless carved a name for itself among West Coast genetics.

name: Jr
abstract: Jr is an indica-dominant strain named after the tinge of black licorice in its aroma, with relaxing full body effects.

name: Juicy Fruit
abstract: Also known as Fruity Juice, this cannabis strain has a THC content of up to 15-20% and tastes similar to fruit punch.

name: Juicy Jack
abstract: Juicy Jack combines the tropical flavors of Juicy Fruit with the therapeutic attributes of Jack Herer. This hybrid is balanced between its indica and sativa heritage but its effects lean towards the creative, uplifting buzz associated with sativas.

name: Juliet
abstract: Juliet is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Cinderella 99 and NYC Diesel that uplifts mind and body with a sweet berry aroma.

name: Julius Caesar
abstract: The cannabis hybrid strain Julius Caesar provides powerful effects as implicated by its superior genetics.

name: Jungle Juice
abstract: Bred by Golden State Genetics, Jungle Juice is a hybrid strain that crosses Animal Cookies and their in-house Tangie male.

name: Jupiter OG
abstract: Jupiter OG is an extremely potent indica known for its high yields and dense bud. This strain has an overpowering fuel-like aroma.

name: K-Train
abstract: K train is a mostly indica strain of marijuana that is prized for both its muscle relaxation effects and its lucid mental buzz.

name: K1
abstract: K1 is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Durban Poison and LA Kush.

name: K2
abstract: K2's mellow flavors and powerful, long-lasting effects are sure to leave you at a higher elevation.

name: KC 33
abstract: KC 33, bred by KC Brains in Holland, is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid cross between Afghani, Haze, and a Ukrainian landrace strain.

name: KC 36
abstract: Cultivated by KC Brains, KC-36 is an indica strain bred specifically to flourish at high latitudes.

name: Kaboom
abstract: A cross of Jacks Cleaner and Vortex, this sativa-dominant strain gives you a speedy high that is also good for pain relief.

name: Kahuna
parent_names: super skunk jack herer afghan hawaiian
abstract: Kahuna is a 4-way cross that brings together a wide set of influences for a complex high.

name: Kaia Kush
abstract: Created by Apothecary Genetics, Kaia Kush is a 60% sativa cross between Super Silver Haze and OG Kush.

name: Kalalau Kush
abstract: Kalalau Kush is a stimulating sativa-dominant hybrid named for the beautiful Kalalau Valley on the garden island of Kaua’i. This flower smells of guava with herbaceous undertones. The flavor is tropical, exhibiting hints of mango and musky spice.

name: Kalashnikova
abstract: Kalashnikova is Green House Seeds’ hybrid of AK-47 and White Widow. It produces strong, long-lasting indica effects while maintaining a clear train of thought.

name: Kaleidos Dope
parent_names: sour lsd neville's haze fire og purple thai
abstract: Another banger from Snow High Seeds, Kaleidos Dope is a cross of a quick and frosty Sour LSD female with Snow High’s own OG Purple Fire Thai male.

name: Kali 47
abstract: Kali 47 is a mostly sativa strain that is characterized by sweet fruity flavors with hints of caramel.

name: Kali China
abstract: Kali China, bred by ACE Seeds, is a 75% indica strain that combines an uplifting Kali Mist with the potent China Yunnan.

name: Kali Dog
abstract: This OG Kush and Sour Diesel hybrid from Royal Queen Seeds is a powerful strain that has an overwhelming aroma of lemons and diesel fuel.

name: Kali Mist
abstract: A favorite strain among expert marijuana consumers.  Kali Mist provides a great sativa effect that relieves pain and PMS symptoms.

name: Kandahar
abstract: Kandahar, named after the homeland of its ancestor, is a 90% indica strain bred by the Ministry of Cannabis.

name: Kandy Kush
abstract: Kandy Kush is a favorite of DNA Genetics’ Reserva Privada line that combines two California classics, OG Kush and Trainwreck.

name: Kaptn’s Grand Dream
abstract: Kaptn’s Grand Dream is an indica-dominant hybrid steeped in genetic diversity. This particular strain crosses Granddaddy Purple, Lemon Kush, Blueberry, Grape Krypt OG, and Blue Dream to cherry-pick unique the cannabinoids that makes this strain as potent as it is flavorful.

name: Karma Bitch
abstract: Karma Bitch is a 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Rare Dankness using parent strains Skywalker OG and Nevil’s Wreck.

name: Katsu Kush
abstract: Katsu Kush, or just Katsu, is an indica cannabis strain that descends from the hardy Hindu Kush landraces.

name: Kaua’i Electric
abstract: Kaua’i Electric is a Hawaiian landrace sativa that has been cultivated on the Powerline trail near Mt. Wai’ale’ale, also known as the rainiest place on Earth. This hearty sativa exhibits a range of bright tropical colors and smells of passionfruit and guava.

name: Kelly Hill Gold
abstract: Cultivated by Joseph Arthur Botanicals in Colorado, Kelly Hill Gold is a 70/30 indica-dominant strain that crosses Acapulco Gold and Chemdawg 4.

name: Ken's Kush
parent_names: granddaddy purple og kush sour diesel
abstract: Ken’s Kush is a potent hybrid cannabis strain bred by Ken Estes that crosses Granddaddy Purple with OG Kush and Sour Diesel.

name: Kerala Krush
abstract: Kerala Krush by Flying Dutchmen is an 85% sativa strain that unites genetics from Skunk #1 and a South Indian sativa.

name: Key Lime Pie
parent_names: durban poison og kush cherry pie
abstract: Key Lime Pie from Burning Bush Nurseries is a gourmet phenotype of the superstar strain Girl Scout Cookies. Selected for its strong indica characteristics and heavy resin production, this dynamic hybrid boasts flavors of lime candy, mint, and spice that spark flavors of earth and chocolate when activated by heat.

name: Khalifa Kush
abstract: Khalifa Kush is a hybrid that was bred specifically for the rap artist Wiz Khalifa, who claims it descended from an OG strain.

name: Khola
abstract: Khola is a hybrid strain with Brazilian, Thai, and Dutch heritage. It grows well indoors and outdoors, flowering between 7 and 10 weeks.

name: Khufu
abstract: Khufu is an indica-dominant hybrid from The Devil’s Harvest Seed Company that combines Cheese, Afghani #1, and SFV OG genetics to excellent effect.

name: Kid N' Kookies
abstract: As a potent indica-dominant hybrid testing at over 22% THC, Kid n’ Cookies has a heavy, sedating high.

name: Kilimanjaro
abstract: Kilimanjaro is a pure sativa landrace from the mountain slopes of Kenya, where it was originally cultivated for use in hunting and religious practice by the native population.

name: Kill Bill
abstract: Kill Bill, a cleverly named cross between Killer Queen and Willy's Wonder, is a hybrid strain that seeks out and assassinates stress, pain, and appetite loss like a vengeful Uma Therman.

name: Killer Grape
abstract: A cross between Killer Queen and Querkle, Killer Grape is a heavy-handed 50/50 hybrid strain that deals a stupefying blast of cerebral euphoria and deeply relaxing effects.

name: Killer Queen
abstract: British Columbia native Killer Queen is a cross between G-13 and Cinderella 99. It’s a mellow strain that’s great for consumers on the go.

name: Killing Fields
abstract: Killing Fields is a sativa cannabis strain that was bred by Sannie’s Seeds in the Netherlands. It is known for a distinct sweet and spicy taste.

name: Kimbo Kush
abstract: Kimbo Kush from Exotic Genetix is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: King Cake
abstract: King Cake is a clone-only strain from Oregon growers Golden Beaver Farms that combines Ken’s Granddaddy Purple with Mystic Gem and was originally released under the name Disco Glitter.

name: King Kong
abstract: King Kong, a hybrid mothered by Ed Rosenthal Super Bud, has long-lasting effects that promote focus and pain relief.

name: King Louis XIII
abstract: King Louis XIII is a powerful indica-dominant strain with OG Kush lineage.

name: King's Bread
abstract: Said to be a sativa landrace from the Blue Mountains of Jamaica, the King’s Bread cannabis strain delivers mellowing and euphoric cerebral effects.

name: King's Kush
abstract: Bred from OG Kush and Grape, King Kush contains flavors of citrus, pine and kush. This strain comes across as sweet and sour with a powerful and tangy grape scent, as well as some hints of lavender.

name: Kiss
abstract: Formally Queso, this lucious hybrid was created in 2011 by Kannabia Seeds using Cheese and Afghani genetics. Kiss is a hybrid strain that provides powerful body effects and mood elevation.

name: Kiwiskunk
abstract: Kiwiskunk was introduced when a New Zealand Skunk variety met NYC Diesel, adding a little something extra to its flavor profile.

name: Kobain Kush
abstract: Kobain Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Pre-98 Bubba Kush with White Lotus. The goal of this breeding project, by Red Eyed Genetics, was to increase the yield, stretch, and overall vigor of the early Bubba Kush cutting to achieve shorter vegetative cycles and enhance the overall potency and bag appeal.

name: Kona Gold
abstract: Kona Gold is a sativa strain that has traveled far from its native origin, the volcanic soils of Hawaii’s Big Island.

name: Kong
abstract: Kong is an indica-dominant strain bred by Holy Smoke Seeds, who created this hybrid by crossing Motavation with a backcrossed White Russian.

name: Kool-Aid Smile
abstract: Kool-Aid Smile by Andromeda Strains is a deep purple cross of fruity parents. This robust resin-producing flower is the product of Purple Drink x Cherry Sauce and carries telltale notes of its complex lineage in both flavor and appearance.

name: Kosher Kush
abstract: Kosher Kush is the first commercial strain to be blessed by a Rabbi.

name: Kosher Tangie
abstract: Kosher Tangie, a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid, combines two award-winning strains from DNA Genetics, Kosher Kush and Tangie

name: Kraken
abstract: Producing big harvests and intensely euphoric effects, this monster of an indica lives up to its name.

name: Krishna Kush
parent_names: lavender big skunk korean afghani super skunk
abstract: Krishna Kush by Colorado Seed Inc. is a Kush grower’s dream. This stout, purple plant produces dense colas rich with glittering trichomes.

name: Kryptonite
abstract: With a THC content up to 25%, Kryptonite is capable of sending users into a deep indica medicated state.

name: Kuato
abstract: Bred by Terraform Genetics, Kuato’s resin-coated buds release a strong spicy aroma with an orange zest.

name: Kuchi
abstract: Kuchi is a hybrid bred by Devil’s Harvest Seed Company. It combines Exodus Cheese and SFV OG Kush to produce a sweet, tangy fruit flavor with a piney note from the Kush influence.

name: Kurple Fantasy
abstract: Kurple Fantasy is a mostly indica strain that delivers easy, relaxed euphoria alongside a sweet grape aroma.

name: Kush Cleaner
abstract: Kush Cleaner is an earthy, relaxing hybrid strain that combines Kush genetics with Jack’s Cleaner.

name: Kush Rise
abstract: Kush Rise by Colorado Seed Inc. is an odoriferous blend of tropical elements like citrus and greenery mixed with the pungent earth and gentle sweetness of quality ocean grown genetics. By combining Hawaiian Sunrise and Rug Burn OG, CO Seed Inc. has crafted a strain with a bright mental alertness coated in calming body buzz.

name: Kushadelic
abstract: Kushadelic mixes the potency of an indica with the cerebral energy of a sativa in this G-13 Haze and OG Kush cross.

name: Kushage
abstract: Kushage is a hybrid cannabis strain known to be a resilient plant that flowers at 10-11 weeks. When finished, its flowers are light green and smell like pine.

name: Kushashima
abstract: Kushashima is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Kushberry
abstract: Kushberry is the perfect blend of two West Coast flavors, Blueberry from Oregon and the OG Kush from LA.

name: L'Eagle Eagle
abstract: The L'Eagle Eagle hybrid is a blend of Candy Haze and Skunk #6 genetics.

name: L.A. Sunshine
abstract: L.A Sunshine is a designer strain by Darkhorse Genetics crafted for the cannabis comedy duo Cheech & Chong. Its complex heritage is a grab bag of genetic crosses, including Chem Soda F1 x Starfighter (Tahoe phenotype) x (Coal Creek Kush x Strawberry Diesel).

name: LA Chocolat
abstract: LA Chocolate, bred by DNA Genetics, is a 60/40 indica-dominant strain parented by their cherished LA Confidential indica and Chocolope sativa.

name: LA Confidential
abstract: LA Confidential cannabis is a hugely popular strain. It has a smooth and piney taste with a classic skunky aroma.

name: LA Kush
abstract: Originating in Los Angeles, California, LA Kush is a hybrid with obscure genetic roots. The general consensus is that it is a variety of OG Kush, and possibly a select phenotype of Abusive OG.

name: LA OG
abstract: LA OG is a potent variety of medical cannabis with an earthy taste and powerful head and body high.

name: LA Ultra
abstract: LA Ultra by Resin Seeds is a strong indica strain whose genetics are kept secret, but its breeders and name hint at a LA Confidential and MK Ultra cross.

name: LA Woman
abstract: LA Woman is a match of two multi-award winning strains by DNA Genetics, Martian Mean Green and LA Confidential.

name: LAPD
abstract: LAPD is a perfectly balanced hybrid named after parent strains, LA Confidential and Purple Diesel.

name: LSD
abstract: Known for it's psychedelic qualities, LSD cannabis strain has a THC level up to 24% and does well in most growing conditions.

name: LVPK
abstract: LVPK is an indica-dominant hybrid born from Purple Afghani and Hindu Kush. This strain features a strong head and body sensation.

name: La Niña
abstract: La Niña is a sativa-dominant hybrid crossed between Haze and White Widow.

name: Lady Liberty
abstract: Lady Liberty is a balanced 50/50 hybrid strain that delivers a strong blast of energized euphoria alongside a sweet grapefruit aroma.

name: Ladyburn 1974
abstract: Ladyburn 1974 is an indica-dominant hybrid crossed between Jack Herer and Ice Dream.

name: Lake of Fire
abstract: Lake of Fire is a hybrid of Gorilla Glue #4 and Kobain Kush bred by Red Eyed Genetics. The result is a heavily frosted, chocolate, and pine flavored mixture of diesel fumes that produce balanced effects that stimulate the mind while relaxing the body.

name: Lamb's Bread
abstract: Bright green and sticky, Lamb's Bread gives you energy and positive introspection.  Good stress reliever and helpful for depression sufferers.

name: Lambo OG
abstract: Lambo is a hybrid marijuana strain created by TH Seeds. This strain is built for outdoor growing and flowers in 8 weeks.

name: Lamborghini
abstract: Lamborghini, or just Lambo, is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that combines the upbeat, high-energy Lamb’s Bread with the relaxing and blissful qualities of Holy Grail Kush.

name: Larry Bird Kush
parent_names: sunset sherbet thin mint girl scout cookies
abstract: Larry Bird Kush is a nearly perfect 50/50 hybrid strain named after the famous Boston Celtics basketball player. This strain combines Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies from the famous west coast tastemakers Cookie Fam Genetics.

name: Larry OG
abstract: Larry OG is an Orange County indica cross between OG Kush and SFV OG. It produces an easy, happy body feeling.

name: Lashkar Gah
abstract: Lashkar Gah is a sedating indica landrace strain named after its geographic origin in south Afghanistan.

name: Laughing Buddha
abstract: Winner of the 2003 Cannabis Cup, Laughing Buddha is an extremely potent sativa from Amsterdam. This strain typically flowers between 10 and 12 weeks.

name: Lavender
parent_names: super skunk afghani hawaiian south asian indica
abstract: Lavender brings together a mashup of strains that span the globe from Afghanistan, Hawaii, Korea, the U.S., and Europe.

name: Lavender Haze
abstract: Lavender Haze is a hybrid marijuana strain that is identifiable by its purple-hued flowers and floral lavender aroma. This is a popular daytime strain.

name: Lavender Jones
abstract: Lavender Jones, also called Purple Jones, is a hybrid strain that expresses itself in vibrant hues of purple and green.

name: Le Silver Royale
abstract: Le Silver Royal is grown solely by Kleen Karma Gardens in Oregon. This wondrous cross of Green Queen and Super Silver Haze blends bright cerebral qualities with the hazy energy of its recessive Green Crack and Super Silver Haze genetics.

name: Leda Uno
abstract: A Cannabis Cup finalist in the sativa category, Leda Uno will undoubtedly raise your spirits.

name: Legalized OG
abstract: Legalized OG is a popularized cut of the famous OG Kush. This strain’s flavor is piney with fruity nuances that some might describe as grape or berry. The effects set in immediately and envelop the body from the head down with a sedating buzz that lingers and weighs on the body.

name: Legend OG
abstract: Legend OG is a presumed OG Kush phenotype that offers a fresh take on a classic. Known for tart, floral, and pungent terpenes, Legend OG stays true to its Kush background.

name: Legendary Lemon
abstract: Legendary Lemon is a sativa-dominant strain that blends two Mexican speed demons, Zacatecas and Oaxaca, with two zesty zingers, Lemon Skunk and Lemon Kush. This tangy bud hits hard with a strong cerebral buzz and offers whimsical euphoria that makes consumers feel light on their feet.

name: Lem Chem
abstract: Lem Chem is a potent hybrid that is both sweet and sour, with distinct fuel/chemical nuances in flavor that denote its Chemdawg parentage. The buds have deep green foliage and tan/rusty pistils that also demonstrate the Chemdawg in this strain. Anticipate uplifted, mood altering effects that settle in the limbs.

name: Lemon Alien Dawg
abstract: Lemon Alien Dawg comes from Alien Genetics, who crossbred an Alien Dawg female with Lemon Kush to create this pungent hybrid cannabis strain.

name: Lemon Bananas
abstract: Lemon Bananas is a hybrid strain that achieved fame in the 2015 SoCal Cannabis Cup when Dabblicious Extracts processed it into extract worthy of 1st place in the Best Hybrid Concentrate category.

name: Lemon Bubble
abstract: Lemon Bubble from Pheno Finder Seeds is an award-winning strain that combines Super Lemon Haze with Silver Bubble to create a potent sativa that is applauded for its emphasis on flavor.

name: Lemon Daddy
abstract: Lemon Daddy is a sativa-dominant cross between Super Lemon Haze and  Granddaddy Purple that promotes relaxation and focus.

name: Lemon Diesel
abstract: Reigning in as one of the Top Ten in the 2010 Emerald Cup, Lemon Diesel smells and tastes like citrus and pepper with effects that can "sneak up" on its consumer.

name: Lemon Drop
abstract: The Lemon Drop cannabis strain provides pleasant, mellow effects and has a sweet lemon candy taste.

name: Lemon Fire
abstract: Lemon Fire is a hybrid that won Best U.S. Concentrate in the 2014 Seattle Cannabis Cup by Mr. B Extracts.

name: Lemon G
abstract: Lemon G is a sativa daughter of Original G-13. A native of Ohio, this strain is happy, upbeat, and sociable.

name: Lemon Haze
abstract: Lemon Haze smells of lemon peels and appears yellow due to its amber hairs. Its THC content is about 15-20%.

name: Lemon Jack
abstract: Lemon Jack was born from Jack Herer and Lemon Kush. A potent sativa, this strain makes patients feel energized and focused.

name: Lemon Kush
parent_names: afghani south american lemon g master kush
abstract: Lemon Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid that is good for daytime use.  It has an intense lemon flavor and citrus scent.

name: Lemon Larry Lavender
abstract: Lemon Larry Lavender by Big Buddy Seeds is greater than the sum of its parts. The stunningly flavorful cross of Lemon Larry OG Kush and Lavender offers sweet citrus aromas overlaid by velvety floral terpenes.

name: Lemon Marmalade
abstract: Lemon Marmalade is a potent hybrid from Washington State, bred by Platinum Extracts. The strain was developed by crossing Deadhead OG with Cookie Dough, a select phenotype of Girl Scout Cookies. Caked with trichomes and radiating citrus and diesel fumes, Lemon Marmalade creates a complex flavor mix of lemon and piney Kush with subtle fruit undertones.

name: Lemon OG Haze
abstract: Lemon OG Haze by Nirvana is the sensible combination of its titular elements: Lemon OG and Haze. While Lemon OG contains weighty Kush elements that are kind on the body, the excess limonene and alpha-pinene lead the consumer into a state of mental alertness and euphoria.

name: Lemon OG Kush
abstract: Lemon OG is a lemony indica cross of Skunk and OG strains.

name: Lemon Pie
abstract: Lemon Pie from Leafs by Snoop is a sativa-dominant hybrid that will bring about relaxation and creativity.

name: Lemon Sativa
abstract: Lemon Sativa is an easy sativa that provides patients with a clear, focused experience while deeply relaxing the body.

name: Lemon Skunk
abstract: Lemon Skunk is a cross between two Skunks with phenotypes chosen for their zesty lemon characteristics.

name: Lemon Thai
abstract: Originally produced by Dutch Flowers, Lemon Thai is a sativa cross between a Thai and Hawaiian strain. Lemon Thai flowers in 10 weeks.

name: Lemon Walker OG
abstract: Lemon Walker OG is a hybrid strain that took first place in the concentrates category of the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Lemon Wreck
abstract: Lemon Wreck or Lemon Trainwreck is a sativa-dominant cross between Lemon Diesel and Trainwreck that features both a strong head and body sensation.

name: Lemonberry
abstract: Dabney Blue and Lemon Thai come together to produce Lemonberry by Fusion Seeds.

name: Lemonder
abstract: Lemonder is a body-heavy hybrid with an outstanding aroma. This strain is a cross of Soma Lavender and OG Kush, and offers alert mental clarity and relaxing physical effects. The buds glitter with trichomes and are tangled in orange/bronze hairs. Its aroma smells like lemon peel, pine needles, and a sprinkling of earthy spice.

name: Leonidas
abstract: Leonidas is a Super Silver Haze variation produced by Canadian LP Tweed that provides feelings of happiness and focus.

name: Lethal Purple
abstract: Lethal Purple is a vibrantly colored sativa-dominant hybrid first bred by Great White North Seeds in Canada.

name: Liberty Haze
abstract: Winner of the 2011 High Times Cannabis Cup, the Liberty Haze marijuana strain is popular for its fast flowering time and unique taste.

name: Lifesaver
abstract: Lifesaver is an indica-dominant cross between BOG Bubble and Subcool JCB that has a distinct candy taste and flowers within 8 weeks.

name: Light of Jah
abstract: Light of Jah is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain whose name is often used interchangeably with Jack Herer, but may also refer to a Jack Herer and Afghani hybrid.

name: Lime Green Skunk
abstract: Lime Green Skunk is a happy cross between Super Skunk and Northern Lights. This strain has vibrant, lime green leaves and a sweet, skunky taste.

name: Lime Purple Mist
abstract: Lime Purple Mist is an indica-dominant hybrid with deeply relaxing qualities that taper in slowly over time.

name: Lime Skunk
abstract: Lime Skunk, not to be confused with Lime Green Skunk, is the odoriferous offspring of DNA Genetic’s Lemon Skunk and Exotic Genetix’ Green Ribbon BX, and the latest offering from Cresco Labs.

name: Limon
abstract: Created by LivWell, Limon is a sativa-dominant strain that blends Sour Diesel, Strawberry Diesel, and NYC Diesel.

name: Lions Gate
abstract: Lions Gate is a mellow indica strain with a skunky aroma and long-lasting effects that radiate throughout the body.

name: Liquid Butter
abstract: Liquid Butter is a potent nighttime indica that is great for pain relief and appetite stimulation. This strain features a butter-like taste.

name: Liquid Gold CBD Vape Oil
abstract: Liquid Gold CBD Vape Oil is a Co2 extracted concentrate made for your G FarmaLabs vaporizer pen.

Little Devil
abstract: Developed by Tikun Olam in Israel, Little Devil is an indica-dominant strain with a high THC content.

name: Little Dragon
abstract: Little Dragon offers a more citrus-forward Kush experience, blending OG Kush, Colombian, and Thai genetics. While OG Kush anchors the physical effects with mid-level pain relief and a general heaviness in the limbs, the Central American and Southeast Asian genetics explode on the palate and offer complementary mental stimulation.

name: Locktite
abstract: Scents of citrus and diesel overwhelm you as you enjoy this tasty flower engulfed in trichomes.

name: Locomotion
abstract: Locomotion is a 70/30 indica-dominant strain by Heroes of the Farm.

name: Lodi Dodi
abstract: Lodi Dodi is a sativa-dominant hybrid popular in Washington State. Exclusively bred by The Clone Zone, the genetic heritage of Lodi Dodi is undefined and closely guarded. Lodi Dodi carries a sweet, unique flavor of tropical fruit and fresh wildflowers.

name: Logic Diesel
abstract: Created by GroundSwell Cannabis Boutique in Denver, CO at the request of world-renowned electronic/acid jazz musician DJ Logic, Logic Diesel is a cross between Mystic Kush and NYC Diesel.

name: Longbottom Leaf
abstract: Longbottom Leaf is the name of the pipe-weed the hobbits of Middle Earth would enjoy between meals. This sweet, slightly stimulating sativa-dominant hybrid is a mix of Jack’s Cleaner and SFV OG. Longbottom Leaf hits the head immediately, delivering lung expansion and a mental sizzle that settles into the body and leaves the consumer in state of alert tranquility.

name: Lost Coast OG
abstract: Lost Coast OG is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid that marries Chemdawg 4 genetics with those of two age-old heirloom strains, Pakistani Kush and Lemon Thai.

name: Loud Dream
abstract: The mostly sativa Loud Dream from Loud Seeds was created by backcrossing a Blue Dream F1 with itself for a stable female seed.

name: Loud Scout
abstract: Loud Scout is an award-winning hybrid from Loud Seeds. By crossing Girl Scout Cookies with Platinum OG Kush, Loud Seeds created a potent and complex mix of sweet, floral flavors that took 1st place for Hybrids at the 2012 Cannabis Cup in Amsterdam.

name: Love Potion #1
abstract: Love Potion #1 is a 70% sativa strain bred by Reeferman Seeds through crossing G13 and Colombian Gold.

name: Love Potion #9
abstract: Love Potion #9 is an indica-dominant strain with a sweet, fruity flavor and potent effects best suited for evening use.

name: Lowryder
abstract: Lowryder is a hybrid strain that was inbred for nine generations by Joint Doctor Seeds to give it a dwarfed size.

name: Loyalty
parent_names: og kush animal cookies cherry pie
abstract: Loyalty is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by TSL Farms in Los Angeles.

name: Luca Brasi
abstract: Luca Brasi is the indica-dominant hybrid of heavy hitters Corleone OG and Pre-98 Bubba Kush. This potent combination creates a strain with a nearly 1:1 THC/CBD ratio which lends itself to all manner of physical wellness.

name: Luca Brasi x Sour Diesel
abstract: A strain bred with medical patients in mind, Luca Brasi x Sour Diesel is a sativa-dominant hybrid rich in CBD.

name: Lucid Bolt
abstract: Lucid Bolt is a functional indica-dominant hybrid bred to brighten the mind and relax the body. These genetics were cultivated by Paradise Seeds and have become exceptionally popular with all-day consumers seeking a strain that is mentally alert but kind on the extremities.

name: Lucid Dream
abstract: Lucid Dream is a dynamic blend of Amnesia Haze and Blue Dream. This sativa-dominant hybrid provides a stimulating mix of uplifting Haze effects with the sweet blueberry notes of Blue Dream.

name: Lucky Charms
abstract: Lucky Charms from Bodhi Seeds is potent hybrid cross between The White and Appalachia.

name: Lucy
abstract: Lucy is a robust indica-dominant CBD-rich strain created from crossing Luca Brasi and LA Confidential. This strain packs a ton of cannabinoids into a tiny package, rendering THC and CBD content above 10% each. With this potent ratio, you can expect to feel an intense sense of wellbeing that isn’t overwhelmingly sedative.

name: M-39
abstract: M-39 is a cannabis strain with a fast flowering time and a THC content of up to 16.5%.

name: MILF
abstract: MILF, also known as MILF Weed, from Mother Chucker’s Seeds takes its name from an acronym for Marijuana I’d Like to Flower.

name: MK Ultra
abstract: MK Ultra is a very strong variety of cannabis indica. Named after mind control experiments done by the U.S. government, this strain will definitely control your mind.

name: Mad Dawg
abstract: Mad Dog is a hybrid strain that delivers euphoric relaxation and a subtle, uplifting jolt of cerebral energy.

name: Mad Scientist
abstract: Mad Scientist, or Mad.S, by Sannie’s Seeds is an indica-dominant concoction that combines Herijuana and White Widow genetics.

name: Madagascar
abstract: Madagascar is an indica cannabis strain that produces a heavy body sensation that will easily put patients to sleep.

name: Madcow
abstract: Madcow descends from two high-energy sativas, Durban Poison and Purple Cow. With a heavy blanket of crystal resin, this strain is a solid choice for veteran consumers and for making concentrates.

name: Madman OG
abstract: Another excellent hybrid from Southern California breeders Ocean Grown Genetics, Madman OG combines LA Confidential with OG Kush to create a powerful and delicious indica.

name: Madzilla
abstract: Madzilla is an indica that crosses King Louis XIII and Skywalker. Its big bulbous colas are an array of dark green hues with bright orange pistils and a thick layer of sticky trichomes.

name: Magic Beans OG
abstract: Magic Beans OG is a sticky indica strain with heavy, relaxing effects. Known for its weighted sensation on the body and earthy, sweet aroma, Magic Beans OG is a soothing strain with a gentle, herbaceous palate.

name: Magic Jordan
abstract: Magic Jordan is another mysterious Hawaiian cut from Colorado Seed Inc. While its specific genetic lineage is unknown, the testing results on this flower illustrate an unusually high concentration of CBG, which may benefit patients treating sleeping disorders and other conditions.

name: Magnum
abstract: Magnum takes predominantly after its sativa parent when it comes to effects, producing fits of laughter and a euphoric cerebral blast.

name: Magnum PI
abstract: Magnum PI is a sativa-dominant strain with its genetic origins cloaked in a Hawaiian shirt of pure mystery. This stimulating cross, supposedly created by Seahorse Gardens near the Puget Sound, exhibits hints of citrus and sweet earth on the nose.

name: Mai Tai Cookies
abstract: Mai Tai Cookies is a CBD-rich hybrid strain bred by Terraform Genetics, who crossed Alien Orange Cookies and ACDC.

name: Majestic 12
abstract: 3C Majestic 12 satisfies all the requirements of a delicious ‘purple’ strain. Leaves of violet and purple? Check. Dense with frosty trichomes and orange pistols? Check. Deep, sweet earthy flavor? Check. Extremely relaxing on the mind and body? Check.

name: Mako Haze
abstract: Mako Haze is a sativa strain of cannabis that is known for an energetic high. Plants have a longer flowering time but produce high yields.

name: Malakoff
abstract: Bred by Medical Seeds Co., Malakoff is an 80/20 sativa-dominant strain that crosses Strawberry Haze and White Widow.

name: Malawi
abstract: Malawi is a pure sativa strain that comes from the Salima region of Malawi in southeast Africa.

name: Mammoth
abstract: This hybrid from The Bank Cannabis Genetics is a cross between the sativa-dominant Snowcap and indica-dominant LA Confidential.

name: Mandala #1
abstract: Bred by Mandala Seeds, Mandala #1 is a hybrid strain with genetic roots in South Africa, New Zealand, and Northern India.

name: Mango
abstract: The Mango cannabis strain has been around since the 1960s and was improved in 1991 when crossed with KC33. Tasting and smelling of the mango fruit, this strain has a THC content up to 20%.

name: Mango Dream
abstract: Mango Dream is a sativa cannabis strain that provides patients with a burst of energy and an uplifted mood.

name: Mango Haze
abstract: Mango Haze is a mostly sativa strain bred by Mr. Nice Seeds, who crossed Northern Lights #5, Skunk, and Haze to create this uplifting, fruity variety.

name: Mango Kush
abstract: Tasting and smelling like a mango, the Mango Kush marijuana strain is covered with orange pistils and can grow up to 5 feet tall.

name: Mango Tango
abstract: Mango Tango is a hybrid cannabis strain by Elemental Seeds whose crushing indica effects dance with a pungent, fruity flavor profile.

name: Manitoba Poison
abstract: Manitoba Poison is a 50/50 hybrid with heavy indica effects that vastly outweigh its sativa counterpart.

name: Maple Leaf Indica
abstract: The taste of Maple Leaf Indica is sweet and citrusy.  This strain has been known to act as an aphrodisiac and gives off a very relaxing and sensational body buzz.

name: Maramota #10
parent_names: dj short blueberry g13 hash plant
abstract: Maramota #10 is a concoction of DJ Short’s Blueberry mixed with a cross of G13 and Hash Plant.

name: Margaret Cho-G
abstract: Comedian Margaret Cho makes her move into the cannabis game with Margaret Cho-G, a cut of the famous OG Kush available in Bay Area, California.

name: Marionberry Kush
abstract: Like the fruit it is named for, Marionberry Kush is a delicious hybrid bred in Oregon. A well-balanced cross of Raspberry Kush and Space Queen that puts off a full spectrum of fruity flavors, Marionberry Kush closely resembles her genetic “sister” Cinderella 99.

name: Marley's Collie
abstract: Marley's Collie is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Sensi Seeds that won the Dutch High Life Cup in 1999.

name: Mars OG
abstract: Mars OG is a heavy-bodied indica from the California Bay Area. This strain has a high flower-to-leaf ratio and a pungent smell.

name: Martian Candy
abstract: Martian Candy (also known as Martian Candy OG) is a indica-dominant hybrid with an aroma that is out of this world. This strain smells rich with herbaceous notes and just a hint of eucalyptus. It leans heavily on the body, lowering the eyes immediately after the first puff.

name: Martian Mean Green
abstract: Martian Mean Green is a combination of Sharksbreath and G13 Haze.  One of DNA Genetics' flagship strains, it has a super pungent aroma and consciousness-altering effects.

name: Master Bubba
abstract: Master Bubba is a potent indica cannabis strain that is known to be an effective pain reducer and sleep aid.

name: Master Jedi
abstract: Master Jedi is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that promotes body relaxation. It has the distinct aroma of kush strains.

name: Master Kush
abstract: Master Kush provides a pleasing and relaxing body buzz but not overly sleepy.

name: Master OG
abstract: Master OG is an indica-dominant strain that crosses Master Kush and Empress Kush.

name: Master Skunk
abstract: Master Skunk by Mr. Nice Seeds is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Master Kush with Skunk #1.

name: Master Yoda
abstract: Master Yoda is an award-winning cannabis strain that originally gained popularity in Los Angeles. It is a kush strain with high THC levels.

name: Matanuska Thunder Fuck
abstract: Matanuska Thunder Fuck is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that hails from Alaskan genetics and has a signature chocolate aroma.

name: Mau-Mau
abstract: Mau-Mau is a hybrid from Irie Vibe Seeds that crosses an indica-dominant Blockhead female with a Killer Queen male.

name: Maui
abstract: Maui is a head-heavy sativa related to other Hawaiian strains. This tropical number emits a floral smell with a musky taste.

name: Mau-Mau
abstract: Mau-Mau is a hybrid from Irie Vibe Seeds that crosses an indica-dominant Blockhead female with a Killer Queen male.

name: Maui
abstract: Maui is a head-heavy sativa related to other Hawaiian strains. This tropical number emits a floral smell with a musky taste.

name: Maui Bubble Gift
parent_names: god's gift bubble gum maui wowie
abstract: Maui Bubble Gift is an indica-dominant hybrid strain whose known parent strains include Bubble Gum and a Maui Wowie/God’s Gift hybrid.

name: Maui Citrus Punch
abstract: Maui Citrus Punch is an exquisitely fruity strain that combines the best of Maui Dawg and Tangelo Kush. These parent strains come together to create a cross that is pleasurable to nearly all the senses, exhibiting bright citrus notes with funky skunky undertones. The flavor holds on to the citrus and slight earthiness that slowly morphs into a high energy euphoria which settles in the body.

name: Maui Haole
abstract: Maui Haole is a balanced hybrid that combines the sweet, tropical flavors of Maui Wowie with Romulan’s full-bodied relaxation. Bred by Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalōlō Seed Bank, Maui Haole takes powerful influence from the original Romulan Joe cut of Romulan.

name: Maui Mango Diesel
abstract: Maui Mango Diesel is a sativa-dominant hybrid of Maui Wowie and Brooklyn Mango bred by Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalōlō Seed Bank. The Maui Waui father was sourced from Lower Nāhiku Maui, while the mother is Dr. Underground’s Brooklyn Mango.

name: Maui Pineapple Chunk
abstract: Maui Pineapple Chunk is a 50/50 hybrid bred by Pua Mana Seeds, who crossed Pineapple Chunk with their Nāhiku Maui Wowie to create this balanced Hawaiian strain.

name: Maui Wowie
abstract: This Hawaiian legend will give you energy and inspiration.  The soaring sativa high will make you feel as happy as if you were relaxing on a tropical beach.

name: Mazar I Sharif
abstract: Grown in the far north of Afghanistan, Mazar-i-Sharif has a spicy and earthy taste that produces a very good up high.

name: Mazar Kush
abstract: Mazar Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Afghani and Mazar-I-Sharif, two age-old indica strains originating from the Afghanistan-Pakistan region.

name: Mean Misty
abstract: Mean Misty is a fruity hybrid with quality mental and physical effects. Brought to life through the genetic cross of Secret Recipe and Blue Dream, Mean Misty emanates a strong berry aroma with earthy elements that speak to its OG heritage.

name: MediHaze
abstract: MediHaze (or CBD Medi Haze) is an 80/20 sativa-dominant strain bred by CBD Crew that crosses genetics from Super Silver Haze, Neville’s Haze, and an undisclosed CBD-rich parent.

name: Medibud
abstract: Medibud (or Medi Bud) is an uplifting hybrid strain of unknown genetic origins, but many attribute its upbeat, active effects to sativa parentage.

name: Medicine Man
abstract: Medicine Man is a hybrid marijuana strain that is prized for its therapeutic properties in the treatment of many medical conditions.

name: Medicine Woman
abstract: Medicine Woman is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid strain from renowned Oregon medical cannabis grower David Verstoppen.

name: Medusa
abstract: Medusa mixes smooth, sweet flavors with an earthy aroma of fresh blueberries to create a compelling hybrid.

name: Mega Jackpot
abstract: Mega Jackpot is a sativa-dominant hybrid that mixes genetics from Jack Herer, Northern Lights, and Haze. The three-way combination creates a potent strain with flavors of grape and vanilla.

name: Mekamika Haze
abstract: Mekamika Haze won Best Sativa at the 2015 Amsterdam Unity Cup. This pure landrace sativa supposedly hails from the Amazon and shares genetics with another mysterious strain, Mango Rossa (Manga Rosa from Brazil).

name: Melon Gum
abstract: Melon Gum was born with the crossing of Lavender and Bubble Gum, who pass on a combination of sweet, fruity flavors and vibrant bud coloration.

name: Memory Loss
abstract: Memory Loss is a fast-finishing 70% sativa hybrid from Archive Seed Bank that smells very much like a Dutch Haze, with a strong, peppery incense odor and undertones of bubblegum and fruit,

name: Mendo Breath
abstract: Mendo Breath is an interesting mix of OGKB (OGKushBreath, which is the supposed patriarch in the Cookies Fam genetics) and Mendo Montage.

name: Mendocino Purps
abstract: Also known as Mendo Purps or The Purps, Mendocino Purps was a Top Ten winner in 2007 as a High Times Strain of the Year.

name: Mercury OG
abstract: Mercury OG is an indica cannabis strain that is favored for its powerful effects that provide clarity and heightened sensing.

name: Merlot OG
parent_names: larry og grape ape blackberry rhino sfv og
abstract: SoCal cannabis breeders Ocean Grown Seeds originally designed the Merlot OG in 2006 as an attempt to create an OG Kush-type plant with deep purple colors by crossing Larry OG and Grape Ape.

name: Mexican
abstract: Mexican refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: Mexican Sativa
abstract: Mexican Sativa is a cannabis strain that has been bred to bring out all the best sativa effects of the plant, especially its uplifting high.

name: Michael Phelps OG
abstract: Michael Phelps OG is a hybrid strain that no doubt carries OG Kush genetics, but other ancestry remains uncertain.

name: Mickey Kush
abstract: Micky Kush is a 75% sativa cross between Sweet Irish Kush and Jack The Ripper.

name: Middlefork
abstract: Middlefork is a hybrid strain from Washington state that unites two flavorful parents, DJ Short Blueberry and Dutch Treat.

name: Middlefork x Pineapple Express
abstract: Middlefork x Pineapple Express is a 75% sativa strain from western Washington, bred to contain a sweet, fruity flavor and heavy resin production.

name: Midnight
abstract: Midnight, a popular strain in Israel, is a sativa-dominant variety developed by Tikun Olam to treat nausea.

name: Milky Way
abstract: Milky Way is an 80/20 indica-dominant blend bred by Kiwiseeds. Named for the milky white trichomes that cover its buds and sugar leaves, Milky Way has a sweet aroma with flavors of sugar and spice.

name: Millennium
abstract: Named after the idea that it will be around for many years, millennium is a balanced hybrid with 75% indica from the mountains of Iran crossed 25 percent with a Niagara/Shiva sativa. Easy to grow indoors and outdoors.

name: Misty Kush
abstract: Misty Kush is an indica cannabis strain that has surprisingly upbeat effects. Plants have a strong, stinky odor.

name: Misty Morning
abstract: Misty Morning is a sweet creeper crafted by the fine folks at Colorado Seed Inc. This slow-moving strain crawls over the body like mist, gently subduing aches and pains with a subtle yet tangible potency. By crossing Sugar Cane and Gupta Kush, CO Seed Inc. fashioned a stable indica-dominant strain with quality medicinal benefits and inspiring trichome production, making it suitable for patients and consumers with a higher THC tolerance.

name: Mob Boss
abstract: Released in 2009 by Grindhouse Medical Seeds, Mob Boss is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred from ChemDawg D and Tang Tang.

name: Moby Dick
abstract: Moby Dick is an award-winning sativa-dominant cannabis strain bred by Dinafem Seeds. It is a cross of the popular White Widow and Haze strains.

name: Moloka’i Frost
abstract: Moloka’i Frost (also known as Moloka’i Hashplant) is a potent sativa-dominant strain with a robust medicinal history. In 1969, residents of the Lalaaupapa Moloka’i leper colony were allowed to leave and access modern medicine. But a special medicine also left the Kalawao Valley (pronounced ka-la-wow), too.

name: Moloka’i Purpz
abstract: Moloka’i Purpz is a luscious Hawaiian landrace strain from the island of Moloka’i. With deep purple hues and an aroma so rich with grape and berry that some might say it even “smells purple,” Moloka’i Purpz delivers sedating effects ideal for those suffering from insomnia and stress. Anticipate a flavor as rich as the smell, with notes of exotic berry and grape intermixed with a sweet skunkiness.

name: Money Maker
abstract: Breeder Strain Hunters has mixed the potency and vitality of Master Kush and Hindu Kush in combination with the vigorous growth and sweet flavors of Skunk #1 to form an indica-dominant cross that can be appreciated by cultivators and connoisseurs alike.

name: Monkey Paw
abstract: Monkey Paw takes its name from its fingerling buds that resemble the curled paws of primates. It is a fabled old school strain whose roots sprouted in Michigan and has built a solid reputation for itself across the Midwest.

name: Monolith
abstract: Monolith is an indica-dominant strain with Afghan roots that stretch back to the 1980s. This indica exhibits a pungent aroma that has an earthy, herbaceous core glazed with stinky-sweet terpenes powerful enough to clear a room.

name: Monster Cookies
abstract: Monster Cookies is an 80% indica cross between Girl Scout Cookies and Granddaddy Purple that delivers a jarring dose of euphoria and relaxation.

name: Monster OG
abstract: Monster OG from The Green Element is a hybrid strain that crosses a heavy OG indica with an OG Kush and SFV OG hybrid.

name: Montana Silvertip
abstract: Montana Silvertip is a Granddaddy Purple and Silver Haze hybrid cross that inherits the name of its homeland.

name: Moondance
abstract: Inheriting genetics from Super Silver Haze, Neville’s Haze, and an unknown CBD-rich parent, Moondance is a variation of the better-known MediHaze sativa.

name: Moonshine Haze
abstract: Moonshine Haze by Rare Dankness Seeds is a mostly sativa strain bred by combining Nevil's Wreck and Amnesia Haze.

name: Moonwalker Kush
abstract: Moonwalker Kush is a balanced indica-dominant hybrid that is the genetic cross of Triple OG and Tahoe Alien. This odoriferous combination speaks volumes through its scent, which is thick with soured earth and a hint of pepper on the finish.

name: Moose and Lobsta
abstract: Moose and Lobsta is a 70% sativa-dominant hybrid that produces heavy yields of high-potency flowers in about nine to ten and a half weeks of flowering.

name: Morning Star
abstract: Morning Star has as much as 24% THC content, provides an uplifting and mind-expanding high.

name: Mossad
abstract: Mossad is a hybrid strain bred by Terraform Genetics, who crossed a Conspiracy Kush male with the Kosher Kush female.

name: Mossimo OG
abstract: Mossimo OG is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Motavation
abstract: Motavation, first bred by Magus Seeds, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain that combines genetics from Sensi Star and Warlock.

name: Mother Tongue
abstract: Mother Tongue is a vibrant 70/30 sativa-dominant strain bred by JinxProof Genetics.

name: Mother of Berries
abstract: Mother of Berries, or M.O.B., is an indica strain from Maine that provides a deeply relaxing experience that transitions well into restful sleep.

name: Mother's Milk
abstract: Mother’s Milk is the sativa-dominant hybrid of Nepali OG and Appalachia. This potent strain smells of powdered milk and delicate earthy terpenes and is layered in a coat of sparkling trichomes.

name: Mother’s Finest
abstract: Mother’s Finest, brought into existence by Sensi Seeds, is a 70% sativa-dominant strain with heavy Haze genetics.

name: Mother’s Helper
abstract: Mother’s Helper is a 50/50 hybrid cross between the sativa Chocolope and a Northern Lights #5 indica.

name: Mr. Nice
abstract: Mr. Nice is named in honor of Howard Marks who was one of the biggest marijuana smugglers of our time.  This indica-dominant cannabis strain has extremely dense buds with a sweet smell.  An easy smoke that provides a strong and very mellow high.

name: Mr. Tusk
abstract: Mr. Tusk is a phenotype of Ken's OG Kush, grown specially by Kushman Veganics for the release of Kevin Smith's film Tusk.

name: Ms. Universe
abstract: Ms. Universe from Dynasty Seeds is a sativa-dominant hybrid of their Des*tar strain crossed with Space Queen.

name: Mt. Cook
abstract: Named after the highest peak in New Zealand, Mt. Cook by Kiwiseeds is a former Cannabis Cup champion.

name: Mt. Hood Magic
abstract: Thought to be exclusive to Portland, Oregon dispensary Five Zero Trees, Mt. Hood Magic is a cross between Northern Lights #5 and Durban Poison.

name: Mt. Rainier
abstract: This hybrid is great for daytime use, but don’t overdo it if you intend to stay functional and productive.

name: NL5 Haze Mist
abstract: NL5 Haze Mist by Green House Seeds is a classic sativa-dominant strain that mixes genetics from Northern Lights #5, Haze, and Kali Mist.

name: NY Cheese
abstract: NY Cheese, a rumored hybrid cross between Cheese and NYC Diesel, provides cerebrally-focused euphoria that stimulates creativity, conversation, and a positive mood.

name: NY-47
abstract: NY-47 is a potent, sativa-leaning blend that combines NYC Diesel with AK-47 and provides balanced effects.

name: NYC Diesel
abstract: NYC Diesel by Soma Sacred Seeds is a 60% sativa-dominant cross between Sour Diesel and an Afghani/Hawaiian male.

name: NYPD
abstract: NYPD, or New York Power Diesel, is a 70/30 sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Nirvana Seeds, who crossed Aurora Indica with a Mexican sativa called Eldorado.

name: Narnia
abstract: Narnia, a strain produced by Soulshine Cannabis and developed by Advanced Growing Technologies, is the stimulating sativa-dominant cross of Jack Herer and Trainwreck. It has an incredibly fast onset, imbuing consumers with an amplified sense of their imaginations while promoting upbeat physical activity.

name: Nebula
abstract: Nebula is an award-winning cannabis strain with a psychedelic buzz and a honey-filled smell and taste.

name: Nebula II CBD
abstract: Nebula II CBD was bred as a collaboration between Paradise Seeds and the CBD Crew. The 60/40 sativa-dominant strain was bred for its high concentrations of CBD which hover around 7%.

name: Negra 44
abstract: Negra 44, a cross between Top 44 and African landrace strains, is an indica strain bred by R-Kiem Seeds in Spain.

name: Nepalese
abstract: Nepalese refers to any strain that grows natively in the Nepal region.

name: Nepalese Jam
abstract: Bred by ACE Seeds, a Nepalese female plant was crossed with a Jamaican ’85 male to create this hybrid, Nepalese Jam.

name: Neptune Kush
abstract: Neptune Kush is a classic indica cannabis strain that induces a relaxing sedation optimal for stress and anxiety relief.

name: Neptune OG
abstract: Neptune OG is a potent indica cannabis strain that sets itself apart by its euphoric onset, smooth delivery, and earthy aroma.

name: Nevil's Wreck
abstract: The sativa-dominant Neville’s Wreck from Rare Dankness Seeds crosses Arcata Trainwreck and Neville’s Haze in a spicy, floral fusion.

name: Neville's Haze
abstract: Neville's Haze won the Cannabis Cup in 1998 and has a THC content up to 21%.

name: Nexus OG
abstract: Nexus OG is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Nice Cherry
abstract: Nice Cherry is an indica-dominant strain that captures the flavorful qualities of its Cherry parent and the relaxing attributes of Mr. Nice.

name: Nicole Kush
abstract: Nicole Kush is a 75/25 indica-dominant strain that will satisfy your need for potency as well as flavor.

name: Night Nurse
abstract: Night Nurse is an indica-dominant strain from Reeferman Seeds that combines genetics from BC Hash Plant, Harmony, and Fire OG.

name: Night Terror OG
abstract: Night Terror OG sways heavily toward the indica side of the spectrum, inducing relaxing effects that sink deeper in the body over time.

name: Night Train
abstract: Night Train is an indica-dominant cross between Jasmine and Trainwreck released by Elemental Seeds in California.

name: NightFire OG
abstract: NightFire OG by Sin City Seeds is a sativa-dominant hybrid that descends from parent strains White Fire OG and White Nightmare.

name: Nightmare Cookies
abstract: The commonsense cross of White Nightmare and Girl Scout Cookies, Nightmare Cookies is a hybrid strain that locks the consumer to the couch while delivering robust, uplifting euphoria. Nightmare Cookies exhibits beautiful purple hues, bright orange pistils, and an aroma that is thick with pine sap, earth, and sweetness.

name: Nina Limone
parent_names: super lemon haze rebel god smoke
abstract: Nina Limone by Colorado Seed Inc. is a stimulating citrus-heavy cross of Super Lemon Haze and Rebel God Smoke. While this strain produces beautiful, rich nuggets of hard, resinous flower, the yield is small and unsuitable for mass production, but may still be found in special, rare quantities. Instead, CO Seed Inc.

name: Ninja Fruit
abstract: Ninja Fruit by Ocean Grown Seeds is a hybrid strain with fruity flavors and massive trichome production. By crossing Grapefruit Haze with Grape Ape (by Stoned Ninja), Ocean Grown Seeds created a cerebral, uplifting strain that stimulates creativity, good conversation, and appetite.

name: Nordle
abstract: Nordle, named after Howard Marks’ code word for “hashish,” is a high-CBD indica cross between Afghani and Sensi Star.

name: North American Indica
abstract: North American refers to any strain that grows natively in this region.

name: North American Sativa
abstract: North American refers to any strain that grows natively in this region.

name: North Indian
abstract: North Indian refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis (or landraces) that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: Northern Berry
abstract: Meet Northern Berry, daughter to the power couple Northern Lights #5 and Blueberry who delivers a complex balance of cerebral and body effects.

name: Northern Cross
abstract: Northern Cross by Glen’s Plant Farm is a combination of two sativa-dominant hybrids built for potency and trichome production. With dense buds that smell of bright citrus and earth, this Chernobyl x Permafrost pairing is dreamy and uplifting while imbuing the body with relaxed contentment.

name: Northern Lights
abstract: Northern Lights is a pure indica strain cherished for its resinous buds, fast flowering, and resilience during growth.

name: Northern Lights #5
abstract: Northern Lights #5 is in the popular Northern Lights family of cannabis strains.  Introduced in 1989 it has since won many awards at the Cannabis Cup and other harvest festivals.

name: Northern Lights #5 x Haze
abstract: A sativa from Sensi Seeds, Northern Lights #5 x Haze is a vigorous strain bred to improve upon Haze’s flowering time and bud structure.

name: Northern Wreck
abstract: Northern Wreck is an indica-dominant strain that combines the dizzying strength of Northern Lights with the complex cerebral sensations of Trainwreck.

name: Nova
abstract: Nova is Canadian LP Tweed’s version of Pennywise, an indica-dominant cannabis strain with an equal ratio of THC and CBD.

name: Nuggetry OG
abstract: Nuggetry OG is a solid cannabis strain that delivers sedative indica effects and yields attractive, emerald green flowers.

name: Nuken
abstract: The mostly indica Nuken is a Canadian strain bred by combining genetics from Kish (a cross of two Shishkaberry parents) and God Bud.

name: Nurse Jackie
abstract: Nurse Jackie is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by TGA Genetics, who crossed Jack the Ripper with Medicine Woman to create this sour lemon flavored strain.

name: OCA’s Cloud 9
abstract: OCA’s Cloud 9 is a phenotype of the mysterious Brazilian landrace strain known as Borderliner.

name: OCD
abstract: OCD is a strain native to Seattle that, as its name suggests, is great for high energy pursuits.

name: OG #18
abstract: OG #18 is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by DNA Genetics.

name: OG Cheese
abstract: OG Cheese by GreenLabel Seeds is a sour-smelling hybrid that crosses a potent OG Skunk #1 with the resinous indica Afghani.

name: OG Chem
abstract: OG Chem, also called Chem OG, is a sativa-dominant cross between two legendary strains, Chemdawg and OG Kush.

name: OG Diesel Kush
abstract: OG Diesel Kush is a hybrid marijuana strain with frosty dark green buds. It has a THC content of up to 19.5% and CBD levels of up to 0.36%.

name: OG Eddy Lepp
abstract: OG Eddy Lepp is an indica strain that won 2nd place in the 2013 Cannabis Cup and also competed in the 2014 competition.

name: OG Kush
abstract: OG Kush makes up the genetic backbone of West Coast cannabis strains, but in spite of its ubiquity, its origins remain a debatable mystery.

name: OG LA Affie
abstract: OG LA Affie from DNA Genetics is a pure indica variety best known for parenting the famed LA Confidential.

name: OG Poison
abstract: OG Poison is a fast-acting, hard-hitting hybrid. It is perfect for those who suffer from insomnia, and it features a strong piney aroma.

name: OG Ringo
abstract: OG Ringo is an indica-dominant variety of OG Kush bred by SoHum Seeds.

name: OG Shark
abstract: OG Shark, a rare strain found primarily in Canada, sets high standards with its impressive THC content and pungent, earthy aroma.

name: OG Skunk
abstract: A cross between OG #18 and Skunk #1, OG Skunk is a 60% sativa-dominant hybrid from DNA Genetics.

name: OG Strawberry
abstract: OG Strawberry, grown on the southwest ridgeline of Mendocino County by HappyDays Farms, is an indica-dominant hybrid strain that delivers crushing effects alongside a sour fuel aroma.

name: OG Tonic
abstract: OG Tonic is a high-CBD hybrid strain that took 1st place in the 2015 High Times Denver Cannabis Cup as “Best CBD Concentrate.”

name: OG Wreck
abstract: OG Wreck, a sativa hybrid cross between the famed OG Kush and Trainwreck, has powerful cerebral effects and medicinal properties.

name: OG's Pearl
abstract: OG’s Pearl is an 80% indica strain grown in Washington that delivers strong body-focused effects perfect for fast-acting stress relief or a lazy evening at home.

name: OGiesel
abstract: OGiesel is a happy cross between OG Kush and Sour Diesel. This hybrid typically flowers in 8 weeks and is best when grown indoors.

name: Obama Kush
abstract: Obama Kush is an indica cannabis strain that channels the President’s famous message of Change as it invigorates and inspires.

name: Odyssey
abstract: Odyssey is a hybrid cannabis strain that flowers at 8 weeks and has a sweet candy aroma

name: Ogre
abstract: Ogre has a pungent and lemony scent and provides a strong body high.

name: Ogre Berry
abstract: Orge Berry is an indica-dominant strain cultivated in the highlands of Northern Mendocino County by HappyDay Farms.

name: Old Mother Sativa
abstract: Old Mother Sativa is an enormous plant with uplifting, euphoric effects. This strain is believed to have originated in Southeast Asia, but gained popularity in Australia during the 1960’s and 70’s. With bushes that can reach upwards of 15 feet tall, this flower grows well in a variety of climates.

name: Old Toby
abstract: Old Toby was developed by grower Matthew Gordon to help curb short term memory loss while offering exceptional anti-inflammatory effects. With a terpene profile rich in limonene and pinene, Old Toby uplifts the mind and blankets the body in a trainquility that is medicinal without being sedating.

name: Omega
parent_names: white widow afghani nyc diesel permafrost
abstract: Bred over generations from White Widow, Kush, NYC Diesel, and Permafrost genetics, Omega by Rogue Buds is a hybrid strain that lets the mind soar while relaxing the body.

name: Omega Dawg
abstract: Omega Dawg is a 50/50 hybrid cross between Chemdawg and Space Queen bred by Alphakronik Genes.

name: One to One
abstract: Named for its equal balance of THC and CBD, One to One by CBD Seeds is a stabilized hybrid bred from Amnesia Haze and a high-CBD landrace strain.

name: Opal OG Kush
abstract: Opal OG Kush is an 80% indica strain grown by Nine Point Growth Industries in Washington state.

name: Opium
abstract: Opium by Paradise Seeds is an even 50/50 hybrid that offers the best of both indica and sativa strains. This strain won 2nd place at the 2006 High Times Cannabis Cup and has grown in popularity since. Known to flourish indoors, this plant grows fat, resinous colas when hydroponics are employed.

name: Or
abstract: Or, comprised of 70 percent indica genetics, is an Israeli strain from the medical cannabis supplier Tikun Olam.

name: Orange Blossom
abstract: Orange Blossom by Falcanna is the hybrid cross of Orange Bud and OG Kush. This strain combines equal measures carefree euphoria with calming physical effects that make it ideal for leisurely activities.

name: Orange Bud
abstract: A combination of two pure Skunk family members, Orange Bud is a marijuana strain that is easy to grow with a THC level up to 16.5%.

name: Orange Cookies
abstract: Orange Cookies bred by Franchise Genetics is a hybrid that combines Orange Juice with the renowned Girl Scout Cookies.

name: Orange Creamsicle
abstract: Orange Creamsicle’s tall structure, heavy colas, and pungent flavor will be sure to keep you coming back for more.

name: Orange Crush
abstract: Bred from California Orange and Blueberry, Orange Crush is a hybrid cannabis strain with a THC content of up to 15% and powerful cerebral effects lasting up to 2 hours.

name: Orange Diesel
abstract: Orange Diesel, or Agent D, is a mostly sativa-dominant hybrid that combines Sour Diesel and TGA Seeds’ Agent Orange.

name: Orange Dream
abstract: Orange Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that crosses Orange Crush with Blue Dream.

name: Orange Durban
abstract: Orange Durban is a citrus-heavy version of the African landrace strain Durban Poison. Parent strains Orange Juice Bud and Durban Poison come together to offer consumers notes of sweet orange intermixed with pine and earthy undertones.

name: Orange Haze
abstract: The sativa-dominant hybrid Orange Haze by Green Devil Genetics combines a flavorful Orange Bud with the classic Haze.

name: Orange Hill Special
abstract: Orange Hill Special is a select cross from the Orange Skunk family. Bred by Dutch Passion Seed Company, Orange Hill Special was developed over six generations by blending the genetics from Orange Bud and California Orange into a balanced hybrid.

name: Orange Juice
abstract: Orange Juice, bred by Gage Green Genetics, mixes one of their staple strains Joseph (Underdog OG bag seed) with a cross of California Orange and OG Kush.

name: Orange Kush
abstract: With a strong tangy citrus flavor, Orange Kush has a THC content up to 20%.

name: Orange Skunk
abstract: Orange Skunk is a sweet-tasting hybrid cross between Californian Orange and Skunk with invigorating cerebral effects.

name: Orange Turbo
abstract: Orange Turbo, bred by MTG Seeds, is a flavorful hybrid strain that crosses Orange Creamsicle with Turbo Diesel.

name: Orange Velvet
abstract: Orange Velvet taste and smells remarkably like orange dreamsicles.  The high gives a euphoric lift while maintaining focus and clarity.

name: Oregon Diesel
abstract: Oregon Diesel is an indica-dominant hybrid that combines NYC Diesel and Blackberry genetics in a blend bred by Oregrown specifically for the Pacific Northwest climate.

name: Oregon Pinot Noir
abstract: This Hawaiian Purple Kush and Pitbull cross was bred among the grapes of a respected Pinot Noir vineyard in Oregon.

name: Ortega
abstract: Ortega by Mr. Nice Seeds is a sedating, sweet-smelling indica strain bred from Northern Lights genetics.

name: Oteil’s Egyptian Kush
abstract: Oteil’s Egyptian Kush was the first runner-up at the 2010 Connoisseur Cup in San Francisco. Since, this blend of Nepalese Kush, Tangerine Kush, and a mystery sativa has flourished under its honorary nomenclature based on the Grammy award-winning bassist, Oteil Burbridge of the Allman Brothers.

name: Outer Space
abstract: Outer Space is a sativa-dominant strain that is a cross of Island Sweet Skunk and Trinity and is known for cerebral and creative effects. It has a citrusy odor that is strong and produces a flavorful smoke. Great as a daytime medicine.

name: Outlaw
abstract: Outlaw is a high-intensity strain bred by Dutch Passion, who combined Super Haze and Amnesia to create this 80% sativa.

name: P-51
abstract: P-51 is a piney, earthy indica strain that crosses a Tahoe OG male and a Blackberry mother.

name: P-91
abstract: P-91 is the product of Northern Lights crossed with itself three times. This cubing comes out as a 50/50 hybrid that offers potent, balanced effects that settle in the limbs.

name: PVC OG
abstract: PVC OG is an indica-dominant cannabis strain developed by Positive Vibrations Collective in Long Beach, California.

name: Pacific Blue
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush dj short blueberry
abstract: Pacific Blue by Falcanna is a flavorful cut with a THC content that consistently reaches above 20%. This indica-dominant strain was bred by crossing the legendary Kush powerhouse Pre-98 Bubba Kush with the fruity phenom DJ Short Blueberry.

name: Pagoda
abstract: Pagoda grows in the lanky manner of Apollo 11, meaning that she will require a great deal of support to keep her dense flowers off the ground.

name: Pakistan Valley Kush
abstract: Pakistan Valley Kush is a pure indica landrace strain from the Hindu Kush mountain range. This bushy plant grows squat and resilient, exhibiting deep colors and earthy, floral aromas.

name: Pakistani Chitral Kush
abstract: Pakistani Chitral Kush, also known as PCK, is a pure indica that is considered a selected landrace, meaning it is an indigenous strain that has been selectively inbred to enhance its characteristics. PCK produces a very colorful phenotype, often earning nicknames like Purple Pakistani or Purple Chitral.

name: Panama Punch
abstract: Berry, apple, grape, mango, pineapple; if you love fruity flavors and terpenes, Panama Punch is the strain for you!

name: Panama Red
abstract: Fondly regarded for its sentimental value, Panama Red is a pure sativa cannabis strain dating back to the 1960’s.

name: Panda OG
abstract: From Grow Op Farms’ Phat Panda line, Panda OG is a hybrid from Washington State that crosses two sativa-dominant hybrids, OG Chem and Berry Sour Cream.

name: Pandora's Box
abstract: A mostly sativa cross of Jack the Ripper and Space Queen, this strain has high THC levels and a citrus flavor.

name: Papa's OG
abstract: Papa’s OG is an indica cannabis strain that provides positive and uplifted cerebral effects in unique combination with the classic indica full-body relaxation.

name: Papaya
abstract: Papaya is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that has a distinct fruit smell and flavor and an energetic buzz.

name: Paris OG
abstract: Paris OG is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Paris XXX
abstract: Paris XXX is an extension of the Paris OG family that has placed in multiple Cannabis Cup competitions. This indica variety combines Headband OG, Chemdawg, and OG Kush genetics, creating a crisp, piney, and woody flavor on inhale.

name: Patti Cake
abstract: Patti Cake by Potbox is a delectable treat created in homage to the grower’s sweetheart. This strain is a mysterious genetic cross that has been described as a relative of Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie.

name: Peaches and Cream
abstract: The Peaches and Cream hybrid is a Skunk phenotype with a sweet, fruity flavor that lives up to its name.

name: Pearl Scout Cookies
abstract: Pearl Scout Cookies, a Girl Scout Cookies hybrid, is a cannabis strain developed by Fireline for recreational shops in Washington State.

name: Pele's Fire OG
abstract: Pele’s Fire OG by Pua Mana Pakalōlō puts the volcanic flames of the Hawaiian goddess Pele into this Fire OG backcross.

name: Pennywise
abstract: Pennywise is a high-CBD indica cross between Harlequin and Jack the Ripper, a combination that lends this strain its killer-clown name.

name: Peppermint Cookies
abstract: Peppermint Cookies is a select phenotype of Girl Scout Cookies that is grown by Goldleaf Gardens in Washington. The minty flavors and dark purple-green hues helped Peppermint Cookies take Best Hybrid at the 2015 DOPE Cup in Seattle.

name: Permafrost
abstract: Permafrost is a sativa-dominant hybrid named for its frosty coat of crystal trichomes and fresh pine aroma.

name: Pestilence
abstract: Pestilence, named for one of the Four Horseman of the Apocalypse, is a rare indica-dominant strain with strong OG undertones. Coffee and caramel fill the air when this strain is combusted, but a touch of pungent earth lingers on the exhale to round out this Abusive OG and West Coast Dawg cross.

name: Petrolia Headstash
abstract: Reeferman's Petrolia Headstash is a flavorful indica perfect when battling stress or producing concentrates.

name: Pez
abstract: Pez is an indica daughter of Afghani and Pakistani strains.

name: Phantom Cookies
abstract: Phantom Cookies is a 65% sativa strain from Northern California that crosses a flavorful Cherry Pie hybrid with the resin-heavy Granddaddy Purple.

name: Phantom OG
abstract: Phantom OG is an indica-dominant strain that begins with heightened energy and ends with a crash of full-body relaxation.

name: Phishhead Kush
abstract: Phishhead Kush, named in homage to the American rock band, is an indica strain that was passed down from an older grower to the cultivators at The Clinic in Colorado.

name: Pie Face OG
abstract: Pie Face OG is what you get when you cross Cherry Pie with Face Off OG, a creation from Archive Seed Bank.

name: Pine Cone
abstract: Pine Cone by Glen’s Plant Farm is the hybrid cross of Blue Tahoe and Cinex. This combination develops a strong forest aroma and tight resinous nuggets that explode with earthy flavor upon vaporization or combustion.

name: Pine Tar Kush
abstract: Pine Tar Kush stems from a family of pure indica genetics native to Pakistan. This cannabis strain is nearly unaltered from its original genetic form and expresses itself with bright green hues and a skunky aroma.

name: Pineapple
abstract: A perfect strain for stress relief, Pineapple's tropical flavors will transport you to your happy place, leaving you uplifted and relaxed.

name: Pineapple Chunk
abstract: Pineapple Chunk, bred by Barney’s Farm, is an indica-leaning hybrid that induces heavy full-body effects and a fast-paced cerebral buzz.

name: Pineapple Diesel
abstract: Pineapple Diesel is an uplifting sativa-dominant cannabis strain that provides powerful but clear cerebral effects.

name: Pineapple Dog Shit
abstract: Pineapple Dog Shit is a hybrid strain that may not sound appetizing, but its elite parentage of Pineapple Punch and Chemdawg 4 is enough to draw connoisseurs of old school genetics.

name: Pineapple Express
abstract: Pineapple Express has a THC content up to 17% and smells like apple and mango, with a taste of pineapple.

name: Pineapple Fields
abstract: Pineapple Fields by Dynasty Seeds is an extremely odoriferous hybrid cross with a long lineage and even longer lasting effects. By crossing Kali Snapple (Snowbud/Pineapple x Pre-2K Kali Mist) and Ms. Universe #10, Dynasty Seeds achieves a strain with a sweet terpene profile and energizing, clear-headed attributes.

name: Pineapple Haze
abstract: Pineapple Haze combines the tropical aroma of Pineapple with the racing cerebral energy of Haze, creating a mostly sativa hybrid with equally enticing flavors and effects.

name: Pineapple Jack
abstract: Pineapple Jack is a mostly sativa cannabis strain whose Jack Herer and Pineapple genetics collide, combining their soaring, blissful effects in unison.

name: Pineapple Kush
abstract: Pineapple Kush has a THC content of up to 15% and tastes of sweet pineapple.

name: Pineapple OG
abstract: Pineapple OG is a 70% sativa hybrid is thought to be a cross between Pineapple Express and an unknown OG Kush hybrid, and is probably only available on the West Coast.

name: Pineapple Punch
abstract: Pineapple Punch by Flying Dutchmen is a 70/30 sativa-dominant strain that unites Skunk #1 genetics with those of the Hawaiian indica Real McCoy.

name: Pineapple Purple Skunk
abstract: Bred by MTG Seeds, Pineapple Purple Skunk is a hybrid cannabis strain that combines Pineapple and Purple Skunk genetics.

name: Pineapple Purps
abstract: Pineapple Purps is a sativa-dominant strain that is rarely found but always cherished by those looking for strains with a high THCV cannabinoid profile.

name: Pineapple Skunk
abstract: Pineapple Skunk is a hybrid bred by Humboldt Seeds crossed between Pineapple, Skunk #1, and Cheese.

name: Pineapple Super Silver Haze
abstract: Pineapple Super Silver Haze from Fire Bros. is a sativa strain that modifies the widely cherished Super Silver Haze with a Pineapple hybrid strain.

name: Pineapple Thai
abstract: Pineapple Thai is a sativa-dominant cannabis hybrid with a high CBD content and powerful, clear-minded medicinal effects.

name: Pineapple Trainwreck
abstract: Pineapple Trainwreck is sativa marijuana strain bred from Pineapple Express and Trainwreck.

name: Pink Berry
abstract: Pink Berry by Apothecary Genetics is a delicious indica-dominant strain with relaxation on tap. This strain is the heavy-hitting combination of Pink Champagne and Blackberry, offering sweet, fruity overtones while keeping a root firmly planted in OG genetics.

name: Pink Bubba
abstract: Pink Bubba is a mostly indica strain that is said combine genetics from Bubba Kush and Pink Kush.

name: Pink Champagne
abstract: Pink Champagne goes by many names, including Wow Kush, Raspberry Kush, Phantom ( or Ken’s Phantom). Bred in the Bay area by Ken Estes, who crossed Ken’s Granddaddy Purple and Cherry Pie, this sedative beauty is not to be confused with Phantom Cookies.

name: Pink Cookies
abstract: Pink Cookies, also known as Wedding Cake, is the familial genetic cross of Girl Scout Cookies x Cherry Pie. This delectable treat is rich with tangy sweet earth and pepper, taking notes and dimension from its OG and Durban Poison parentage.

name: Pink Kush
abstract: Pink Kush, as coveted as its OG Kush relative, is an indica-dominant hybrid with powerful body-focused effects.

name: Pink Lemonade
abstract: Pink Lemonade is a tart sativa-dominant hybrid that adheres to its namesake in flavor and smell. This strain smells of fruity, mentholated tea and screams tart lemons and grapefruit on the exhale.

name: Pink Pez
abstract: Daughter of hybrids Pez and Sour Pink Grapefruit, Pink Pez is an indica-dominant cannabis hybrid with a citrus smell and floral taste.

name: Pink Sunset
abstract: Pink Sunset is the indica phenotype of the delicious indica-dominant hybrid Sunset Sherbert. This sugary strain has roots in Girl Scout Cookies, but pushes the functional sedation of its OG Kush and Cherry Pie parentage into the realm of full-body relaxation.

name: Pitbull
abstract: Pitbull is an indica dominant cannabis strain that was bred in the United States. It flowers quickly and has potent buds.

name: Platinum Bubba Kush
abstract: Platinum Bubba Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that produces dense flowers in 8 to 9 weeks. This strain has a floral smell and sweet flavor.

name: Platinum Girl Scout Cookies
abstract: Platinum Girl Scout Cookies is a Cannabis Cup-winning hybrid cross of OG Kush, Durban Poison, and Cherry Kush.

name: Platinum Kush
abstract: With a silver/platinum shade due to its many crystals, Platinum Kush creates a strong buzz affecting both the head and body.

name: Platinum OG
abstract: Platinum OG is a precious indica-dominant strain that has established itself as one of the heaviest cannabis medications available today.

name: Platinum Purple Kush
abstract: Platinum Purple Kush is a great nighttime indica marijuana strain. It’s a great option for those looking to eliminate insomnia or de-stress after work.

name: Plushberry
abstract: Plushberry, a cross between Black Cherry Soda and Space Queen, is an 80% indica strain bred by TGA Seeds.

name: Pluto Kush
abstract: Pluto Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain with cosmic undertones that thrives on balancing instant physical relief with steady cerebral stimulation.

name: Pokie
abstract: Pokie is an indica-dominant strain that descends from a Pure Kush and LA Confidential hybrid and a Sweet Tooth and Juicy Fruit cross.

name: Poochie Love
abstract: Poochie Love from Archive Seed Bank is a 70% sativa strain that descends from the ever-so-tasteful Dog Shit and Face Off OG.

name: Pop Rox
abstract: True to its name, Pop Rox carries a sweet, candy-like aroma that translates to a fruity flavor on the inhale.

name: Popcorn Kush
abstract: Popcorn Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that resembles and tastes like popcorn but delivers short, intense effects.

name: Pot of Gold
abstract: Pot of Gold is covered in resin and can be very sticky.  Hash and fruity taste when smoked, very quick to grab hold of your brain.

name: Power Kush
abstract: A popular strain in Amsterdam, Power Kush has a THC content up to 16% and smells of strawberry and orange.

name: Power Plant
abstract: Power Plant is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that has both a potent smell and a potent high that ranges from creative to intoxicating.

name: Pre-98 Bubba Kush
abstract: Pre-98 Bubba Kush is an oldie but goodie. Featuring a pungent aroma and flowering around 10 weeks, this indica is great for stress relief.

name: Predator Pink
abstract: A cross between Plushberry and Starfighter, Predator Pink by Exotic Genetix is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid with a tropical candy flavor.

name: Presidential OG
abstract: Presidential OG primarily indica Kush strain and has a balanced cerebral and body high. It is also known for its citrus aroma and earthy taste.

name: Primus
abstract: Primus, also called Primus OG, is a complex indica strain that combines Arcata, Trainwreck, and 303 Kush.

name: Princess’s Tiara
abstract: Princess's Tiara, bred by Branden Waite, is the heady cross of parent strains Cinderella's Dream and Headband. Offering a bouquet of pungent terpenes that reek of fuel, sweetness, and earth, the Princess’s Tiara smells very similar to its predecessors.

name: Professor Chaos
abstract: Professor Chaos is what you get when you combine the malevolent forces of Mad Scientist and Jack the Ripper, two strains that balance energy with merciless painkilling properties.

name: Project Blue Book
abstract: 3C Project Blue Book is like a more sophisticated Blue Dream; it’s sativa in nature, but backed by a serene body high. This sativa heavy hybrid is a cross between Blue Dream and 3C Majestic 12. Both powerful strains blend perfectly to create a clear, focused, and calming experience.

name: Proper BHO Shatter
abstract: Proper’s BHO Shatter, from Golden XTRX, comes in a variety of indica strains. The Butane Hash Oil (BHO) concentrates are vacuum purged to maintain and enhance purity, potency, and flavor.

name: Proper BHO Shatter
abstract: Proper’s BHO Shatter from Golden XTRX comes in a variety of sativa strains. The Butane Hash Oil concentrates are vacuum purged to maintain and enhance purity, potency, and flavor.

name: Proper BHO Shatter
