abstract: Proper’s BHO Shatter from Golden XTRX comes in a variety of hybrid strains. The Butane Hash Oil (BHO) concentrates are vacuum purged to maintain and enhance purity, potency, and flavor.

name: Proper PHO Shatter
abstract: Proper’s PHO Shatter from Golden XTRX offers its own unique flavor profile. The Propane Hash Oil (PHO) shatter is heavily concentrated with cannabinoids and is a popular remedy for body pains.

name: Proper PHO Shatter
abstract: Proper’s PHO Shatter from Golden XTRX offers its own unique flavor profile. The Propane Hash Oil (PHO) shatter is heavily concentrated with cannabinoids and is a popular remedy for body pains.

name: Proper PHO Shatter
abstract: Proper’s PHO Shatter from Golden XTRX offers its own unique flavor profile. The Propane Hash Oil (PHO) shatter is heavily concentrated with cannabinoids and is a popular remedy for body pains.

name: Puna Buddaz
abstract: Puna Buddaz is a legendary Hawaiian landrace indica that first gained popularity in the 60’s and 70’s. This powerful psychedelic strain originated in the Puna District of The Big Island and has been cultivated on the “Red Road” in Puna for generations.

name: Puna Budder
abstract: Puna Budder is a hybrid of Hawaiian and Afghani landraces bred by T.H. Seeds. The tropical influence of Hawaiian genetics creates an invigorating aroma and flavor palate, while the stable Afghani genes minimize Puna Budder’s flowering cycle down to a respectable 55-60 days.

name: Punky Lion
abstract: Punky Lion from Samsara Seeds combines the strength of two potent indica strains, Chronic and Matanuska Tundra.

name: Pure Afghan
abstract: The Pure Afghan is an exclusive landrace from the Mazar I Sharif region of Afghanistan.

name: Pure Kush
abstract: Pure Kush is a very powerful indica cannabis strain. Great for pain sufferers and insomniacs, it provides users with heavy head and body effects.

name: Pure Power Plant
abstract: Pure Power Plant is a potent sativa-dominant hybrid that flowers in 8-10 weeks. Great for daytime use, PPP produces strong head-heavy effects.

name: Purple AK-47
abstract: Purple AK-47 is a hybrid cross between Granddaddy Purple and AK-47. This strain has a floral aroma and an early flowering time of 7-9 weeks.

name: Purple Afghani
abstract: This Afghani is a mostly Indica inbred to produce thick and heavy buds. This variety has dark green leaves and calyxes that turn purple at flowering. Medium-high leaf to flower ratio with a subtle aroma and a very good high.

name: Purple Alien OG
parent_names: tahoe og kush alien kush alien og
abstract: This purple phenotype of Alien OG is known for having dark purple leaves covered in trichomes, a pungent smell, and relaxing effects.

name: Purple Arrow
abstract: Purple Arrow was designed to ease pain while allowing users to function. Euphoric and relaxing, this hybrid is the best of both worlds.

name: Purple Aurora
abstract: New from breeders Alaska Built, Purple Aurora is a 60% indica, 35% sativa, 5% ruderalis auto-flowering hybrid resulting from a cross of Purple Kush and Purple Auto.

name: Purple Berry
abstract: Purple Berry is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that is a cross between Granddaddy Purple and Blueberry. It has a strong fruity aroma.

name: Purple Bubba
abstract: Purple Bubba is a cross of two well-known indica strains, Bubba Kush and Purple Kush.

name: Purple Bud
parent_names: afghani jamaican hindu skunk purple kush
abstract: From Sensi Seeds comes the purple-blossomed indica Purple Bud, appropriately named for its bright hues of lavender.

name: Purple Buddha
abstract: Purple Buddha combines grape flavors of the Purps with the creamy berry tastes of Blue Buddha.

name: Purple Bush
abstract: This dense purple-hued strain tests upward of 21% THC and will have you feeling relaxed after a long day.

name: Purple Candy
abstract: Purple Candy is an indica-dominant marijuana strain originally from British Columbia that has a sugary sweet smell and flavor.

name: Purple Champagne
abstract: Purple Champagne is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain bred by Grand Daddy Purp, who crossed a rare sativa phenotype of his famous Granddaddy Purple with Pink Champagne.

name: Purple Cheddar
abstract: Purple Cheddar is the caved-aged cross of Cheese and Grandaddy Purple. This strain packs pungent, earthy dimensions that linger on the tongue after combustion and offers a nearly instant euphoria. Tertiary effects gently creep over the body and mind, allowing the consumer to stay happy, heady, and functional while indulging in a mid-level relaxation.

name: Purple Cheese
abstract: Purple Cheese is an indica-dominant autoflowering hybrid that combines Purple #1, Blue Cheese, and Lowryder.

name: Purple Chemdawg
abstract: Purple Chemdawg is a potent 75/25 indica-dominant hybrid that delivers powerfully relaxing effects alongside a sweet grape aroma.

name: Purple Cotton Candy
abstract: Purple Cotton Candy by LivWell is a calming indica-dominant hybrid strain that crosses Granddaddy Purple and Cotton Candy Kush.

name: Purple Cow
abstract: Creative minds will appreciate the extra spark provided by Purple Cow’s dreamy, invigorating euphoria, and her sweet, sour mango aroma has something to offer flavor connoisseurs as well.

name: Purple Crack
abstract: There are at least two variations of the strain Purple Crack. One, bred by Cali Connection, claims to be Green Crack genetics crossed with a Blackwater male. The other is bred by the Qola Family using Juicy Fruit in combination with Green Crack.

name: Purple Cream
abstract: Purple Cream has been around for over a decade and is perfect for anxiety sufferers. This indica is relaxing and eases muscle pain.

name: Purple Diesel
abstract: Purple Diesel is a cross between Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Sour Diesel. Typically flowering around 8 weeks, this strain is uplifting and relaxing.

name: Purple Dog Shit
abstract: Purple Dog Shit is a hybrid strain with tranquilizing body effects that ease you  into a solid night’s sleep.

name: Purple Dragon
abstract: Purple Dragon is a cross between Purple Urkle and Blue Dragon. Providing a motivating but relaxed sensation, this isn't your average indica.

name: Purple Dream
abstract: Purple Dream is a cross between Granddaddy Purple and Blue Dream. It has a strong sour taste and provides moderate hybrid effects.

name: Purple Goat
abstract: Purple Goat is a hybrid cross between Trainwreck and Blueberry Skunk, created by Oregon OMMP growers in the early 2010s.

name: Purple Goo
abstract: Purple Goo is a relaxing indica that is perfect for unwinding after a long day. It’s great for nighttime use and for those looking to ease pain.

name: Purple Gorilla
abstract: Purple Gorilla, named for its violet, oversized buds, is an indica-dominant hybrid that originated in the Bay Area of California.

name: Purple Hashplant
abstract: Purple Hashplant is a hybrid cannabis strain that flowers in 8 to 9 weeks and provides patients with well-balanced head and body effects.

name: Purple Haze
abstract: Purple Haze is a great strain for medicinal users because it provides strong relief from pain.

name: Purple Headband
abstract: Purple Headband is a 50/50 hybrid strain that combines the famous Headband with an unknown “purple” hybrid, resulting in dense pink and purple flowers covered in greenish trichomes.

name: Purple Hindu Kush
abstract: A cross between Hindu Kush and Purple Afghani, Purple Hindu Kush is almost pure indica and offers the kind of high one would expect from its lineage: deep relaxation along with pronounced pain relief.

name: Purple Ice
abstract: Purple Ice is a potent hybrid that is great for stress relief. Slightly sativa-dominant, this strain produces euphoric and focused effects.

name: Purple Jack
abstract: Purple Jack is a relaxing hybrid that combines a Purple Kush indica with the sativa-dominant Jack Herer.

name: Purple Jolly Rancher
abstract: Purple Jolly Rancher is a 75% indica cross between Purple Kush and Route 66.

name: Purple Kush
abstract: Purple Kush from Oakland, California is an all-indica cross between Hindu Kush and Purple Afghani.

name: Purple Martian Kush
parent_names: purple kush blackberry kush martian mean green
abstract: Purple Martian Kush is an indica-dominant cross between Purple Kush, Blackberry Kush, and Martian Mean Green.

name: Purple Maui
abstract: Purple Maui is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Happy Harvest.

name: Purple Monkey Balls
abstract: The genetic heritage of Purple Monkey Balls is somewhat murky. What we do know is that it is an indica-dominant mix of a Northern Californian purple strain -- some claim Medno Purps, others Granddaddy Purple -- and an indica from Afghanistan, believed to be Deep Chunk.

name: Purple Mr. Nice
abstract: GDP and Mr. Nice come together in this very heavy indica, do not operate heavy machinery after smoking.

name: Purple Nepal
abstract: Purple Nepal is a cross between Lemon Thai and Nepal. It produces a mid-level buzz and typically flowers between 8 and 9 weeks.

name: Purple OG Kush
abstract: Purple OG Kush is an extremely potent indica. A popular medical strain, it’s perfect for insomnia sufferers and boosting appetite.

name: Purple Pantera
abstract: Purple Pantera is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Snowhigh Seeds. The mix of Pink Panther and Grape Krush genetics produces dark purple hues and a piney OG Kush aroma that is highlighted by sweet grape notes with subtle berry undertones.

name: Purple Panty Dropper
abstract: A three-way cross of Purple Haze, Oregon Grape, and Matanuskan Mist, Humboldt Seed Company’s Purple Panty Dropper is named for its deep purple hues and supposed aphrodisiac effects.

name: Purple Paralysis
abstract: Purple Paralysis, bred by Cream of the Crop, is a sativa-dominant hybrid with potently energizing effects and a hashy lavender aroma.

name: Purple Passion
abstract: Purple Passion is a mostly indica strain, typically maturing around 9 weeks. This strain is thoughtful, creative, and relaxing.

name: Purple People Eater
parent_names: granddaddy purple pure afghan purple urkle
abstract: Purple People Eater is the lanky indica-dominant cross of (Lapis Mnt. Indica x GDP) x (Afghan x Purple Urkle) that has been known to produce green and purple buds that smell pungent and earthy.

name: Purple Pinecone
abstract: Purple Pinecone by Sagarmatha Seeds is a dense indica known for its heavy effects and generous trichome production. Though its genetics remain unknown, this deep purple strain reeks of pine and earth, hinting at its indica parentage.

name: Purple Power
abstract: A sativa-dominant cross of Dutch Dope and Skunk #1, Purple Power is a very popular strain with outdoor and greenhouse growers, but is very unpredictable and difficult to manage when grown indoors

name: Purple Princess
abstract: Purple Princess is the mellow daughter of Cinderella 99 and Ice Princess. This strain flowers in 5-6 weeks and has a skunky fruit aroma.

name: Purple Punch
abstract: Purple Punch is the sweet and sedating union of two indica-dominant classics. By breeding Larry OG with Granddaddy Purple, the astonishing trichome laden Purple Punch was born, smelling of grape candy, blueberry muffins, and tart Kool-Aid.

name: Purple Rhino
abstract: Purple Rhino combines White Rhino’s skunky aroma with the sweet piney flavors of The Purps.

name: Purple Sage
abstract: Purple Sage is a hybrid marijuana strain with a unique spicy aroma that gives uplifting mental effects combined with pain relief.

name: Purple Skunk
abstract: Purple Skunk is an uplifting, sativa-dominant cannabis cross between Skunk #1 and an older purple strain. It has an earthy aroma.

name: Purple Sour Diesel
abstract: Purple Sour Diesel is a quick and heavy hybrid cross between Sour Diesel and Purple Kush. It features a fruity, sour taste.

name: Purple Star
abstract: Purple Star is a pure indica strain bred by Dutch Passion.

name: Purple Tangie
abstract: A spin on the citrus-loaded Tangie sativa, Purple Tangie is a flavorful strain that invigorates the spirit with uplifting euphoria.

name: Purple Tears
abstract: Purple Tears by Dirt Farmer Genetics is a pleasant twist on an old favorite. It’s the product of breeding Querkle and DelaHaze, creating a strain with the aroma of musty grape and hash, and effects that are distinctly sedating.

name: Purple Thai
abstract: Purple Thai is a mostly sativa strain that crosses Highland Oaxacan Gold with Chocolate Thai.

name: Purple Trainwreck
abstract: Lemon-scented cross between GDP and Trainwreck.  Gives a slight body high, nicely euphoric and uplifting.

name: Purple Urkle
abstract: The legendary Purple Urkle is a very popular indica strain.  It possesses an interesting sweet grape flavor when smoked.

name: Purple Voodoo
parent_names: double purple doja purple urkle purple diesel
abstract: Purple Voodoo is a hybrid cannabis strain that boasts strong THC and CBD percentages. It has a pungent odor and taste.

name: Purple Widow
abstract: Purple Widow from De Sjamaan Seeds crosses White Widow with the renowned Dutch outdoor strain Purple Power, resulting in a large, sturdy plant that produces fat, resin-covered purple flowers.

name: Purple Wreck
abstract: Purple Wreck is a strain of cannabis that is a good choice for outdoor growing and a favorite among growers for its high yields.

name: Q3
abstract: A sativa dominant strain.

name: Qleaner
abstract: Qleaner is a mostly sativa strain that provides an impressive high to even the most jaded pot snob.

name: Qrazy Train
parent_names: trainwreck trinity purple urkle space queen
abstract: Qrazy Train is a hybrid cannabis strain that boasts diverse genetics and a unique flavor. It provides potent head and body effects.

name: Quantum Kush
abstract: TGA Genetics produced this mix of Sweet Irish Kush and Timewreck, a combination that passes on a complex aroma that is both earthy and sweet.

name: Quebec Gold
abstract: Quebec Gold, a staple strain of the Quebec region, is a potent hybrid cross between M-39 and Freezeland.

name: Queen's Panties
abstract: Queen’s Panties is a royally stimulating sativa-dominant that charges the body with a palpable energy. This energy is worn on consumers like regal cape that flows behind them as they bound from place to place, visibly lit up by this cross of Dream Queen and Purple Panty Dropper.

name: Querkle
abstract: Querkle is a marijuana strain that's a cross between Purple Urkle and Space Queen. It has a fruity grape & berry scent.

name: Queso
abstract: Created in 2011 by Kannabia Seeds, Queso, (Spanish for “cheese”) is a hybrid strain that provides powerful body effects and mood elevation.

name: Quin-N-Tonic
abstract: Quin-N-Tonic is a high-CBD strain bred by La Plata Labs, who combines genetics from Harlequin and Cannatonic.

name: Qush
abstract: Qush is a 70/30 indica-dominant cannabis strain from TGA Genetics, who combines Pre-98 Bubba Kush with Space Queen.

name: R-4
abstract: R-4, also known as Cindy’s Solution, is a CBD-dominant strain with exceptional therapeutic benefits. With a THC/CBD ratio of 1:40, R-4 sits firmly in the medical category, catering to consumers seeking relief from muscle spasms, chronic physical pain, nausea, and a shortlist of other ailments dulled by high quantities of CBD.

name: Rafael
abstract: Rafael is a sativa-dominant strain bred to contain high levels of CBD for patients experiencing sleep and digestive disorders.

name: Rainbow
abstract: Tastes like tropical Starburst with purple, orange and green colored buds. THC range of 17-22%.

name: Rare Dankness #1
abstract: Colorado breeders Rare Dankness created this staple of their breeding program by crossing Ghost OG with Chemdawg.

name: Rare Darkness
abstract: Rare Darkness has deep dark purple flowers, with flavors of grapes and berries. The heavy indica effects uplift your mind and relax your body.

name: Raskal OG
abstract: Bred by Cali Connection, this indica-based hybrid smells of lemon and pine and has a THC level up to 17%.

name: Raspberry Cough
abstract: Raspberry Cough is a 70% sativa strain bred by Nirvana Seeds that crosses a Cambodian landrace with ICE.

name: Raspberry Kush
abstract: Raspberry Kush is an indica strain of marijuana that is great for treating body pain. It has a raspberries and cream aroma.

name: Raw Diesel
abstract: G-13 Labs created Raw Diesel by crossing New York City Diesel with G13 Haze.

name: Ray Charles
abstract: Ray Charles is a potent indica strain named in honor of the cannabis-friendly blues musician and songwriter.

name: Rebel Berry OG
abstract: Rebel Berry OG was the winner for Best Outdoor at the 2016 Oregon Growers Cup. This sativa-dominant hybrid created by Kotton for Rebel Spirit Cannabis was bred for potency and its ability to stimulate creativity.

name: Rebel God Smoke
abstract: Rebel God Smoke is a pro-grade sativa-dominant strain that blasts users with the motivating energy of a launching warhead. This rocket fuel is a cross of Cinderella 99 and Gupta Kush, and has been known to finish flowering in under 8 weeks.

name: Reclining Buddha
abstract: Reclining Buddha from Soma Seeds is a mostly indica cannabis strain bred from Super Skunk, Big Skunk Korean, and Holland’s Hope.

name: Recon
abstract: The ReCon is a perfect blend of two parts LA Confidential and one part Cannadential.

name: Red Cherry Berry
abstract: Red Cherry Berry is a 50/50 hybrid developed by Barney’s Farms, who combined the classic sativa Skunk #1 with Cherry Bomb Indica.

name: Red Congolese
abstract: Red Congolese, an African sativa strain, promotes focus and mental clarity while treating a wide array of symptoms.

name: Red Diesel
abstract: Red Diesel takes the distinctive sweet and sour diesel flavors of NYC Diesel and adds in California Indica, a stable heavy producer, to increase the yield and potency.

name: Red Dragon
abstract: Red Dragon is a connoisseur strain created by Barney’s Farm. Happy and upbeat, this strain has a fruity aroma and flowers in 8-10 weeks.

name: Red Dwarf
abstract: Red Dwarf is an indica-dominant cannabis strain that includes ruderalis genetics to make it an autoflowering plant. Plants mature quickly at 6 weeks.

name: Red Eye OG
abstract: Red Eye OG is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Red Haze
abstract: Red Haze is the product of a cross between Neville’s Haze and Colombian Red. This sativa is a slow grower, typically flowering in 12-14 weeks.

name: Red Headed Stranger
abstract: A cross between Tom Hill’s Haze and William’s Wonder, Red Headed Stranger offers a jolt of cerebral vigor that fuels creativity and focus.

name: Red Poison
abstract: Red Poison is an auto-flowering hybrid of Green Poison and a Pakistani landrace strain, believed to be a Hindu Kush phenotype that was selected for its deep purple colors.

name: Red Widow
abstract: Red Widow is a hybrid cross of Red Dragon and White Widow that produces an uplifting, euphoric high and sweet fruity aromas.

name: Redd Cross
abstract: Redd Cross is an indica-dominant hybrid bred by Genetics Gone Mad that crosses Spirit of ’76 with an undefined Afghani indica.

name: Redding OG
abstract: Redding OG is a hybrid strain that won 3rd place in the 2014 Los Angeles Cannabis Cup.

name: Redwood Kush
abstract: Redwood Kush is a Northern California indica cannabis strain. Featuring an earthy aroma, it's extremely relaxing.

name: Remedy
abstract: Remedy, a cross between Cannatonic and Afghan Skunk,  is a high-CBD strain that induces little to no psychoactive effects.

name: Rene
abstract: Rene, named after the cannabis activist Renee Boje, is a potent sativa strain popular in Canada.

name: Rene Mist
abstract: Rene Mist is a high-energy hybrid cross between Cannatonic and Rene.

name: Richie Rich
abstract: Richie Rich is a Northern Lights #5 crossed with Skunk #1.  It is a favorite among medical users for pain relief.

name: Riddler OG
abstract: Riddle me this! Riddler OG, also known as “Power,” is a trichome-rich hybrid that blends the heady, uplifting euphoria of Sour Dubble with the mid-level Kush-driven body effects of Master Kush. These effects come together to form a well-balanced hybrid that is useful and enjoyable any time of the day.

name: Ridge Berry
abstract: Ridge Berry by Marley Natural is a succulent and stimulating sativa-dominant strain that imbues the consumer with energy right away, but leans back into alert sedation over time.

name: Ringo's Gift
abstract: Ringo’s Gift is a high-CBD strain that crosses Harle-Tsu and ACDC. It is named for the late Lawrence Ringo, a cannabis activist and CBD pioneer.

name: Rip City Purps
abstract: Rip City Purps is a mostly indica hybrid from Alphakronic Genes that pays homage to Portland, Oregon, the city where they got their start.

name: Ripped Bubba
parent_names: pre-98 bubba kush jack the ripper
abstract: Ripped Bubba is a 60% indica strain bred by TGA Genetics that crosses a resinous Pre-98 Bubba Kush with the flavorful and euphoric Jack the Ripper.

name: Rob Ford Kush
abstract: A Toronto strain that gets its name from its sensationalized former mayor, Rob Ford Kush is a powerfully sleepy indica strain.

name: Robert Plant
abstract: Robert Plant is the heady, stimulating virtuoso brought to life by crossing Blue Dream and Rebel God Smoke. This creative and drastically energetic strain combines Blue Dream’s hazy, uplifted mental energy and Rebel God Smoke’s full-throttle stimulation to bring about motivation and creativity.

name: Rockbud
abstract: Rockbud by Soma Seeds is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain bred using genetics from Super Skunk, Afghani, Big Skunk Korean, and Afghan Hawaiian.

name: Rocklock
abstract: Rocklock marijuana is a cross between the RockStar and Warlock cannabis strains.

name: Rockstar
abstract: Rockstar, a cross between Rockbud and Sensi Star, is a potent indica-dominant hybrid that delivers strong effects without sedation.

name: Rockstar Kush
abstract: Rockstar Kush, also known as BC Rockstar, is a popular strain in British Columbia renowned for its excellent medical qualities.

name: Rockstar Master Kush
abstract: Rockstar Master Kush folds together veteran strains Master Kush, Sensi Star, and Afghani into one potent indica.

name: Rocky Mountain Blueberry
abstract: Rocky Mountain Blueberry is an indica-dominant cannabis strain parented by Shishkaberry and Dutch Passion’s Blueberry.

name: Rocky Mountain High
abstract: Rocky Mountain High is an indica-dominant hybrid from Colorado that crosses Mikado with Colorado Green Bud.

name: Rollex OG Kush
abstract: Rollex OG Kush, bred by Devil’s Harvest Seeds, is an indica-dominant hybrid of White Fire OG and Kuchi. The combination creates a complex flavor profile that mixes the skunky, pine flavors of OG Kush with sharp cheesy undertones.

name: Rolls Choice
abstract: Rolls Choice by Royal Choice Farms is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross. Exhibiting a pungent bouquet of diesel, pine, and sour, skunky earth, Rolls Choice shows off its OG Kush and Chemdawg parentage.

name: Romping Goddess
abstract: Romping Goddess is an original creation that combines a powerful, local medicinal strain with the Cannabis Cup winning "God Bud".

name: Romulan
abstract: Romulan, named after the alien Star Trek race, is a powerful indica revered for its potent therapeutic qualities.

name: Romulan Grapefruit
abstract: Top quality hybrid, amazingly strong scent. Grows like the Grapefruit in size and stature but has a bigger punch and stronger smell due to the Romulan influence

name: Romulan Haze
abstract: Romulan Haze by Next Generation Seeds is a clear-headed hybrid ready for all day consumption. Mind your dosage and this strain will keep you lucid and productive, stimulating the body and calming the mind, allowing the consumer to remain focused.

name: Rose Bud
abstract: Rose Bud by Royal Choice Farms in an indica-dominant cross with an enticing floral aroma. Known for its skunky rose smell and dense node clusters, Rose Bud offers consumers a relaxing buzz with a pleasant mental sizzle.

name: Royal Chemdawg
abstract: Though this hybrid has some sativa in its lineage, Royal Chemdog is a true indica at heart.

name: Royal Dwarf
abstract: Royal Dwarf is a full-body hybrid bred by Royal Queen Seeds in Spain through crossing Skunk with a cannabis ruderalis variety.

name: Royal Haze
abstract: Royal Haze is a sativa strain that inherits a spicy citrus flavor and buzzing, energetic effects.

name: Royal Highness
abstract: Royal Highness is a hybrid bred by Royal Queen Seeds. Its combination of Dance Hall and Respect genetics express themselves in a nearly balanced THC:CBD ratio, and while indica in stature the effects of Royal Highness are led by its sativa influence.

name: Royal Kush
abstract: Royal Kush by G13 Labs is a king among hybrids, delivering powerful trance-like effects with an earthy, skunky aroma.

name: Rubicon
abstract: Rubicon, 2016 Colorado Cannabis Cup winner of Best CBD Flower, is a utilitarian indica-dominant hybrid. This 1:1 THC/CBD hybrid offers about 9% on either cannabinoid, creating a pleasant smoke for consumers seeking a mild body buzz with anti-inflammatory qualities.

name: RudeBoi OG
abstract: Bred by Archive Seeds, RudeBoi OG is an indica-dominant hybrid cannabis strain that brings together genetics from two OG Kush phenotypes, Irene Kush and a backcrossed Face Off OG.

name: Rug Burn OG
abstract: By crossing Ghost OG with Rare Dankness #1, Rare Dankness Seeds has created a pungent flavor mix of sour citrus and hints of diesel that sting the senses.

name: Russian Assassin
abstract: Russian Assassin is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Skywalker, Lemon OG Kush, and Headband. The resulting buds are large, chunky, and covered in trichomes with dark red pistils throughout.

name: Russian Rocket Fuel
abstract: Russian Rocket fuel is a hybrid cross between NYC Diesel and an unknown indica. It has a flowering time of 8-10 weeks.

name: SAGE
abstract: S.A.G.E. is a well-balanced Haze cross with a robust indica strain.  Spicy sandalwood flavor combined with a long lasting and uplifting high make this the plant for those who like the best.

name: SFV OG
abstract: SFV OG is a hybrid marijuana strain that has a strong, sometimes harsh lemon and pine aroma. It’s most often used to treat pain.

name: SFV OG Kush
abstract: SFV OG Kush, not to be confused with its precursor SFV OG, is an indica-dominant strain bred from OG Kush genetics by The Cali Connection.

name: Sage N Sour
abstract: Sage N Sour by T.H. Seeds is a 75/25 sativa-dominant strain that unites the sharply pungent Sour Diesel with their SAGE hybrid.

name: Salmon River OG
abstract: Salmon River OG is an indica-dominant strain from Oregon breeders Dynasty Genetics, who combine a Pre-98 Bubba Kush clone with a carefully selected Blue Heron male.

name: Santa Maria
abstract: This tall, uplifting, sativa blend originates from the Brazilian Amazon. With hints of fruit and flowery flavors, the effects are described as long-lasting and energetic.

name: Sapphire Scout
abstract: Sapphire Scout is local legend grown by Vashon Velvet in Washington state. This sumptuous blend of medical-grade Girl Scout Cookie genetics crossed against True OG yields a plant that is equally potent and well-rounded.

name: Sapphire Star
abstract: Sapphire Star, a cross between Blue Hawaiian and God Bud, is a hybrid whose genetics and effects tip slightly toward the sativa side.

name: Sasquatch Sap
abstract: 3C Sasquatch Sap is a unique and heady sativa, dishing out a strong meditative mental state from the onset that slinks down into the body. The aroma and flavor of this flower’s tightly bound colas are distinctive, leading with a heavy dose of diesel and finishing with tartness on the palate.

name: Satellite OG
abstract: Bred by Satellite, Satellite OG is an indica-dominant cross between OG Kush and SFV OG.

name: Satori
abstract: Satori is a 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain that flowers in 9-10 weeks and produces light green flowers. This strain has a unique honey smell and taste.

name: Saturn OG
abstract: Saturn OG is a hybrid strain with mysterious beginnings, but its earthy citrus and diesel flavors confirms its close relationship to OG Kush.

name: Savant's Grail
abstract: Savant’s Grail is a hybrid strain from Michigan bred by 710 Savant. The undertones of piney kush, diesel fumes and a sweet, candied flavor that helped it take home 2nd place for Hybrid Flowers at the Michigan Cannabis Cup in 2015.

name: Schrom
abstract: Schrom is a 70% sativa strain that delivers a clear-headed buzz with a pungent lemon and lime aroma.

name: Scooby Snacks
parent_names: platinum girl scout cookies face off og
abstract: Scooby Snacks is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Platinum Girl Scout Cookies with Face Off OG. Its dense purple buds are full of piney OG Kush flavor and a sweet aftertaste.

name: Scott's OG
abstract: Scott’s OG is an indica-dominant hybrid strain bred by Rare Dankness Seeds, who crossed Triangle Kush with their Rare Dankness #1 to create this prominent OG variety.

name: Seattle Blue
abstract: Seattle Blue has a sweet and fruity taste that provides a strong and euphoric body high.  A great indica for relaxing.

name: Seattle Cough
abstract: Seattle Cough is a potent, long-lasting sativa hybrid grown by Dutch Brothers in Washington.

name: Secret Garden OG
abstract: Secret Garden OG is a Colorado Seed Inc. masterpiece. This OG strain is incredibly relaxing and dedicated to Kush fans everywhere. The blend of Lavender parentage against a Ghost OG Moonshine x Rug Burn OG foretells the weight this strain applies to muscles throughout the body.

name: Secret Recipe
abstract: After realizing the importance for medical patients to better understand their medicine Connoisseur Genetics released the genetic details in a popular grower’s forum. The father is attributed to a Chemdawg backcross, while the mother is a mix of Abusive OG and Diesel genetics.

name: Sensi Skunk
abstract: Sensi Skunk from Sensi Seeds is a potent Skunk #1 hybrid that offers a sweet citrus flavor in contrast with the earthy, herbal aroma typical of Skunk varieties.

name: Sensi Star
abstract: Sensi Star is a very strong indica with THC levels reaching up to 20%.

name: Sequoia Strawberry
abstract: Sequoia Strawberry by SinCity Seeds is a sativa-dominant strain with strong motivating attributes. The genetic offspring of White Strawberry and White Nightmare, Sequoia Strawberry delivers a delicious aroma of strawberry candy with a slightly hashy undertone.

name: Serious 6
abstract: Serious 6 from Serious Seeds mixes undefined Canadian genetics with sativa landraces from Africa.

name: Sexxpot
abstract: Sexxpot is an indica strain bred from Mr. Nice genetics that is said to have aphrodisiac qualities.

name: Shaman
abstract: Shaman is a sativa-dominant strain bred from Purple #1 and Skunk. This stinky, uplifting strain, originally crafted by Dutch Passion, is a welcome compliment to patients seeking assistance with depression, anxiety, and chronic pain.

name: Shangri-La
abstract: Shangri-La is a hybrid strain that takes you to a peaceful mindset where happiness and relaxation are no strangers.

name: Shark Attack
abstract: A 70/30 indica dominant hybrid from Dinafem Seeds, Shark Attack is a cross of Super Skunk and White Widow.

name: Shark Bite
abstract: A hybrid from Archive Seed Bank, Shark Bite combines Great White Shark with a Face Off OG backcross into one fast-finishing, easy-to-grow strain.

name: Shark Shock
abstract: Shark Shock is a cross of the famous White Widow and Skunk #1 strains.  This indica is also sometimes referred to as Peacemaker or Great White Shark.

name: Sharksbreath
abstract: Sharksbreath is a hybrid marijuana strain originally bred by DNA Genetics. It flowers in 9 weeks and its shorter plants produce heavy yields.

name: Shiatsu Kush
abstract: From the island of Amami Oshima comes Shiatsu Kush, a powerful hybrid strain brought from Japan by BC Bud Depot.

name: Shipwreck
abstract: Shipwreck is a sativa cannabis strain that’s great for getting things done and then relaxing. This descendant of Trainwreck can be hard to find.

name: Shishkaberry
abstract: Shiskaberry is a hybrid strain with a sweet fruit and berry aroma that comes from its Blueberry lineage. Plants mature in 8 to 9 weeks.

name: Shiskaquine
abstract: Shiskaquine is semi-sedative, CBD heavy strain with heirloom indica genetics out of the Emerald Triangle. With a 20:1 CBD-to-THC ratio, this flower is dense with resin and smells of sweet berries and skunk.

name: Shiva Skunk
abstract: Shiva Skunk by Sensi Seeds is a potent indica cross between Northern Lights #5 and Skunk #1.

name: Shoreline
abstract: Shoreline is a hybrid marijuana strain that originated in Texas and quickly gained fame for its potency and super strong skunk smell.

name: Silver Back
abstract: Silver Back by Colorado Seed Inc. is a potent and mysterious strain. With unknown Hawaiian genetics that mutated during mainland propagation, this strain was described as a “boutique Hawaiian crystal-beast.”

name: Silver Bubble
abstract: Silver Bubble is a timeless Dutch strain that provides well-rounded effects and an aroma spiced with sandalwood.

name: Silver Cindy
abstract: Colorado Seed Inc. brings speedy effects and excessive trichome production to market with Silver Cindy, the hybrid cross of Silver Back and Rebel God Smoke. With stimulating effects and heady potency, this strain offers the consumer an aggressive sativa experience that lends itself to athletes, laborers, and outdoorsy types.

name: Silver Haze
abstract: A 75/25 sativa hybrid, the Silver Haze buzz is strong and clear.

name: Silver Kush
abstract: Silver Kush is a sativa-dominant mix of Silver Bubble and OG #18 genetics bred by DNA Genetics under their Reserva Privada label.

name: Silver Nina
abstract: Silver Nina by Colorado Seed Inc. is the stabilized cross of Silver Back and Nina Limone. Like Gupta Kush, Nina Limone appears in many CO Seed Inc. crosses due to its excellent flavor, aroma, and effects. This sweet, citrusy strain offers consumers a palpable stimulation without being overwhelming.

name: Silver Pearl
abstract: Silver Pearl is an award-winning cannabis strain that is sativa dominant and may have psychedelic effects.

name: Silver Surfer
abstract: Silver Surfer is a strong sativa strain that is a result of crossing Super Silver Haze and Blue Dream. Plants flower in 8 to 9 weeks.

name: Silver Train
abstract: Silver Train is a hybrid of two very well-known and popular strains, Super Silver Haze and Trainwreck, that produces very resinous flowers and a sweet-spicy aroma that is similar to that of Trainwreck.

name: Silverback Gorilla
abstract: Silverback Gorilla is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Grape Ape and Super Silver Haze. A nighttime strain, Silverback is very potent.

name: Silverfalls Kush
abstract: Silverfalls Kush is a disease-resistant strain that is known to grow strong and tall in many different environments. Its 50/50 hybrid genetics make it versatile and well suited for mood enhancement and paint relief.

name: Silverhawks OG
parent_names: super silver haze white fire alien og
abstract: Silverhawks OG is a strong cross between Super Silver Haze and White Fire Alien OG, preferred by consumers for daytime use.

name: Sin City Kush
abstract: Sin City Kush is an 80/20 indica-dominant cross of LVPK and Snowdawg bred by Alphakronik Genes Seeds. The buds of Sin City Kush are a mix of deep purple and green hues with a glossy coat of white trichomes and a compelling floral aroma.

name: Sin Valley OG
abstract: Sin Valley OG is a 60/40 indica-dominant cannabis strain bred by Sin City Seeds, who crossed SFV OG with a Blue Power indica.

name: SinMint Cookies
abstract: SinMint Cookies is Sin City Seeds’ signature hybrid cross between Girl Scout Cookies and Blue Power.

name: Sinai
abstract: Sinai, also known as Red Sea, is an Egyptian landrace strain cultivated on the Sinai Peninsula by the indigenous Bedouin population. There are two known phenotypes of the variety: a shorter tree-like indica expression and a taller sativa-like vine that is easier to train.

name: Sirius Black
abstract: Sirius Black by the Oregon Breeders Group is a deep purple indica strain with a rich terpene profile. Exhibiting a strong flavor and aroma of sweet grapes, Sirius Black’s palate is tart but smooth on the exhale.

name: Six Shooter
parent_names: haze northern lights super skunk trainwreck
abstract: Six Shooter by Royal Dutch Genetics is a six-way cross that comes out as a sativa-dominant hybrid with effects as diverse as its lineage. By crossing Haze, Super Skunk, Northern Lights, Brazilian, Royal Dutch, and Trainwreck, this strain achieves a symphony of effects that lean ever so gently toward the stimulating side, complementing the latent indica effect nestled deep between a calyxes of this flower.

name: Skins Skunk
abstract: Skins Skunk is a 60% indica hybrid from Loud Seeds is a result of years of work that started by pollinating an elite clone-only Afgoo found in Sonoma with a male Michigan Skunk.

name: Skunk 47
abstract: Skunk 47, offspring of Skunk #1 and AK-47, is a sour-smelling hybrid strain that leans far to the indica side of the family.

name: Skunk Dawg
abstract: Skunk Dawg is a sativa cross between Super Skunk and Chemdawg that elevates the mood with a sweet and sour aroma.

name: Skunk Haze
abstract: Skunk Haze by Mr. Nice Seeds is a sativa-dominant hybrid with Skunk and Haze heritage.

name: Skunk No. 1
abstract: Skunk #1, first bred by Sensi Seeds in the '80s, is a hybrid strain that has influenced cannabis breeding on a global scale.

name: Skunkberry
abstract: Skunkberry is the odoriferous hybrid cross of parent strains Skunk and Blueberry. While the genetic makeup of this strain might seem commonplace, the unique terpenes specific to each of these fine cannabis varieties (and their robust and varied lineages) contribute to the complexity of this strain's effects.

name: Skunky Diesel
abstract: A cross of Sensi Skunk with NYC Diesel.  Skunky Diesel comes on fast and strong.

name: Skydog
abstract: Skydog is notorious for being a pretty intense strain that takes consumers to new heights.

name: Skywalker
abstract: Skywalker is a hybrid cannabis strain that can be helpful in treating pain and insomnia. Indica- dominant, these plants are hardy and stay small.

name: Skywalker Alien
abstract: Skywalker Alien is an indica-dominant hybrid strain that inherits a staggering THC content from its parent strains.

name: Skywalker OG
abstract: Skywalker OG is an indica-dominant cannabis strain known for its strong body effects and potent aroma.

name: Slazerbeam
abstract: A sativa-dominant hybrid of Super Lemon Haze and Gupta Kush, Slazerbeam is loaded with dense, zesty buds.

name: SleeSkunk
abstract: SleeSkunk is a hybrid bred by DNA Genetics that crosses SleeStack with Skunk #1. The result is a resinous, sativa-dominant cross that produces clear, uplifting effects focused in the head.

name: SleeStack
abstract: SleeStack is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by DNA Genetics. The large yields and sharp fuel flavors of Schrom combine with the vigorous growth and pungent, piney flavors of Martian Mean Green to create an uplifting hybrid with a rich fragrance.

name: Slimer OG
parent_names: ghost og white fire alien og
abstract: The Slimer OG hybrid offers a double dose of ocean grown genetics through the heavy but functional Ghost OG and the complex aroma and subdued stimulation of White Fire Alien OG.

name: Smelliot
abstract: Smelliot, named after its flavorful and pungent buds, is a sativa dominant hybrid that crosses Abusive OG with NYC Diesel.

name: Smooth Operator
abstract: Smooth Operator is an ideal cut for consumers seeking mental alertness wrapped in a haze of mid-level sedation. Developed by Colorado Seed Inc. through crossbreeding Hawaiian Purple Trainwreck with Rug Burn OG, this strain produces aromas of sweet fuel and citrus trees.

name: Snoop Dogg OG
abstract: Named after the rap artist and cannabis enthusiast, Snoop Dogg OG is a 70% indica-dominant hybrid strain that is said to contain Lemon OG and Sour Diesel genetics.

name: Snoop's Dream
abstract: Snoop’s dream is an indica dominant strain of marijuana bred from two of the rapper’s rumored favorites, Blue Dream and Master Kush.

name: Snow Bud
abstract: Named after its snow-like resin and white pistils, Snow Bud by Dutch Passion is a hybrid that crosses Afghani and an unknown South African strain.

name: Snow Diesel
parent_names: east coast sour diesel snow lotus
abstract: Snow Diesel, bred by House of Funk Genetics, is a hybrid that was developed by crossing an East Coast Sour Diesel clone with a Snow Lotus male. Known for its extreme yields even under the constraints of indoor cultivation, Snow Diesel produces a range of diesel aromas that shift from sweet candied flavors to a dank musky funk.

name: Snow Leopard
abstract: Snow Leopard, from the mysterious breeder Bodhi Seeds, is one of the more unique seed strains out there, crossing the dual multinational genetics of Tigermelon and Snow Lotus.

name: Snow Lotus
abstract: Snow Lotus is a mostly indica hybrid of Afgooey and Blockhead bred by Bodhi Seeds that is sometimes referred to as Goohead.

name: Snow Monster
abstract: Snow Monster from Exotic Genetix is an indica strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Snow Mountain
abstract: Snow Mountain is an indica-dominant strain that combines the flavorful, high-yielding Snowcap with Pure Kush and a rare Uzbekistani line.

name: Snow Ryder
abstract: Snow Ryder is an indica-dominant auto-flowering strain available only in feminized seed form from Sensi Seeds.

name: Snow White
abstract: Early and abundant resin production is attributed to her White Widow mother.

name: SnowLAnd
abstract: SnowLAnd is a cross of Snowcap and LA Confidential created in an attempt to tame the huge size of Snowcap while still producing large yields of potent, highly-resinous flowers.

name: Snowcap
abstract: A legendary West Coast strain, Snowcap's known for it's lemony scent and cerebral effects.

name: Sojay Haze
abstract: Sojay Haze by Cresco Labs is a powerful sativa with uplifting attributes. Cresco Farms brought the famous BC Big Bud and the rare Grape FX together to create a sweet, satisfying flavor and deep physical effects.

name: Somango
abstract: Somango from Soma Seeds is a 75% indica strain bred by crossing Jack Herer, Super Skunk, and Big Skunk Korean.

name: Sonic Screwdriver
abstract: Sonic Screwdriver by TGA Subcool Genetics has been dubbed one of the best yielding plants of all time. With genetic parents Orange Cream Soda and Trainwreck, Sonic Screwdriver leans toward the sativa side, offering stimulating effects with bright, complex terpenes of ripening citrus and forest floor.

name: Sonoma Coma
abstract: Sonoma Coma sprouted in Sonoma County, California and presents itself with tight, electric green buds which produce a thick coat of trichomes that sparkle in the sunlight. Contrary to what the name implies, Sonoma Coma is actually an energetic, uplifting sativa.

name: Soul Assassin OG
abstract: Soul Assassin OG is an OG Kush variety bred by the Soul Assassins Crew, a collective of musicians and artists affiliated with the hip hop group Cypress Hill.

name: Soul Shine
abstract: Soul Shine is a cerebral hybrid with a fruity aroma. This strain creates an almost psychedelic sensation while simultaneously relaxing muscles.

name: Sour Alien
abstract: Sour Alien by the Cali Connection is a 60% indica-dominant hybrid cross between Alien Kush and Sour Diesel.

name: Sour Amnesia
abstract: Sour Amnesia has an earthy, floral aroma that is enhanced by the citrus, diesel zest of Sour Diesel.

name: Sour Ape
abstract: Another finely crafted strain by Colorado growers at Joseph Arthur Botanicals, Sour Ape is an 80/20 indica-dominant hybrid cross between the legendary Sour Diesel and Grape Ape.

name: Sour Apple
abstract: Sour Apple is an indica-dominant cross between Sour Diesel and Pure Kush. This strain is a powerful sedative and features a candy aroma.

name: Sour Banana Sherbet
abstract: This powerful hybrid from Crockett Family Farms is the result of crossing AJ’s Sour Diesel with Banana Sherbet.

name: Sour Bubba
abstract: Sour Bubba blends two famous strains that are robust all on their own but, when unified, show unique flavors and effects that speak to their long, potent lineages.

name: Sour Bubble
abstract: Sour Bubble is an indica bred by B.O.G. Seeds parented by solely BOG Bubble.

name: Sour Candy
abstract: Sour Candy is a predominantly sativa mix of Sour Diesel and Bubble Gum.

name: Sour Cheese
abstract: Sour Cheese is an uplifting marijuana strain that inspires creative thoughts. Growers also like these plants for their high yields.

name: Sour Chocolate
abstract: Sour Chocolate is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain with a sweet and sour taste. This strain gives patients moderate body effects.

name: Sour Chunk
parent_names: deep chunk east coast sour diesel
abstract: Sour Chunk is a hybrid strain that combines the potency of a Deep Chunk indica with the pungent skunky aroma of East Coast Sour Diesel.

name: Sour Cookies
abstract: Sour Cookies is a blend of Girl Scout Cookies and Sour Diesel. This cross combines the medical-grade sedation of GSC with the uplifted, cerebral, mood enhancing effects of Sour Diesel. The smell is doughy and pungent with overtones of fuel and hash.

name: Sour Cream
abstract: Sour Cream is a sativa-dominant cross between G-13 Haze and Sour Diesel, which lends this strain a sour, fuel-like aroma.

name: Sour Diesel
abstract: Sour Diesel, sometimes called Sour D, is an invigorating sativa named after its pungent, diesel-like aroma.

name: Sour Dream
abstract: Sour Dream is an uplifting hybrid cross between Blue Dream and Sour Diesel. Taking after Sour Diesel, Sour Dream has a strong, pungent aroma.

name: Sour Dubble
abstract: Originally a mysterious clone-only strain of unknown heritage, Sour Dubble is thought to be a cross of East Coast Sour Diesel and Sour Bubble.

name: Sour Flower
abstract: Sour Flower is a sativa that provides relief from pain and anxiety.

name: Sour Grape
abstract: Not to be confused with “Sour Grapes,” Sour Grape is a well-balanced hybrid cross between Sour Diesel and Granddaddy Purple. It tastes just like sour grape candy.

name: Sour Haze
abstract: Sour Haze is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that is known for its strong lemon aroma and focused high.

name: Sour Headband
abstract: As its name implies, Sour Headband is a cross between two of the most famous cannabis strains in the United States, Sour Diesel and Headband.

name: Sour Jack
abstract: Sour Jack, one-half Sour Diesel one-half and Jack Herer, takes its name from its parents. It has developed a solid reputation and is highlighted by an intense aroma and profound cerebral effects.

name: Sour Jilly
abstract: Sour Jilly is a hybrid strain descended from Jilly Bean that won first place in the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Sour Joker
parent_names: amnesia haze east coast sour diesel
abstract: Sour Joker is the stimulating sativa blend of Amnesia Haze and East Coast Sour Diesel (ECSD). This amped combination offers consumers a vigorous body buzz that is clear headed and motivating, encouraging physical activity in or outside.

name: Sour Kush
abstract: Sour Kush is a potent cross between Sour Diesel and OG Kush. It's a great daytime strain as it relieves pain without sedative effects.

name: Sour LSD
abstract: Elevating the senses to new heights, Sour LSD is a great companion strain for enjoying the outdoors or creative activities.

name: Sour Lemon OG
abstract: Bred by Emerald Triangle Seeds, Sour Lemon OG is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between California Sour and Lemon OG.

name: Sour Maui
abstract: Sour Maui is a sativa cross between Maui Wowie and Sour Diesel.

name: Sour OG
abstract: Sour OG is a cross of Sour Diesel and OG Kush.  A very nice weed to smoke, not overly powerful but provides a relaxing yet energetic high.

name: Sour Pebbles
abstract: Sour Pebbles, grown by Fire Bros. in Washington state, is a sativa cross between Alien Diesel and Fruity Pebbles

name: Sour Poison
abstract: Sour Poison is a sweet, earthy sativa-dominant hybrid of Sour Diesel and Durban Poison genetics.

name: Sour Power
abstract: Sour Power, bred by HortiLab Seeds, is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Star Bud and East Coast Sour Diesel.

name: Sour Spyder
abstract: Sour Spyder is a combination of two autoflowering strains built for their resilience in the garden and speed of production.

name: Sour Strawberry Diesel
abstract: Sour Strawberry Diesel by MTG Seeds is a hybrid cross between Sour Strawberry and Turbo Diesel.

name: Sour Sunset
abstract: Featuring high yields, THC levels well over 20%, and great bag appeal, Sour Sunset is sure to be a favorite with growers.

name: Sour Tangie
abstract: DNA Genetics’ Sour Tangie is an 80% sativa cross between East Coast Sour Diesel and Tangie.

name: Sour Tsunami
abstract: Sour Tsunami is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain bred for its high CBD levels. It is used medicinally to treat inflammation, pain, and other conditions.

name: Sour Urkle
abstract: Sour Urkle is a hybrid cannabis strain that unites Sour Diesel and Purple Urkle, whose opposing sativa and indica genetics meet in a balanced and flavorful fusion.

name: Sour Willie
abstract: Sour Willie is a sativa crossed between Sour Diesel and Willie Nelson.

name: Sourlope
abstract: Sourlope is a sativa-dominant cross known for its uplifting and energetic effects. Believed to be a hybrid of NYC Diesel and Cannalope Haze genetics, Sourlope creates a mix of tropical flavors that are sharpened by a strong diesel note.

name: South American
abstract: South American refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: South Asian Indica
abstract: South Asian refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis (or landraces) that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: South Asian Sativa
abstract: South Asian refers to the indigenous sativa varieties of cannabis (or landraces) that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: South Central LA
abstract: South Central LA is a high-THC indica strain from Root Seller Seeds.

name: South Indian Indica
abstract: South Indian refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis (or landraces) that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: South Indian Sativa
abstract: South Indian refers to the indigenous varieties of cannabis that grow natively in this region of the world.

name: Southern Lights
abstract: Southern Lights, formerly known as White Star, from Delta 9 Labs takes NYC Diesel and adds just a touch of earthy indica flavor from Sensi Star to the mix.

name: Space Bomb
abstract: Space Bomb is a cannabis strain that was developed by TGA Seeds in 2006. It is a speedy grower that flowers at 7-8 weeks with light green and orange buds.

name: Space Candy
abstract: Space Candy originally comes from the gardens of TGA Genetics, who bred this hybrid strain by crossing Cherry Space Queen and Cotton Candy.

name: Space Cream
abstract: Space Cream by Hotsause Genetics is an indica-dominant hybrid with surprisingly uplifting effects. This strain keeps the consumer alert, but hazy mental effects may make it difficult to articulate that alertness. In a way, it gives your mind couchlock while allowing the body to roam unencumbered.

name: Space Dawg
abstract: Space Dawg is an indica-dominant strain of cannabis known for its potency and fruit candy aroma.

name: Space Jill
abstract: Space Jill by TGA Genetics is an F2 recreation of the famed Space Queen hybrid, which crossed Romulan with Cinderella 99.

name: Space Monster
abstract: Space Monster is an indica-dominant strain that grows tall and has been employed by growers to improve yield in confined spaces.

name: Space Needle
abstract: Space Needle, named after Seattle's iconic landmark, is a mostly sativa strain descended from Blue Dream and Vortex.

name: Space Queen
abstract: A cross of Romulan and Cinderella 99, very fruity taste and head high.

name: Special K
abstract: Special K is a hybrid cross between sativa Western Winds and indica Slyder.

name: Special Kush #1
abstract: Special Kush #1 by Royal Queen Seeds is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that descends from the original varieties of the Afghanistan and Pakistan region.

name: Spirit of '76
abstract: Spirit of 76 is a hybrid bred by Kindman out of Denver, CO who closely guard the genetic heritage of their proprietary strains.

name: Spliff’s Strawberry
parent_names: strawberry cough jack herer skunk no. 1
abstract: Created by Dutch Seedbank, Spliff’s Strawberry is a zealously strong sativa-dominant strain with an in-your-face fresh berry flavor.

name: Spoetnik #1
abstract: Spoetnik #1 by Paradise Seeds (not to be confused with Sputnik) is named for the CCCP satellite sent into space in 1957. While the full genetic cross remains a mystery, this plant exhibits strong Afghani traits, including rich, dark buds that have an earthy aroma intermixed with subtle fruitiness.

name: Sputnik
abstract: What happens when you cross a space-themed Apollo 13 strain with Black Russian? You get Sputnik.

name: Spyder Mon
abstract: Spyder Mon is an uplifting CBD strain with a good lineage, getting its manageable euphoria and anti-inflammatory effects from Midnight Farm’s Super Skunk and Florin Wellness Center’s Charlotte’s Web.

name: Star 47
abstract: Star 47 sounds like a cosmological address, but it’s actually the combined efforts of Sensi Star and AK-47 to create a hybrid worth sharing. These stains were bred together by World of Seeds (seed) Bank. It exhibits a bright aroma of citrus and pine that is pleasurable all on their own, and the effects are lucid and uplifting while remaining centered in a physical placidity.

name: Star Berry Indica
abstract: Star Berry Indica is an indica bred by CannaVenture crossed between Sensi Star and Blueberry.

name: Star Killer
abstract: Star Killer is a 70% indica crossed between Skywalker OG and RD#2.

name: Star Master Kush
parent_names: sensi star master kush medicine man platinum kush
abstract: Star Master Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid strain from the gardens of Zion Cannabis in Portland, Oregon.

name: Star Tonic
abstract: Star Tonic is a high-CBD strain bred from Death Star and Cannatonic parents. This hybrid is appreciated by medical patients for its relaxing effects that calm pain and stress without losing focus.

name: StarBud
abstract: This potent indica originated from a mystery clone out of the Midwest United States. StarBud is appreciated for its relaxing body effects and its ability to cradle consumers to sleep.

name: Stardawg
abstract: Stardawg is a hybrid cross of Chemdawg 4 and Tres Dawg that helps patients remedy stress and mood disorders.

name: Stardawg Guava
abstract: Stardawg Guava won first place for “Best Sativa” at the 2012 Denver Cannabis Cup. This strain hits the consumer square between the eyes with uplifting sativa stimulation and then cascades over the body with a subtle, vibrating warmth. Its aroma is mild but doesn’t lack nuance, expressing notes of pine, cheese, and tartness.

name: Starfighter
abstract: Bred by Alien Genetics, Starfighter mixes genetics from Alien Tahoe OG and Lemon Alien Dawg to create a sweetly aromatic, uplifting hybrid that boasts its potency with a sparkling coat of star-like trichomes.

name: Stella Blue
abstract: Stella Blue is a 70% sativa strain from Humboldt County, California, cherished for its fruity aroma and happy, uplifting qualities.

name: Stephen Hawking Kush
abstract: Named for famed scientist Dr. Stephen Hawking, SHK was created by pollenating a Harle-Tsu female with a Sin City Kush male.

name: Stevie Wonder
parent_names: trainwreck sensi star bubba kush blueberry
abstract: Stevie Wonder is a sativa-dominant hybrid born from the famed tetrad of Trainwreck, Sensi Star, Bubba Kush, and Blueberry.

name: Strawberry
abstract: Originally bred in the Netherlands, Strawberry is a mostly sativa cannabis strain with a pungent fruity scent and uplifting effects.

name: Strawberry Amnesia
abstract: A powerful and uplifting flower from Dinafem, Strawberry Amnesia is a strain made in sativa heaven

name: Strawberry Banana
abstract: Strawberry Banana is a hybrid strain that competed in the 2014 L.A. Cannabis Cup.

name: Strawberry Blue
abstract: Strawberry Blue is a 75% sativa bred by World of Seeds that crosses Strawberry and New Blue Line.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake
abstract: Strawberry Cheesecake is a 70% indica strain that combines the genetics of White Widow, Chronic, and Cheese.

name: Strawberry Cough
abstract: This sativa-dominant strain smells of fresh strawberries and will tickle your lungs. Good for a lift of spirits or going out and enjoying the great outdoors.

name: Strawberry Diesel
abstract: Strawberry Diesel is a true hybrid. A cross between NYC Diesel and Strawberry Cough, it’s a potent strain that flowers in 9-10 weeks.

name: Strawberry Dream
abstract: Strawberry Dream is a cross of Blue Dream and Strawberry Cough.  It's a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid strain that is very potent and sweet-smelling.

name: Strawberry Durban Diesel
abstract: Strawberry Durban Diesel is an 80% sativa-dominant strain that finishes flowering in 8-10 weeks and can produce THC levels up to 25%.

name: Strawberry Fields
abstract: Strawberry Fields is an indica strain that takes the flavorful Strawberry Cough and crosses it with an undisclosed indica parent.

name: Strawberry Frost
parent_names: strawberry cough deep chunk space queen
abstract: Strawberry Frost by MaddFarmer is a three-way cross of fruity trichome producers. The genetic descendant of a Strawberry Cough/Deep Chunk hybrid crossed with Space Queen, Strawberry Frost is a heady indica-dominant strain that is gentle on the body.

name: Strawberry Ice
abstract: Strawberry Ice is a heady, energetic sativa-dominant strain that was named Best Sativa at the 2015 Oregon DOPE Cup. With big colorful flowers that emit an aroma of fresh strawberries, Strawberry Ice is a great choice for staying active and motivated throughout your day.

name: Strawberry Kush
abstract: Strawberry Kush is an indica-dominant hybrid between Strawberry Cough and OG Kush. Genetics may vary depending on dispensary and location.

name: Strawberry Lemonade
abstract: Strawberry Lemonade is a mostly sativa strain that took 1st in High Times’ 2015 Cannabis Cup as “Best Sativa Concentrate.”

name: Strawberry Mango Haze
abstract: Strawberry Mango Haze is a beautiful synergy of effects that just happen to be dressed in sweet, fruity aromas. This strain achieves deep mental haziness and subtle degree of stimulation by combining Strawberry Cough and Mango Haze.

name: Strawberry Milkshake
abstract: Strawberry Milkshake, a perfect 50/50 hybrid, flaunts the fruity flavor of its parent, Strawberry Soda, and the pungent richness of White Fire Alien OG.

name: Strawberry OG
abstract: Strawberry OG (not to be confused with OG Strawberry) is the product of a laborious search for stable strawberry flavor mixed against Bruce Banner’s exceptional structure, yield, and early flowering schedule.

name: Strawberry Satori
abstract: Strawberry Satori is a mostly sativa strain, fathered by Satori and mothered by Strawberry Cough.

name: Sublime
abstract: Sublime is a 70% sativa strain that delivers energizing effects alongside a tropical fruity flavor.

name: Sugar Black Rose
abstract: Sugar Black Rose is a cross of Critical+ and Black Domina bred by Delicious Seeds.

name: Sugar Cookie
parent_names: blue hawaiian sensi star crystal gayle
abstract: Sugar Cookie is an indica-dominant hybrid cross between Sensi Star, Blue Hawaiian, and Crystal Gale.

name: Sugar Kush
abstract: Sugar Kush is an indica-dominant cross between Kandy Kush and Hash Plant.

name: Sugar Mama
abstract: A hybrid of two well-known indicas, Sugar Mama is praised for her over-sized colas and sugary flavors.

name: Sugar Pine
abstract: Sugar Pine has been a work in progress for the last two decades, crossing and backcrossing specific cannabis genetics to compose an ideal sativa-dominant hybrid that is simultaneously uplifting and soothing. Produced by Flying Dutchman Gardens, Sugar Pine is an eclectic hybrid with genetics that include Skunk, Sugar Bush, Afghani, and Sweetie.

name: Sugar Plum
abstract: Sugar Plum from Stoney Girl Gardens is an award-winning sativa bred by crossing Berkeley Blues and Hawaiian Haze Plum.

name: Sugar Punch
abstract: Sugar Punch is a sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Sannie Seeds crossed between Super Silver Haze and The One.

name: Sugar Shack
abstract: Sugar Shack is a moderate hybrid with indica-dominant effects. It’s great for those who suffer from insomnia and lack of appetite.

name: Suicide Girl
parent_names: og poison platinum girl scout cookies
abstract: Suicide Girl by Calyx Gardens is the cleverly named cross of Poison OG and Platinum Girl Scout Cookies. This beautiful and potent cannabis strain delivers hearty mid-level sedation in the body and a sizzling mental buzz that carries the consumer forward.

name: Summertime Squeeze
abstract: Summertime Squeeze is a sativa-dominant strain whose aroma brings to mind fresh citrus and tropical fruit.

name: Sumo Grande
abstract: Sumo Grande is a unique cross that builds off the old school genetics of Sensi Star and Sour Diesel to create Hong Kong, which is then crossed with the sativa Nina Limone, a citrusy yield powerhouse.

name: Sun Ra
abstract: Sun Ra is a powerful blend of Colorado Seed Inc.’s most potent sativas, Sunburn and Rebel God Smoke. This heady synthesis yields a strain that stimulates the mind and body with upbeat energy. It has a pleasant and spicy aroma, yielding notes of fuel, earth, and a latent fruitiness that fades into the background.

name: Sunburn
parent_names: island sweet skunk rug burn og
abstract: Sunburn is a lime green sativa-dominant hybrid that reeks of old, sweet genetics. Sunburn began as Island Sweet Skunk crossed with Rug Burn OG. Island Sweet Skunk’s genetics supposedly crossed the ocean with Vietnam Veterans.

name: Sunlight Skunk
abstract: Sunlight Skunk from Zion Botanicals is a hybrid cannabis strain bred from Skunk #1 genetics.

name: Sunset Haze
abstract: Much like a summer sunset, Sunset Haze's buds burst with hues of pink, purple, and red.

name: Sunset Sherbet
abstract: Heir to the Girl Scout Cookies throne is Sunset Sherbet, an indica-leaning hybrid with intoxicatingly potent effects.

name: Sunshine
abstract: Sunshine is an uplifting, citrusy sativa-dominant cannabis strain produced by the Canadian LP Peace Naturals Project.

name: Sunshine #4
abstract: Sunshine #4 is an award-winning hybrid bred by Bodhi Seeds. This blend of Chemdawg 4 and Sunshine Daydream genetics took the prize for Best Hybrid Flower at the 2015 High Times Medical Cup in Michigan.

name: Sunshine Daydream
abstract: From Bodhi Seeds comes Sunshine Daydream, an indica-dominant cross between Appalachia and Bubbashine.

name: Supa Don
abstract: Supa Don is a 70% sativa strain bred from Oregon Trainwreck (also called “The Don”) and DJ Short Blueberry.

name: Super  Chronic
abstract: Super Chronic is an indica-dominant cross between a pre-‘98 Chronic and Critical Kush.

name: Super Blue Dream
abstract: Super Blue Dream is the product of a cross between Super Silver Haze and Blueberry. This hybrid features a sour blueberry aroma.

name: Super Bud
abstract: Super Bud (or Superbud) is an indica-dominant cross between Big Bud and Skunk bred by Green House Seeds.

name: Super Cat Piss
abstract: The Super Cat Piss strain smells just like you would imagine.  The name doesn't provoke very appetizing ideas but this is a great sativa.

name: Super Cheese
abstract: Super Cheese, bred by Positronics, is a throwback to the old school strains that filled the coffee shops of Amsterdam in the late 1980s. Super Cheese was created through inbreeding, crossing Cheese genetics with another select phenotype believed to be Exodus Cheese.

name: Super G
abstract: Super G by Soulshine Cannabis is a Haze-heavy powerplayer that combines the stimulating elements of G-13 and Super Silver Haze. This sativa-dominant combination smells of Haze, exhibiting earth and skunk aromas and pine on the exhale.

name: Super Green Crack
abstract: Super Green Crack is a true sativa. The product of a cross between Super Silver Haze and Green Crack, this strain is uplifting and energizing.

name: Super Jack
abstract: A super sativa! Super Jack mixes Super Silver Haze with the illustrious Jack Herer to create a sweet, spiced blend with a rich buttery aroma.

name: Super Kush
abstract: Super Kush is a cross of Northern Lights #5 and Hindu Kush. An easy indica, this strain grows best indoors and flowers between 7-8 weeks.

name: Super Lemon Haze
abstract: Super Lemon Haze from Green House Seeds is a cross between Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze. This strain has a lemon smell and a sweet taste.

name: Super Lemon OG
abstract: Super Lemon OG from DNA Genetics crosses two notable cannabis strains to create a flavorful burst of lemony OG Kush that is sweet and earthy.

name: Super Silver Haze
abstract: Super SIlver Haze is an award-winning, energetic sativa cross between Skunk, Northern Lights, and Haze.

name: Super Silver Lights
abstract: Super Silver Lights is a hybrid strain with effects that quickly transition from functional to deeply sedating with every hit. With an uplifting onset that settles behind the eyes, Super Silver Lights is immediately euphoric, leaving the taste of mint, herbs, and earth on the palate.

name: Super Skunk
abstract: Skunk lovers rejoice, Super Skunk was bred specifically for you. The strong skunky smell provides a very pleasant high to all who try it.

name: Super Snow Dog
abstract: Super Snow Dog, a sativa-dominant strain from the Chemdawg family, is  typically used for daytime relief of stress and tension.

name: Super Sour Diesel
abstract: Super Sour Diesel is a potent cross between Super Silver Haze and Sour Diesel. This strain is a sociable sativa with strong cerebral effects.

name: Super Sour OG
parent_names: blueberry sour diesel og kush lost coast og
abstract: Super Sour OG is a 50/50 hybrid from Emerald Triangle combines well-known strains Blueberry, Sour Diesel, and OG Kush with Lost Coast OG to excellent effect.

name: Super Sour Skunk
parent_names: east coast sour diesel super skunk
abstract: Super Sour Skunk from Hortilab Seeds is a hybrid that was developed when an old school Super Skunk clone (pre-98) from Holland was pollinated by an East Coast Sour Diesel male.

name: Super Sour Widow
abstract: Super Sour Widow, a cross of Super Sour Diesel and White Widow, is a sour and skunky top-shelf hybrid.

name: Super Sweet
abstract: Super Sweet is an indica-dominant hybrid strain that was bred in Flint, Michigan by Masterpiece Medical Group.

name: Supergirl
abstract: Nirvana Seeds created Supergirl by backcrossing the famous Skunk #1 and focusing on the indica portion of that strain’s genetics.

name: Superglue
abstract: Superglue, bred by Seedism Seeds, is a hybrid strain that crosses Skunk #1 with Northern Lights.

name: Superman OG
abstract: Superman OG is a potent indica-dominant cross between Tahoe OG and Bubba Kush. A favorite among connoisseurs, this strain is very potent.

name: Supermax OG
abstract: Supermax OG is a hybrid strain that delivers everything an OG Kush enthusiast cherishes most: fast-acting euphoria that hits like a train alongside an earthy, piney aroma.

name: Supernatural
abstract: A pungent fruity mixture of Grape God and The Flav, Supernatural is a great indoor strain that has a biting, skunky zest and uplifting sativa effects.

name: Supernova
abstract: Supernova, formerly called “Chronic,” is an indica-dominant hybrid from Amsterdam.

name: Superstar
abstract: Superstar by Exotic Genetix is a sativa hybrid cross between their Starfighter and Supernatural strains.

name: Suzy Q
abstract: Suzy Q is a high CBD, low-THC strain with a piney taste that helps treat symptoms with little to no “high.”

name: Swazi Gold
abstract: Swazi Gold is a sativa landrace from Malawi, Africa, known for its sweet, citrus flavor and fast-acting effects.

name: Sweet Baby Jane
abstract: Sweet Baby Jane by Vashon Island Organics for Cresco Labs is an indica-dominant strain of the highest caliber. Known for its creeping sedative body buzz, this strain glues consumers to their seats, infusing the limbs with deep relaxation that slowly teeters toward sleep.

name: Sweet Berry
abstract: Sweet Berry is a hybrid cross between two flavor powerhouses, Chernobyl and Blueberry.

name: Sweet Black Angel
abstract: Sweet Black Angel presents a sweet musky odor with undertones of blackberry, and a relaxing body high most suitable for nighttime use for the treatment of pain, anxiety, and insomnia.

name: Sweet Cheese
abstract: Sweet Cheese is a 70% sativa strain that combines the potency and unique flavor profiles of Cheese and Black Jack.

name: Sweet Deep Grapefruit
abstract: Sweet Deep Grapefruit is an indica-dominant cross of Grapefruit and Blueberry genetics, bred by Dinafem Seeds. The intense, relaxing effects of the Sweet Deep Grapefruit cannabis strain are led by a unique fruity flavor and carry a captivating, sweet aroma that lures the senses.

name: Sweet Diesel
abstract: Sweet Diesel is an earthy cross between Sour Diesel and OG Kush. This sativa features a light fuel aroma and produces a head-heavy effect.

name: Sweet Dream
abstract: Sweet Dream by Colorado Seed Inc. combines a local Colorado favorite, Al’s Dream, with the newborn local legend, Gupta Kush. This union offers consumers the heady stimulation of Al’s Dream (an Albert Walker and Blue Dream cross) and the medical-grade potency of Gupta Kush all in one well-cured package.

name: Sweet Dreams
abstract: Sweet Dreams is an aptly named indica-dominant hybrid that is known for its tendency to creep up on consumers, leaving them deeply relaxed to the point of sleepiness.

name: Sweet Jane
abstract: Sweet Jane is a sweet-flavored sativa strain that provides an uplifting burst of cerebral energy ideal for daytime use.

name: Sweet Kush
abstract: Sweet Kush is the potent daughter of Sweet Tooth and OG Kush. Featuring a citrusy sweet taste, this strain is both cerebral and relaxing.

name: Sweet Lafayette
abstract: Sweet Lafayette is an 80% indica strain with mellow, dreamy qualities conducive to relaxation and stress relief.

name: Sweet Nina
abstract: Sweet Nina by Colorado Seed Inc. is a hybrid cross of Hindu Kush and Nina Limone. Nina Limone (another CO Seed Inc. cut) offers a bright citrus flavor and aroma while imbuing the consumer with a keen mental alertness.

name: Sweet Pebbles
abstract: Sweet Pebbles, bred by Fire Bros. in Washington, is an aromatic hybrid strain with uplifting, happy effects.

name: Sweet Tooth
abstract: A perfect pairing of indica and sativa high with a very sweet taste.

name: Sweet and Sour Widow
abstract: Bred by CBD Crew, Sweet and Sour Widow is a 70/30 indica-dominant cannabis strain with a 1:1 CBD-THC ratio and a subtle sweet onion aroma.

name: Swiss Bliss
abstract: Swiss Bliss is a mostly sativa cannabis strain that users like for its active cerebral high. Plants have many branches and flower in 9 weeks.

name: Swiss Gold
abstract: Swiss Gold is a high-CBD strain from Northern California that is typically classified as a sativa and was bred by the late Lawrence Ringo. Ringo describes the structure of the strain as “pure indica, short and fat.”

name: Swiss Indica
abstract: Swiss refers to any strain that grows natively in the region of Switzerland.

name: Swiss Sativa
abstract: Swiss refers to any sativa strain that grows natively in the region of Switzerland.

name: Swiss Tsunami
abstract: Swiss Tsunami is a rare CBD-rich strain with a pungent smell. A genetic cross of Swiss Gold and Sour Tsunami, Swiss-Tsu is a potent pairing that can generate over 14% CBD with just 0.5% THC on average.

name: THC Bomb
abstract: THC Bomb is a hybrid marijuana strain that was created by Bomb Seeds to have upwards of 20% THC. Plants are hardy and flower in 7 to 9 weeks.

name: TJ's CBD
abstract: TJ’s CBD is a high-CBD strain that is bred by TJ’s Organic Garden in Washington State. Its subtle and mellow flavor profile is led by a skunky aroma and produces a sense of calm physical relaxation without clouding the mind.

name: Tahoe Alien
abstract: Tahoe Alien is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid by Alien Genetics that combines Tahoe OG Kush and Alien Kush.

name: Tahoe Hydro Champagne
abstract: Tahoe Hydro Champagne is a complex sativa-dominant hybrid that challenges the palate while going easy on the body. With a refined melange of fruit, cheese, and floral undertones, this strain opens up like aged spirits and caresses the body with soothing effects.

name: Tahoe Hydro OG
abstract: Tahoe Hydro OG by Tahoe Hydroponic Company is a rich cross of Tahoe OG and OG #18. This strain has a distinct aroma of lemon and fuel with complex earthy notes on the exhale. It is ideal after-hours, saddling the consumer with heavy limbs and deep relaxation.

name: Tahoe OG Kush
abstract: Tahoe OG Kush is the child of OG Kush and SFV OG. This hefty indica is extremely potent and fast-acting, and is perfect for insomnia sufferers.

name: Tangelo
abstract: Tangelo (not to be confused with Tangelo Kush) is the sour citrus offspring of Tangerine Sunrise and Gorkle (The Fork x Rebel God Smoke). With obvious notes of tropical fruit and an unmistakable tangerine/orange juice aroma, Tangelo offers bright, pleasurable aromas and flavors worth sharing.

name: Tangelo Kush
abstract: Chemdawg and Bermese Kush combine their unique and flavorful properties to turn Tangelo Kush into a delicious mixture of skunky, sour citrus zest that emphasizes flavor over potency.

name: Tangenesia
abstract: Tangenesia is a heady bud crafted from even headier parent strains, Tangerine Haze and Ghiesel Amnesia Haze. This strain is a rare gathering of sweet sativa-dominant elements that offer cerebral clarity cloaked in a hazy aura, making it ideal for zoning out on repetitive tasks or binge watching television.

name: Tangerine
abstract: Tangerine is a sativa-dominant hybrid, a 4th generation daughter of Ch9 Aroma.

name: Tangerine Dream
abstract: A 2010 Cannabis Cup winner, Tangerine Dream is a connoisseur hybrid from Barney’s Farm. This strain is well-balanced and flowers in 8-10 weeks.

name: Tangerine Haze
abstract: Tangerine Haze is a sativa-dominant hybrid that is treasured for its distinct citrus smell and taste.

name: Tangerine Kush
abstract: Tangerine Kush is an indica-dominant marijuana hybrid with a sweet taste and citrusy aroma. This relaxing strain is great for those with stress and anxiety.

name: Tangerine Man
abstract: With a citrus aroma and trichome-coated buds, expect a nice pick-me-up that pairs wonderfully with daytime physical activity.

name: Tangerine Power
abstract: Tangerine Power is a hybrid strain by SinCity Seeds that combines Agent Orange and Blue Power.

name: Tangerine Sunrise
abstract: Tangerine Sunrise is easily Colorado Seed Inc.’s most popular strain. It was listed as one of The Ten Best Marijuana Strains of 2014 in the Westerword and has only grown more popular since. With an outstanding aroma that has been described as freshly squeezed orange juice with just a touch of Haze muskiness, Tangerine Sunrise shines even before combustion. Its effects are kind to the body and light on the mind, eliciting a clearheaded mental buzz with positive euphoria.

name: Tangie
abstract: Tangie is a popular hybrid strain out of Amsterdam that has a strong citrus aroma and provides uplifting yet mellow effects.

name: Tangie Dream
abstract: Tangie Dream is a sativa-dominant hybrid strain that reeks of orange peel and rock candy. The strain’s overall sweetness permeates the flavor, leaving consumers with a subtle tartness on the exhale.

name: Tangier Chilly
abstract: Tangier Chilly by Mr. Mack’s Snacks is an homage to Chilly Mack himself and the home of the tangerine. By blending Tangie x Larry OG x Pakistani, Mr. Mack emphasizes a euphoric Kush undertone with sweet citrus terpenes. The buzz is happy and lighthearted while being kind to the body.

name: Tangilope
abstract: Tangilope is a chocolatey, citrus blend of two of DNA Genetics' best sativas, Tangie and Chocolope.

name: Tango Kush
abstract: Tango Kush by Potbox is a Mango Kush cross offering sweet funkiness in droves. With random forest aromas mixed in with the tart fruit, the smell of this strain is complex and pleasant.

name: Tembo Kush
abstract: Tembo Kush, bred by BUDS Pasco in Washington, is a sativa-dominant strain that combines genetics from Elephant, Durban Poison, and OG Kush.

name: Terminator OG
abstract: Terminator Kush (also known as Terminator OG) is a heavy indica-dominant strain with effects similar to that of Death Star and Brutus. This strain offers medium to heavy physical effects that creep onto the body while simultaneously wrapping the consumer’s mind in heady energy.

name: Tesla
abstract: From Pacific Northwest breeder Alphakronic Genes, Tesla is a combination of two popular West Coast hybrids, Harle-Tsu and Gobstopper.

name: Thai
abstract: Thai refers to a cannabis variety that grows natively in Thailand and was brought to the U.S. in the 70s and 80s.

name: Thai Girl
abstract: Thai Girl is supposedly the result of seeds found by Gold King in Thai Stick crossed against Tres Dawg. This sativa-dominant hybrid was cultivated in the late 70’s and spread the euphoric stimulation native to Southeast Asian herb across the cannabis world.

name: Thai Haze
abstract: Thai Haze is a sativa dominant cannabis strain that creates an active, euphoric high. Buds smell spicy and sweet and taste similar to their scent.

name: Thai Lights
abstract: Thai Lights is a sativa-dominant blend that crosses the uplifting effects of Thai Haze with the stable and robust Northern Lights.

name: Thai-Tanic
abstract: Thai-Tanic or Thai Tanic is a very compact Sativa variety, with classic chocolate Thai smell and taste.

name: Thaidal Wave
abstract: Thaidal Wave is a hybrid cannabis strain of Thai lineage. It leaves patients physically active while calming the mind.

name: The Black
abstract: The Black is a powerfully sedating 90% indica strain bred by BC Bud Depot.

name: The Blintz
abstract: Bred by Terraform Genetics, The Bintz is a dense hybrid strain that crosses Cheese Quake with Josh D.O.G.

name: The Blood
abstract: The Blood is a Hawaiian landrace phenotype that appears so rarely that it has gained a mythological status among growers. The Blood was given its name for the red veins found in its stems and leaves, and the deep red sap that flows from them.

name: The Brotherhood
abstract: The Brotherhood by Animas Seed Co. is a stimulating cross of Slick Willie and Icarus. This strain has a quick onset and robust longevity, making it ideal for anyone seeking some get-up-and-go. Hitting firmly between the eyes and rippling outward throughout the body, The Brotherhood offers a stimulating alertness ideal for exercise, sports, or outdoor activity.

name: The Cough
abstract: The flavor and aroma is a mixture of earthy, hash notes and a hint of citrus. The Cough produces a happy mindset and a relaxed body making it a great strain to counter stress.

name: The Doctor
parent_names: great white shark super skunk south indian indica
