abstract: Bred by Green House Seeds, The Doctor is an indica-dominant strain designed to treat a myriad of unpleasant symptoms such as pain, nausea, appetite loss, and insomnia.

name: The Flav
abstract: The Flav was included in High Times' Top 10 of 2008. It's a cross between Romulan and Space Queen.

name: The Fork
abstract: Colorado Seed Inc.’s “The Fork” is dubbed as such because the original breeders utilized a fork, a knife, and a spoon in lieu of tagging their three mysterious Hawaiian strains with specific names.

name: The Grunk
abstract: The Grunk is a perfect representation of its parent strains Grape Ape and Skunk #1. The aroma is sweet and fruity, mixing with pungent skunky notes to create a flavorful burst of earthy, grape flavors upon exhale.

name: The Hog
abstract: This potent indica is regarded as one of the strongest strains in the world and is the 2002 High Times Cannabis Cup winner for best indica.

name: The OX
abstract: e OX has a delightful flavor of coffee and berries, and a high CBD content, making it a good choice for medical users.

name: The One
abstract: The One, originally bred by SkyHighAtrist, is a perfectly balanced hybrid of two landrace strains. It is sometimes referred to by its genetic combination Thai x Pure Afghan.

name: The Ooze
parent_names: green crack white fire alien og
abstract: The Ooze is an indica-dominant cross of Green Crack and White Fire Alien OG.

name: The Sauce
abstract: The Sauce is a 60/40 sativa-dominant hybrid bred by Exotic Genetix. Using a backcross of Green Ribbon to pollenate a Gorilla Glue #4 mother, the Northwest breeder created a potent blend that emits a mix of chocolate, lime and diesel flavors.

name: The Sheriff
abstract: The Sheriff is a sativa-dominant hybrid cross between Chemdawg 91 and SFV OG Kush, two classic staples known for their potent cerebral euphoria.

name: The Sister
abstract: The Sister is an 80/20 indica-dominant strain that is said to be a rare “sister” cut of Chemdawg

name: The Third Dimension
abstract: The Third Dimension, or 3D, from TGA Genetics is a sativa-dominant cross between Apollo 13 and Jack the Ripper.

name: The Truth
abstract: The Truth is a rare sativa-dominant hybrid bred in California by Emerald Mountain Seeds through crossing a Super Skunk hybrid with Chemdawg.

name: The Void
abstract: The Void is a cross between Apollo-13 and Querkle strains. It tastes like grape saltwater taffy while providing a motivational high.

name: The White
abstract: This mysterious strain is aptly named; The White is covered with so many white trichomes that the buds look like they were rolled in confectioner’s sugar.

name: The Wife
abstract: The Wife by Terrapin Care Station is a robust CBD hybrid with a nearly 20:1 CBD/THC ratio.

name: Thelonious Skunk
abstract: Thelonious Skunk, named for Colorado Seed Inc.’s favorite jazz musician, Thelonious Monk, is the funky lovechild of Island Sweet Skunk and Nina Limone. This upbeat, bebopping combo exhibits tropical flavors like citrus trees and sweet earth, mixed with a distinct skunky undertone.

name: Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies
abstract: Thin Mint, a hybrid cross of Durban Poison and OG Kush, is a phenotype of the legendary Girl Scout Cookies strain.

name: Think Different
abstract: Think Different is a durable plant with strong sativa effects that leave consumers feeling dreamy and relaxed.

name: Thor's Hammer
abstract: Like a bolt of lightning commanded by the Norse god himself, Thor’s Hammer delivers an electrifying blast of cerebral energy that awakens creativity and motivation.

name: Throwback Kush
abstract: Throwback Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain bred by Exotic Genetix. It is a combination of an old-school OG Kush mother from the 1990s and a Green Ribbon BX (backcross) father.

name: Thunderbird Rose
abstract: Thunderbird Rose is a sativa strain bred by Kotton for Rebel Spirit Cannabis of Eugene, Oregon. This strain produces large lime green buds that express engorged trichome-covered calyxes and crimson pistils.

name: Thunderstruck
abstract: Thunderstruck is a powerful rock ‘n’ roll themed CBD strain without the big hair. Named after the AC/DC song of the same name, you might have guessed that Thunderstruck is the genetic cross of two high-CBD ACDC phenotypes.

name: Tickle Kush
abstract: Tickle Kush is a relatively new strain bred by Greenwerkz in Colorado. It is a compelling hybrid that combines the earthy diesel flavors of Chemdawg with the pungent and vigorous LA Kush.

name: Tiger Woods
abstract: Tiger Woods is a sativa-dominant hybrid named after the famous American golfer of the same name. This strain has been known to yield a lower-than-average THC percentage of between 10-15%.

name: Tiger's Milk
abstract: Tiger’s Milk by Bodhi Seeds is a powerful indica-dominant strain that descends from Bubba Kush and Appalachia.

name: Tigermelon
abstract: Tigermelon is a mysterious strain of unknown origin that has been used by the breeder Bodhi Seeds to create some spectacular hybrids such as Snow Leopard.

name: Timewreck
abstract: Bred by TGA Genetics, Timewreck is a 70% sativa cross between Vortex and a special cutting of Trainwreck known as Blood Wreck.

name: Tina Danza
abstract: From Swamp Boys Seeds comes Tina Danza, a hybrid strain that crosses Triangle Kush and Georgia Pine. This strain hits the head immediately and slowly settles into the body.

name: Titan's Haze
abstract: This strain brings a powerful cerebral rush that sativa connoisseurs crave with the smell and flavor of herbal spice.

name: Tokyo OG
abstract: Tokyo OG is an OG Kush phenotype whose indica dominance offers relaxing effects that help many put to sleep anxiety, pain, and stress.

name: Tommy's Home Grown
abstract: Tommy’s Home Grown, or THG for short, is a balanced hybrid strain that falls under the “Chong Certified” label.

name: Tora Bora
abstract: Tora Bora is an almost pure indica strain with powerfully heavy effects meant for high-tolerance cannabis veterans.

name: Toxic Punch
abstract: Toxic Punch is a sativa-dominant concoction that crosses a hybrid of White Widow and Casey Jones with Blueberry.

name: Training Day
abstract: Bred by DNA Genetics, Training Day is a 70% indica that combines parent strains Trainwreck and LA Confidential.

name: Trainwreck
abstract: Trainwreck is a mind-bending hybrid with potent sativa effects that hit like a freight train.

name: Trash
abstract: Trash is an indica-dominant hybrid that is anything but garbage. This strain crosses Purple Trainwreck against Afghani Hash Plant, blending the mental alertness of Trainwreck with the resin production and deep, earthy aroma native to Afghani genetics.

name: Travel Joint
abstract: The Travel Joint from Green Life Productions in Nevada is a sativa-dominant strain derived from Alien Star Dawg and Monster Cookies genetics.

name: Tree of Life
abstract: Tree of Life is a unique hybrid cross between Trainwreck and Mendocino Purps, created by Oregon OMMP growers in the late 2000s.

name: Tres Dawg
abstract: The indica-dominant strain Tres Dawg by Top Dawg Seeds comes from Afghani #1 and a backcrossed Chemdawg.

name: Triangle Kush
abstract: Triangle Kush is an indica originating in Florida, named after the state's three cannabis-producing capitals: Jacksonville, Miami, and Tampa.

name: Trident
abstract: Trident is a hybrid marijuana strain that is unique for its extremely high CBD content combined with a very low THC content.

name: Trifecta
abstract: Trifecta is a marijuana strain that is the result of a three-way cross of Apollo 11, Apollo 13, and Cinderella 99. It was originally bred by The Brothers Grimm.

name: Trinity
abstract: A rumored hard to find strain, Trinity is known to have a strong skunk-like smell with an uplifting high.

name: Triple Diesel
parent_names: sour diesel strawberry diesel nyc diesel
abstract: Triple Diesel is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that has a sweet, stinky aroma. It’s a cross of three popular diesel strains.

name: Trix
abstract: Riot Seeds claims to have created the most potent and reliable Colombian Gold hybrid in the world by crossing a New World landrace with Loompa’s Chemdawg D cut.

name: Tropic Thunder
abstract: Tropic Thunder is a mysterious Maui Wowie cross that exhibits colorful buds and floral aromas. The strain’s moderate potency makes it suitable for consumption any time of the day, offering a mellow and manageable buzz that elevates the mood and alleviates stress.

name: Tropicali
abstract: One of the newer hybrids, Tropicali is known for providing an uplifting and cerebral high with a frosty mint green color.

name: True OG
abstract: True OG is a prize-winning indica cannabis strain that has a pungent lemon and pine aroma. Patients enjoy its pain-relief properties.

name: True X
abstract: True X by Royal Choice Farms is an indica-dominant strain built for relaxation. Created by crossing C4 and True OG, True X is a sweet OG cross that offers traditional Kush effects that settle nicely on the body while percolating a warm, welcoming euphoria between the ears.

name: Truth Serum
abstract: Truth Serum is a hybrid strain that was originally bred in the Midwest during the summer of 2006. While exploring how to breed feminized seeds, an underground breeder in Minnesota induced stress on a single branch of G13 to create the pollen that fertilized a variety of strains growing in his garden. After narrowing his breeding projects down into two of the more potent and vigorous phenotypes, we are left with the complex combination of G13, Trinity, and Pineapple.

name: Tuna Kush
abstract: Tuna Kush is a BC legend that is now surfacing in North American medical cannabis markets. This strain has been deemed one of the most potent available, producing small, dense nuggets that are hard-caked with resin. Although Tuna Kush is not known for its large yield, what does come off these thinner stalks will be rich with potency and flavor.

name: Turbo Mind Warp
abstract: Turbo Mind Warp is a hybrid bred by MTG Seeds, who crossed parent strains Turbo Diesel and Mendo Mind Warp.

name: Tutankhamon
abstract: This sour, skunky descendant of AK-47 is packed with uplifting sativa effects, making it a great choice for social outings and creative stimulation.

name: Tutti Frutti
parent_names: blue haze green haze sour diesel haze lowryder thai
abstract: A sativa blend that provides fruity flavors with an uplifting, euphoric effect.

name: Twista
abstract: Twista is a sativa-dominant strain with energetic, focused effects and a high THC content.

name: Twisted Citrus
abstract: Twisted Citrus is a sativa-dominant strain with energizing, uplifting effects and a citrus aroma.

name: Tyson
abstract: With a pungent diesel aroma, Tyson delivers a punch of indica effects known to fully relax the body while dulling pain, stress, insomnia, and appetite loss.

name: U2 Kush
abstract: U2 Kush, or Ewe-2 Kush, is a mostly indica strain bred from the genetics of Master Kush and Bubba Kush.

name: UK Cheese
abstract: UK Cheese is a popular hybrid strain that is probably a phenotype of Skunk #1. Effects tend to be strong and balanced between mind and body.

name: UW
abstract: UW is a strong indica medical cannabis strain that is rumored to be from the University of Washington; thus, it is named after the college.

name: Ultimate Trainwreck
abstract: Ultimate Trainwreck is a more potent version of Trainwreck, a popular cannabis strain.

name: Ultra Banana
abstract: Ultra Banana is a delicious, sleep-inducing cross of MK Ultra and Banana Kush. MK Ultra possesses strong indica-dominant genetics, including OG Kush and G-13, which are amplified by the sweet and floral elements of Banana Kush.

name: Ultra Sonja
abstract: Ultra Sonja is a sativa-dominant descendant of U.K. Cheese and Tang Tang that inherits an unusual blend of flavor and effects from its parent strains.

name: Ultra Sour
parent_names: mk ultra east coast sour diesel
abstract: Ultra Sour by THSeeds is a tart cross out of Amsterdam. This strain is the product of crossing MK Ultra and East Coast Sour Diesel, creating a sativa-dominant bud with uplifting stimulation and heady euphoria.

name: UltraViolet OG
parent_names: face off og north american indica
abstract: From Archive Seeds, UltraViolet OG is an 80% indica strain bred by crossing Face Off OG with a Purple Indica from the Pacific Northwest.

name: Urkle Train Haze
abstract: An Arizona Natural Selections' original, Urkle Train Haze was created using the genetics of Ghost Train Haze and Purple Urkle.

name: VCDC
abstract: VCDC is a hybrid, bred by Moxie Seeds and Extracts, that crosses Viper City OG with ACDC.

name: VOTS AZ Super Sour OG
abstract: AZ Super Sour OG is a sour and skunky hybrid strain that can test as high as 24% THC.

name: Vader OG
abstract: Vader OG by Ocean Grown Seeds is the namesake strain of one of OGS’s master growers, Vader. This cross began in 2006 with the combination of SFV OG and Larry OG, and evolved over a laborious process of identifying the best phenotypes to breed forward.

name: Valentine X
abstract: Named for St. Valentine, the patron saint of epilepsy, Valentine X is a 50/50 hybrid sought after for its exceptional healing powers and a CBD:THC ratio of 25:1.

name: Valley Ghash
parent_names: g13 hash plant sfv og kush jack's cleaner
abstract: Valley Ghash is a hybrid strain that combines genetics from G13, Hash Plant, SFV OG Kush, and Jack’s Cleaner.

name: Valley Girl
abstract: From Archive Bank comes Valley Girl, a balanced hybrid strain that descends from SFV OG and Face Off OG.

name: Vanilla Kush
abstract: Vanilla Kush is an indica-dominant cannabis strain. It is a 2009 High Times Cannabis Cup Winner and boasts high THC levels.

name: Vanilluna
abstract: World renowned Oregon breeder DJ Short used his legendary Blueberry genetics to create this 50/50 hybrid, Vanilluna.

name: Velvet Bud
abstract: A mostly sativa that crosses Dutch Treat and Blueberry, Velvet Bud is a great choice for anyone struggling with depression, anxiety, and stress.

name: Venice OG
abstract: Venice OG is a sativa-dominant cannabis strain that has energetic effects for most patients.

name: Venom OG
abstract: Venom OG from Rare Dankness Seeds is an indica-dominant cross between Poison OG and Rare Dankness #1.

name: Venus OG
abstract: Another member of the “planetary series,” Venus OG is a hybrid strain bearing OG Kush heritage, although its specific parent strains are disputed.

name: Verde Electric
abstract: Verde Electric is a hybrid cannabis strain that first emerged in the Arizona medical marijuana community and is often recommended for pain.

name: Versace
parent_names: sour diesel og kush granddaddy purple
abstract: Versace is a clear-headed sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Sour Diesel, OG Kush, and Granddaddy Purple. This trio of trichome-rich strains is combined to offer an array of effects that work off each other.

name: Very Berry Haze
abstract: Very Berry Haze is a pure sativa cannabis strain that grows tall and large indoors or in warm climates. It produces many flowers with a sweet, fruity aroma.

name: Violator Kush
abstract: Known for it's high THC and CBD levels, Violator Kush is a mostly indica cross of Hindu Kush and Malana.

name: Violet Delight
abstract: Violet Delight is an indica-dominant strain that delivers exactly what its name promises: a loud burst of floral flavor that can only be compared to the aroma of a violet.

name: Viper
abstract: Viper is an invigorating sativa that was bred from an indigenous Burmese landrace and a native Mexican strain known as Blackseed.

name: Voodoo
abstract: Voodoo, descended from a Thai landrace, is an uplifting sativa cannabis strain with long-lasting, euphoric effects.

name: Vortex
abstract: Vortex won first place for best sativa in the 2010 Cannabis Cup.

name: WMD
abstract: WMD by Vancouver Island Seed Company is a high-yielding indica with potent Canadian roots. It exhibits a unique aroma of sweet berry, musk, and hashy spice that remains earthy on the palate after exhaling. The effects are initially cerebral, but they later settle down into the body to relax and soothe limbs.

name: WSU
abstract: WSU is a Washington-grown rendition of the indica strain Chemo and it’s waiting for you on the shelves of recreational stores state-wide.

name: Waipi'o Hapa
abstract: Waipi’o Hapa is a Hawaiian beauty with a quick flowering time. Faster than most sativas, this strain flowers in 8 to 9 weeks.

name: Waldo
abstract: Waldo is a hybrid strain of marijuana that grows well in many climates and gives users a long-lasting cerebral high.

name: Walker Kush
abstract: Walker Kush is the Rare Dankness cross of Albert Walker and Rare Dankness #1. These stimulating genetics blend Afghan Skunk, Ghost OG, and Chemdawg into a multifaceted indica-dominant hybrid that uplifts while remaining grounded in soothing body effects.

name: Wally OG
abstract: Wally OG, said to be a Ghost OG and Phantom OG cross, is an indica-dominant hybrid with potent full-body effects.

name: Walrus Kush
abstract: Walrus Kush is a slow, moderate hybrid. Giggly and sociable, this strain is great for weekend gatherings but not ideal for work.

name: Walter White
abstract: Walter White by Mephisto Genetics is a hybrid cross created out of fascination. After seeing a glittering cut of The White, Mephisto Genetics set out to build something special off the brilliant trichome production of that particular plant.

name: Wappa
abstract: Wappa is a 60% indica-dominant hybrid bred by Paradise Seeds that delivers happy, uplifting effects alongside an intense fruity flavor.

name: Warlock
abstract: Warlock by Magus Genetics is an indica-dominant strain with stimulating, focused effects and a sweet, sour aroma.

name: Watermelon
abstract: Watermelon is an 80% indica strain known for its relaxing qualities and appetite stimulation.

name: Webster
abstract: Webster is a stimulating sativa with uplifting elements off the get-go. This strain is immediately motivating, encouraging physical activity from chores to hitting the gym. Flavors of citrus and sweetness are noted on the exhale, and are accompanied by appetite stimulation and an “empty-head” type of stress relief.

name: Wedding Cake
abstract: Wedding Cake, also known as Pink Cookies, is the familial genetic cross of Girl Scout Cookies x Cherry Pie. This delectable treat is rich with tangy sweet earth and pepper, taking notes and dimension from its OG and Durban Poison parentage.

name: Wellness OG
abstract: Wellness OG is a sativa-dominant phenotype of OG Kush that took 1st place for hybrids at the 2015 SoCal Medical Cup.

name: West Coast Dawg
abstract: West Coast Dawg is a thoroughbred West Coast local that harnesses the potency of Chemdawg while remaining indica-dominant in effect. The flavor and powerful onset howl Chemdawg, exhibiting flavors of fuel, chemicals, pine, and a floral undertone that speaks to its latent Kush genetics.

name: West OG
abstract: A heavy-handed indica, West OG descends from the famous Chemdawg and a backcrossed Humboldt.

name: Wet Dream
abstract: Wet Dream, native to San Diego, California, is a high-energy sativa cross between Blue Dream and OB Haze (Ocean Beach Haze).

name: Whitaker Blues
abstract: Whitaker Blues is a classic indica-dominant strain that blends genetics from Quimby (a West Coast indica) and Blueberry.

name: White 99
abstract: White 99 is a potent hybrid cross of polar opposites. The offspring of Cinderella 99 and The White, this hybrid takes after its ancestors in both aroma and effect.

name: White Bastard
abstract: White Bastard is an indica-dominant strain predominantly found East of the Rocky Mountains. It exemplifies its pungent parentage, DJ Short’s Blueberry and God Bud, through its strong aromas of blueberry intermixed with notes of earth, skunk, and forest.

name: White Berry
abstract: White Berry provides a sativa head effect and a nice body sensation when consumed in higher quantities.

name: White Buffalo
abstract: White Buffalo is an 80/20 sativa-dominant cannabis strain that descends from a Romulan and a Blackberry Kush/Bay 11 hybrid.

name: White Caramel Cookies
parent_names: girl scout cookies white widow purple urkle caramella
abstract: White Caramel Cookies by Sumo Seeds is an indica-dominant dessert strain. Created by blending two distinct pairings (Wookie, a cross between Girl Scout Cookies and White Widow; and Purckle, a combination of Purple Urkle and Caramella), White Caramel Cookies’ stabilized genetics yield dense, frosted buds that emanate a sugary, earthy aroma.

name: White Cheese
abstract: White Cheese from Zambeza Seeds is an indica-dominant hybrid that crosses Cheese genetics with Super Skunk and Afghani.

name: White Cookies
abstract: White Cookies by Crop King Seeds is the hybrid cross of old school White Widow and new school Girl Scout Cookies. With potency and acclaim on either side of this cross, White Cookies utilizes the sweet, uplifting euphoria of the old school and masterfully blends it with new school OG elements that relax the body, creating a strain that is effective at curbing pain and enhancing mood.

name: White Dawg
abstract: From the lineage The White and Chem Dawg.

name: White Diesel
abstract: White Diesel is a sativa-dominant hybrid that mixes the resinous White Widow with the pungent flavors of NYC Diesel.

name: White Dragon
abstract: White Dragon is a pure indica strain bred by Eva Seeds through crossing Northern Lights and an Afghani indica.

name: White Dream
abstract: A cross between two epic sativa-dominant strains, Blue Dream and White Widow, White Dream is sure to please fans of potent hybrids, as it has tested at over 24% THC.

name: White Durban
abstract: White Durban by Fireline is a beautiful sativa-dominant strain endowed with the speed of a cheetah wearing a supersonic jet engine. By combining Fireline’s own White Fire OG and the African landrace Durban Poison, a strain with potency and alacrity is created.

name: White Elephant
abstract: White Elephant, an indica-dominant hybrid, combines the potency of White Widow with the sweetness of Purple Elephant.

name: White Empress
abstract: White Empress is a beautifully flavorful and potent indica-dominant strain. With a flavor profile that is repeatedly described as citrus candy or Orange Ocean Spray, this strain is a pleasurable addition to anyone's cannabis collection, if only for how delicious it tastes. Its effects are euphoric yet calming, and are well-suited for patients suffering from nausea, restlessness, and general mental fatigue.

name: White Fire 43
abstract: White Fire 43 is a select phenotype of White Fire OG grown by TLC Collective in Los Angeles, CA. Number 43 was the standout phenotype in a lot of over 500 White Fire OG seeds, originally bred by OG Raskal.

name: White Fire Alien OG
abstract: White Fire Alien OG is a 60% indica strain bred by OG Raskal through crossing The White and Fire Alien Kush.

name: White Fire OG
abstract: White Fire OG, also known as WiFi OG, is a 60% sativa hybrid with uplifting and comfortable, cerebrally focused effects.

name: White Gold
abstract: White Gold from Sensi Seeds is an indica-dominant hybrid that mixes White Widow with Himalayan Gold.

name: White Gorilla
parent_names: gorilla glue #4 white fire alien og
abstract: White Gorilla combines the resinous production of Gorilla Glue #4 with the aromatic bouquet and stress relief of White Fire Alien OG.

name: White Haze
abstract: White Haze, bred by Sensi Seeds, is a 70/30 sativa-dominant strain that offers a lightweight, lofty buzz.

name: White Knight
abstract: White Knight is a “Chong Certified” hybrid strain from Encanto Green Cross in Phoenix, Arizona.

name: White Kryptonite
abstract: White Kryptonite is an indica-dominant strain that descends from Killer Queen, Mendocino Purps, and White Widow.

name: White Kush
abstract: White Kush is the potent daughter of Afghan Kush and White Widow. A nighttime indica, this strain is great for relaxation and stress relief.

name: White Lavender
abstract: White Lavender is a sativa-dominant cross of White Widow and Lavender bred by G13 Labs. The influence of White Widow genetics adds a heavy coat of trichomes to the potent effects and flowery flavors of Lavender.

name: White Lightning
abstract: Bred by British Columbia Seed Company, White Lightning is an indica-dominant strain that combines White Widow and Northern Lights #5.

name: White Lotus
abstract: A frosty cross between The White and Snow Lotus, White Lotus is a relaxing indica-dominant hybrid.

name: White Nightmare
abstract: Blue Dream’s soaring sativa effects and fruity flavors collide with White Moonshine’s resinous coat of milky trichomes to produce White Nightmare.

name: White OG
abstract: White OG is an indica-dominant strain that was first bred by Karma Genetics by crossing The White with SFV OG Kush.

name: White Queen
abstract: White Queen is a potent relative of White Widow. This strain grows well both indoors and outdoors and has a flowering time of 8 to 9 weeks.

name: White Rhino
abstract: White Rhino is a hybrid cross of White Widow and an unknown indica strain. It's great for medicinal use because it has a high THC content.

name: White Romulan
abstract: White Romulan, a combination of Romulan and The White, is a balanced hybrid bred by OG Raskal Genetics.

name: White Russian
abstract: White Russian may be the strongest plant known currently.  With 22% THC it has won multiple Cannabis Cups and will not disappoint with its strong cerebral high.

name: White Ryder
abstract: White Ryder is Riot Seeds’ attempt to create a Ruderalis version of White Widow by crossing Buddha Seeds’ White Dwarf against Low Ryder. By blending two stout, autoflowering plants, Riot Seeds created a potent indica-dominant hybrid that finishes in under 80 days and can easily be hidden from view.

name: White Sangria
abstract: White Sangria is the functional indica-dominant hybrid cross of Tahoe Hydro OG and Gelato 45. This strain’s buds are bright green with facets of purple throughout and emanate an aroma of pine, citrus, and sweetness. The buzz is happy and uplifting while leaving the body cozy and collected.

name: White Siberian
abstract: By combining the vigorous AK-47 with the popular White Widow, Dinafem Seeds has increased the flavor, potency, and CBD content of this dynamic strain.

name: White Skunk
abstract: White Skunk is an indica-dominant variation of Skunk from Sensi Seeds’ White Label.

name: White Slipper
abstract: White Slipper is a sativa-dominant hybrid that crosses The White and Glass Slipper, resulting in a relaxing strain perfect for shedding stress.

name: White Smurf
abstract: White Smurf is a hybrid strain bred from a Northern Lights x Skunk #1 female and a pure Dutch sativa male

name: White Strawberry
abstract: White Strawberry is the flavorful cross of The White and Strawberry Cough. This all-day hybrid blends The White’s relaxing physical effects and tertiary gastrointestinal benefits with Strawberry Cough’s cerebral stimulation to create a potent hybrid with medicinal utility.

name: White Urkle
abstract: White Urkle is a hybrid of Purple Urkle and The White bred by OG Raskal Genetics. Most phenotypes will express themselves with deep violet hues that show the influence of its Purple Urkle mother.

name: White Walker Kush
abstract: DNA Genetics’ White Walker Kush (not to be confused with Whitewalker OG) is a hybrid cross of elite parent strains White Widow (Ingemar cut) and Skywalker Kush.

name: White Walrus
abstract: White Walrus is a phenotype of Chernobyl, grown specially by Kushman Veganics for the release of Kevin Smith's film Tusk.

name: White Widow
abstract: Among the most famous strains worldwide is White Widow, a balanced hybrid first bred in the Netherlands.

name: White Zombie
abstract: White Zombie is a potent hybrid strain with cerebrally-focused effects conducive for creative endeavors and stress relief.

name: Whiteout
abstract: Parent strains Super Silver Haze and The White were brought together to create this uplifting hybrid strain. Whiteout delivers intense euphoria paired with an alert, focused effect sure to satisfy your daytime needs.

name: Whitewalker OG
abstract: Whitewalker OG (not to be confused with White Walker Kush) by Gold Coast Collection is an indica variation of the renowned SFV OG Kush.

name: Willie Nelson
abstract: Willie Nelson is a sativa-dominant cannabis that is a 2005 Cannabis Cup winner. It leaves consumers clearheaded and uplifted.

name: Willy Wonka
abstract: Willy Wonka is a sativa strain that took third place in the concentrates category of the 2014 Denver Cannabis Cup.

name: Willy's Wonder
abstract: Willy’s Wonder is a cannabis strain that was originally developed in the 1980s and has since grown in popularity and potency.

name: Wonder Haze
abstract: Wonder Haze is a hybrid cannabis strain that combines cerebral haze effects with body relaxation and pain relief.

name: Wonder Woman
abstract: Wonder Woman is a hybrid marijuana strain that is prized for its extremely high yields, easy growing, and long-lasting high.

name: Wonka's Bubblicious
abstract: Wonka's Bubblicious has a taste reminiscent of Bubblicious bubble gum from your childhood. Taste is known to subtly change flavors and tones over the period of two minutes, similar to Wonka's candy.

name: Woody Kush
abstract: Woody Kush is a potent indica. Great for insomnia and stress relief, this strain takes after its Master Kush, OG Kush, and Hindu Kush parentage.

name: Wreckage
abstract: Wreckage, bred by TH Seeds, is a sativa-dominant cross between Trainwreck and SAGE that provides an energetic, happy escape from stress, fatigue, and bad moods.

name: X-File
abstract: Not to be confused with the similar-sounding X-Files hybrid, this indica-dominant strain crosses Kosher Tangie with a White Fire Alien and ’09 Cookies hybrid.

name: X-Files
abstract: X-Files is a hybrid cross between Sour Diesel, Mask, and the pure indica strain Purple Drank.

name: X-Wing
abstract: X-Wing is a mid-level indica-dominant strain with dark purple foliage and lightly frosted buds. This Skywalker OG phenotype exhibits OG Kush flavors like earth and spice coupled with the pungent aroma of forest floor.

name: X-tra Chz
abstract: X-tra Chz, bred by MTG Seeds, is a pungent-smelling hybrid cross between Cheese #1 and Cheese Bomb.

name: XJ-13
abstract: XJ-13 is a sativa-dominant strain cherished for both its therapeutic potency and enjoyable euphoric buzz.

name: XXX 420
abstract: XXX 420 from Ontario, Canada is an indica cross between Sweet Tooth #3 and Chemo.

name: XXX OG
abstract: XXX OG, from parent strains OG Kush and XXX, is a hard-hitting indica that took 1st place in the 2014 Los Angeles Cannabis Cup.

name: Xanadu
parent_names: south asian cinderella 99 durban poison thai
abstract: Xanadu is sativa-dominant strain that delivers soaring cerebral euphoria alongside a skunky, citrus aroma.

name: Y Griega
abstract: Also known as Shangri La or simply “Y,” the 80% sativa Y Griega is an energizing strain with a sweet floral, citrus aroma.

name: Yeti OG
abstract: Originally known as the Headband BX, Yeti OG was bred by NorCal collective Loompa Farms and has become a highly sought after strain due to its incredible taste and heavy yields.

name: Yoda OG
abstract: Yoda OG, a descendant of the legendary OG Kush, is an indica-dominant strain that induces heavy relaxation of the mind and body.

name: Yoda's Brain
abstract: Yoda’s Brain is an indica-dominant cut with dense, crystal-coated buds rich with potency. Due to its high THC content, Yoda’s Brain exhibits a sativa-dominant rush to the head off the get-go. This powerful sizzle in the brain simmers down and wraps the body in a weighted aura some might consider meditative.

name: Yogi Diesel
abstract: A pungent mix of Sour Diesel and Northern Lights #5, Yogi Diesel is a great way to relieve stress and maintain your energy.

name: Yumboldt
abstract: Yumboldt is known to leave the user with heavy eyelids and a smile.

name: Yummy
abstract: Yummy is a calming indica-dominant hybrid that hails from Northern California where it was bred by combining Granddaddy Kush and White Dawg genetics.

name: Zen
abstract: Zen is a sour, earthy hybrid strain bred to help patients treating stomach, digestive, and mood disorders.

name: Zeta Sage
abstract: Zeta Sage is a sativa-dominant hybrid that combines SAGE and OG Kush genetics. The flavors of Zeta Sage are a sweet, pungent mix of sharp diesel and blueberry that leave a lingering menthol aftertaste.

name: Zeus OG
abstract: Zeus OG is a hybrid cross between Pineapple OG and Deadhead OG bred by A Greener Today's Dankczar.

name: Zkittlez
abstract: Zkittlez is an indica-dominant mix of Grape Ape and Grapefruit that is crossed with another undisclosed strain to produce this candy-flavored cannabis bred by 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz. This award-winning combination took 1st Place Indica at the 2015 Cannabis Cups in San Francisco and in Michigan.

name: Zombie OG
abstract: Zombie OG is an extremely potent indica cannabis strain. This cross between OG Kush and Blackberry is great for relieving muscle spasms and pain.

name: Zoom Pie
abstract: Zoom Pie (also known as Zombie Pie) is a heavy indica-dominant strain that blends the potency of Blue Zombie with the Cookie Fam legend, Cherry Pie. This combination yields blue and purple foliage that reeks of tart cherries and pungent skunky fuel. It is known to stimulate appetite while imbuing the consumer with a heady euphoria (presumably from the recessive African landrace, Durban Poison, nestled in Cherry Pie).

name: ʻAlenuihāhā
abstract: ʻAlenuihāhā is a sativa-dominant hybrid by Pua Mana 1st Hawaiian Pakalōlō Seed Bank named after the sea channel that separates the Kona side of the Big Island and the island of Maui. By blending Kona Gold and Maui Wowie, ʻAlenuihāhā achieves an uplifted and happy stimulation that doesn’t overclock the consumer’s heart or mind.
